**TLDR**: Fern generates useful artifacts for your API, like SDKs, docs, and server code. [Star us on GitHub! ⭐](https://github.com/fern-api/fern)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69195&key=user_uploads/1214945/858d9c67-1fb0-4dc2-8e3b-53c2c1db216f)

_Steve Yazicioglu, Head of Engineering at Candid Health (Series A)_

### **Problem**

When building APIs, we spent a lot of our time doing things like:

* Writing types & networking logic on the backend
* Communicating details of the API endpoints over Slack
* Re-writing the _same_ types & networking logic on the frontend
* Re-writing the _same_ types & networking logic in each SDK or client library
* Re-writing the _same_ information in our docs & Postman Collection

Inevitably, these multiple sources of truth get out of sync, causing runtime bugs, wasted hours of debugging, and frustration.

### **Solution**

[Fern](https://www.buildwithfern.com/) productizes schema-first API design. You define the schema of your API (or give us an OpenAPI spec) and we generate:

* **SDKs** in popular programming languages. Our SDKs feel handwritten. They can be used externally for customers or internally for your frontend/microservices.
* **API docs** that sync to your provider of choice.
* **Postman Collection** complete with examples of successful and unsuccessful requests
* **Server-side validation** to make sure that you serve the API you promised.

Fern also registers all versions of your API in a registry — no need to ping a coworker over Slack to understand how to consume an API.

With love [💌](https://emojipedia.org/love-letter/),\
Team Fern 🌿 (Deep, and Danny)

### **Our asks**

* Star us on [GitHub!](https://github.com/fern-api/fern)

launches.tagline: We score every opportunity against your unique sales process by analyzing call recordings
launches.body:
**_TL;DR_** _- Fabius helps sales leaders take the guesswork out of their sales pipeline by providing visibility into their sales process. For individual reps, we provide just-in-time feedback to reps to help drive urgency and win more deals._

Hey everyone, we’re [Neil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/neil-madsen-18a3755b/) and [Andy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrewkday/) and we’re thrilled to announce the launch of [Fabius](https://www.fabius.io/).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69385&key=user_uploads/630080/d80ac2d9-d0a3-4448-a5b0-656faa0d255b)

**🫣 The Problem: B2B sales teams are often blind to how their sales process works in practice.**

Despite having a well-defined process (like MEDDPICC), sales reps can often overlook key information, and view deals with rose-colored glasses.

Identifying pain, driving urgency, and gaining access to power are critical to successful B2B sales - especially in today’s market! Without visibility into their process, sales leaders struggle to make accurate forecasts, identify deals that are off-track, and onboard new reps effectively.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69385&key=user_uploads/630080/8ecee57b-d85c-4bb6-819d-d8b0ed4ee007)

**🔎 The Solution:**

Fabius uses data from customer intelligence tools like Gong and Chorus to overlay your company's sales methodology with what's happening in the field, leveraging LLMs to extract the ground truth around your opportunities. We score every deal against your company’s tailored sales process so you can replicate what works again and again.

**For sales leaders** - this gives unparalleled visibility into their sales processes, so they can improve their forecasts, help course correct deals which are missing key steps in their methodology, and ramp up sales reps faster.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69385&key=user_uploads/630080/5281e3e4-5b22-406b-9b01-ba28f58619c9)

**For individual reps** - they get just-in-time feedback on their sales calls to help them drive urgency and win more deals.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69385&key=user_uploads/630080/188dcb5f-5446-4ee1-ae91-b4ef2e5f5f06)

We believe that Fabius is the best way to take the guesswork out of sales and help sales teams become more efficient and productive. We are excited to get started and look forward to helping B2B sales teams succeed!

**Our Asks!**

1. Sign up for our waitlist by emailing [founders@fabius.io](mailto:founders@fabius.io)!
2. Share this post with anyone who might need this (think Sales Leaders, CROs, etc)

launches.title: highlight.io - Open-source session replay & error monitoring
launches.tagline: highlight.io is the open source, fullstack monitoring platform. We help engineers reproduce hard-to-crack issues, and understand how their product is used.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68975&key=user_uploads/241768/1b79410b-8b41-4e1e-8869-c4ccfe7d2130)

## **TL;DR:**

[highlight.io](http://highlight.io) is an open-source **session replay and error monitoring** tool that helps teams reproduce hard-to-crack issues and understand product usage. We enable developers to understand WHY bugs are thrown on their web apps to eliminate the noisy alerts they get from more traditional monitoring tools.

[highlight.io](http://highlight.io) is already being used in production by **2k+ developers and 80+ companies**. Get started for free at [app.highlight.io](http://app.highlight.io) and give us a ⭐️ at [github.com/highlight/highlight](http://github.com/highlight/highlight).

### **The Problem**

How many times have you gotten an alert from Bugsnag or Sentry, and dismissed it because you weren’t sure about what caused it? And how many of you have an endless backlog of errors that your team _should_ triage, but haven’t gotten to yet?

We’ve found that when debugging an issue or customer request, **the toolset that you use is responsible for delivering one thing only: context**. And if there’s any gaps in this context, engineers are left in the dark.

To solve this, at our last companies, we found a lot of value in instrumenting a session replay-like tool, (similar to Logrocket or Fullstory), paired with an error monitoring tool (like Bugsnag). In fact, we’ve built these sorts of tools ourselves to hackily solve the problem. Enter [highlight.io](http://highlight.io).

### **The Solution: Session Replay 🤝 Error Monitoring**

With a simple `yarn/npm` import in your frontend and an optional import in your backend, [highlight.io](http://highlight.io) gives you session replay and error monitoring out of the box. This means that you can:

* Replay exactly what a user was seeing at the time of an issue/bug.
* Reproduce the browser dev-tools for every user session, including the network requests, errors, and more.
* Access all of the errors and exceptions (both frontend and backend) thrown in your app, paired with session replay.

Lastly, given the privacy-sensitive nature of the product, we have a very powerful privacy API that you can take a look at in our docs [here](https://www.highlight.io/docs/session-replay/privacy).

## **💬 What’s Next?**

We’re just getting started! We have plans to go way deeper into your observability stack to give you ALL of the visibility you need; that means logs, traces and more! Join us on this journey:

* ⭐️ us on [GitHub](https://github.com/highlight/highlight) to keep up with releases and news.
* Join [our Discord](https://highlight.io/community)!

launches.body:
# **Problem: 74% of sales reps miss quota**

👆This is why Pipeline Generation is today’s biggest problem CROs are facing!  

B2B selling is hard. Buyers are inundated with noise. Modern “solutions” only automate the problem:

* 2% cold call success = automated power dialers 🤮
* 1% cold email success = mass sales engagement sequencers 👎🏼
* Costly SDR team = AI prospecting + “virtual SDRs” that “personalize” at scale 🙅‍♂️

Personalization does not matter if no one opens your email or answers your call. There’s a monumental shift in the industry of B2B prospecting - and CROs are searching for a new playbook.

# **Vector: Less Volume, More Quality**

We believe in an AI-enabled world where authentic relationships rule all.

Vector is the world’s only Relationship Intelligence platform — using AI to analyze 400M+ signals in real-time to identify meaningful relationships across your company’s entire network to win, retain, and expand deals.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/V8oj_wAPmeAT7ayqDcRBSOPMM66QEMPMd0Tlwd-kgcEBr9ijOnSmtE-OOxC-4TOZQno7GE118BQwF2qJsA-Z1Mv8F-Pa7KY6Ver8YvvT4n6PnP_5I8Q1P5ahY4k7EziCs79zTJVDcEwddDbLvquKWok)

# **The Shared Experience Graph™**

At Vector’s core is the Shared Experience Graph™ — a powerful data engine analyzing hundreds of signals _per relationship_ and a proprietary AI model purpose-built to find the most authentic relationships for your sales team.

Stop relying on manual spreadsheets, meaningless mutual LinkedIn connections, or expensive, glorified champion tracking tools that only tap a fraction of your network.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/_WqZpni8euVAwRbQBinwgZW9xlhK3WKp3HX1mj8cppFi5ii6F_zgsONXutIpuwxqNgVbMzAe1s-F5SGaHh3aDvkKEhdMaCltw5a3Wki53OxLPpMn0-pALETUoDn1QqgZqEYqvenY8VySx8zrQ17qmOE)

Let’s talk, because **84% of your B2B decision-makers start their buying process with a referral**, but finding the right trusted person to open the door for your team is extremely hard.

Follow us, [Joshua](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joshuaperk/) and [Nick](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicholasamasters/). We lived with this problem for years as GTM executives, and now we’re fixing it at [Vector.](https://vector.co/?utm_source=YC&utm_medium=Launch&utm_campaign=2024&utm_id=YC+Launch%2C+2024)

name: Skyhook
all_locations: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
long_description:
We make running services on Kubernetes as easy as Heroku, but on your cloud and with all the flexibility and power of Kubernetes. Companies use Skyhook so that they don't have to hire dedicated infrastructure engineers.

Although 50-70% of organizations have already adopted Kubernetes, most developers agree that it is too complex and difficult to manage. It is intended to be extremely flexible in order to solve pretty much everyone’s needs, but it can take a ton of work and many auxiliary tools to get there.

As companies grow, they spend a lot on DevOps or Platform Engineers that try to reduce the burden on developers by gluing together all the 3p tools via custom internal tools.

We are building an “internal developer platform” out of the box, with best practices and golden paths for building and operating services on Kubernetes.

We do the research on the latest and greatest tools in the extremely vibrant ecosystem, and automatically integrate for you the tools you want to use.

We operate on our customers code and in your Cloud environment, so they never locked in and never restricted, as is common with classic PaaS offerings.

If you prefer a fully hosted environment like Heroku, Fly or Vercel, we’ll host a cluster for you and offer you a one-click migration to your own cluster when you want.
one_liner: PaaS-like experience with the power of Kubernetes, on your cloud

launches.title: Skyhook - Kubernetes the easy way 🚀
launches.tagline: We make running services on Kubernetes as easy as Heroku, but on your cloud and with all the flexibility and power of Kubernetes.
launches.body:
**TL;DR; We help you set up production-ready services in minutes instead of days and weeks, with all the tools you need and Kubernetes best practices out of the box, so that you can focus on your code. [Talk to us](https://calendly.com/oded-koalaops/meeting) to learn more!**

**Also, if you need help with migrating/working with Kubernetes please [contact us ](https://mailto:founders@skyhook.io)for a free consultation. We’d love to learn and help.**

Hi everyone, we’re Oded Regev and Nadav Erell, the founders of [Skyhook](https://www.skyhook.io/?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=yclaunch).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69952&key=user_uploads/1233799/182a0cd6-8737-48d0-9543-543907a62b1b)

[**Nadav, CTO**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nadav-erell/) formerly a Staff Software Engineer and an experienced team leader and architect at Google. Deep technical experience building scalable, robust systems in cloud native environments.

[**Oded, CEO**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/odedregev/) founded and led Cherrypick Consulting for 7 years with diverse customers including Gong.io, Mixtiles, Outbrain, OpenWeb and many more. 

# The Problem

Although [50-70%](https://www.cncf.io/reports/cncf-annual-survey-2022/) of organizations have already adopted Kubernetes, most developers agree that it is too complex and difficult to manage. It is intended to be extremely flexible in order to solve pretty much everyone’s needs, however, it can take a ton of work and many auxiliary tools to get there.

As companies grow, they spend a lot on DevOps or Platform Engineers that try to reduce the burden on developers by gluing together all the 3rd party tools via custom internal tools.

# Our Solution

We give you an “internal developer platform” out of the box, with best practices and golden paths for building and operating services on Kubernetes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69952&key=user_uploads/1233799/9f8423a0-3f16-48f6-911c-d8e6234bfbc1)

We do the research on the latest and greatest tools in the extremely vibrant ecosystem, and automatically integrate for you the tools you want to use.

We operate on your code and in your Cloud environment, so you’re never locked in and never restricted, as is common with classic PaaS offerings.

If you prefer a fully hosted environment like Heroku, Fly or Vercel, we’ll host a cluster for you and offer you a one-click migration to your own cluster whenever you want.

# **Our Ask 🙏**

[Contact us](https://mailto:founders@skyhook.io) - We have a few last slots left in our beta - we’d love to see if we can help you step up your Kubernetes game or migrate, so that you can focus on building your own product instead of configuring YAML files and tools all day.

### **We also offer free Kubernetes consultation!**

Please [contact us](https://mailto:founders@skyhook.io) or [book time](https://calendly.com/nadaverell) - we’d love to assist, even if you don’t end up using our product. Learning about real-life challenges that you are facing and trying to help you navigate them helps inform our roadmap and focus.

launches.title: Lightski - Embed an AI data scientist in your app
launches.tagline: Embedded data analytics more powerful than Tableau and Looker by pairing AI with code execution
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** Lightski helps you build an analytics experience for your users that answers any arbitrary question about their data. We provide embedded data analytics more powerful than Tableau and Looker by pairing AI with code execution, which eliminates hallucinations.

## Why?

Before YC, I was an engineering manager at Affinity CRM, where we spent six figures on an embedded analytics solution. Even then, our users were never happy; they either didn’t know how to navigate the complex UI or wanted even more advanced analytics. Most customers ended up exporting the data themselves and running their own analysis (not an ideal solution).

Recent AI advancements remove this trade-off, enabling a natural language interface and powerful code-based analysis. We started Lightski to quickly give your users the full power of a data scientist, without needing to know a line of code.

## User Experience

With Lightski, you’re able to embed an AI Data Scientist in your app, pre-loaded with your users’ data. Your users can then explore a dataset however they want; in response, we generate and execute code to perform analyses, such as:

* Create custom graphs, charts, and dashboards
* Perform arbitrary filters, group-bys, and aggregations
* Transform or clean data for a custom CSV export

Anything that a data scientist can accomplish in code can now be accomplished with Lightski. Best of all, your users won’t even know we’re powering the experience—you can quickly re-theme our UI with your design system.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80683&key=user_uploads/68558/dea1307b-ab28-464c-acf0-f89373cf1dfe)

## Under the Hood

We rely heavily on state-of-the-art LLM models to guide the analysis, but there’s a lot of other capabilities built in-house that power the experience:

* Secure and isolated per-user code execution environments
* Native connectors for the most common databases
* Code-based ETL, for flexible data pre-processing and transformation
* Support for image generation and CSV export
* Embeddable streaming UI that supports custom theming

We’re building fast and will also soon launch:

* Interactive charts and even more customizable dashboards
* Direct API access to our safe code execution environments and ETL pre-processing features
* Guided assistants, for less technically-savvy users

and much more! Let us know if you’re interested in any of these and we’ll prioritize it for you.

## Get a Demo

The fastest way to get access to Lightski is by [signing up for our waitlist](https://forms.gle/Sj239WNvp5ZTLJGX6) or emailing [founders@lightski.com](mailto:founders@lightski.com)—we’ll help you format your data into a clean schema, and get Lightski embedded in your app within the day. Email us with any questions or feedback!

launches.title: 🛒 Vendora - Ecommerce enablement for grocery
launches.tagline: Vendora is a vertical saas platform that enables grocers to earn more revenue and better manage their operations online.
launches.body:
Hey all! I’m Sunny, the founder of [Vendora](https://www.vendora.io/).

**tl;dr** At Vendora, we build vertical saas for the grocery industry - today we focus on e-commerce enablement, helping grocers make the most of their digital channels. Think of us as Shopify Meets Toast for supermarkets.  

### Problem

A monumental $800B grocery industry runs on outdated systems and manual processes. In an age where 12% of grocery sales have gone online, many grocers are getting left behind, lacking the tools to adapt and make the most of this emerging channel. Grocers need to adapt to compete with the Amazon and Walmarts of the world.

### Solution

Vendora is solving this problem by being the one platform grocers need to engage with customers digitally. We make it easy for them to succeed online. 

By connecting with their existing stack, we ingest their data, augment it through our AI powered workflows, and set up accurate, enhanced data feeds to their third parties. We also give them their own storefront (website and app) so they can own more of the customer relationship. Along with all this, we give them the tools to easily manage these channels, optimize their performance, and engage with their customers.  

### Who am I?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74433&key=user_uploads/1224770/f850f527-6a20-494e-be39-33fa37d566cb)

I’ve quite literally have been in the grocery space for my entire life. 

I grew up in grocery stores, working in my family’s supermarkets, seeing it go from a single 500 sq ft family store in Queens, NY to a chain of stores. I’ve seen it all first hand (stocking, the register, backoffice, you name it). 

Professionally, I was the Head of US Strategy at Uber Grocery coming in through Uber’s acquisition of Cornershop, where I earned my startup stripes. I began my career at Amazon's US Grocery team, worked on ops for Amazon Fresh, and then the Search Science and AI team. I’ve seen how some of the best companies on the planet run things and I’m channeling that expertise into Vendora. 

### Ask

Know any grocers that want to start selling online or earn even more on existing channels? Send them our way. [founders@vendora.io](mailto:founders@vendora.io)

South Asians in the US are the highest earning and fastest growing ethnic demographic - yet there are few shopping experiences that cater specifically to them. Jaldi is building the first-class e-commerce experience for the South Asian diaspora. The next wave in retail will be cultural commerce, how communities shop and interact with what they buy. launches.title: 👓 SpecCheck - Unifying how the optical industry does business
launches.tagline: We help eye doctors submit & track Rx orders, pay bills, notify patients, and more.
launches.body:
**_Tl;dr:_** _SpecCheck is an all-in-one solution that provides accurate prescription eyewear ordering and tracking, seamless billing, and streamlined communication between patients, eye doctors, and their lab partners. SpecCheck’s users work more efficiently and make fewer costly errors, increasing productivity and improving their overall workflow._

Hello, World! We’re Joe DeMaria and Arnold Villatoro, the co-founders of [SpecCheck](http://www.speccheckrx.com). Together with our team of industry experts and seasoned software engineers, we’re on a mission to revolutionize the optical industry.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69528&key=user_uploads/1251063/d58a9c75-3474-4b78-a5af-978c0f8eea1c)

_Co-founders Joe DeMaria and Arnold Villatoro_

### **❌ The Problem: Current optical industry software sucks!**

Did you know it takes a coordinated team of eye doctors, opticians, technicians, and an optical lab to successfully dispense a _single pair_ of prescription eyeglasses? Despite this complex balancing act, each of these groups are forced to use antiquated technology and systems built in the 1990s that are fragmented, outdated, and limited to specific use cases. This results in glasses taking longer than they should to reach the patient, and results in expensive remakes. Not-so-fun fact: one in ten pairs of glasses needs to be redone before they are ready for pick up.

### 😎 **The Solution: SpecCheck**

SpecCheck is a unified ordering, billing, and communications platform designed specifically for the optical industry. Our solution centralizes all processes involved in the purchasing and manufacturing of prescription eyewear, saving time and reducing costly errors. Some of our features include: 

* **✨ Modern Dashboard:** Our simple and intuitive dashboard appeals to both new and veteran eye doctors.
* **👓 Order Entry:** The easiest way for eye doctors to electronically transmit eyewear orders to optical laboratories, with advanced data validations to reduce errors.
* **💳 Payments Processing:** Doctors can conveniently pay lab invoices directly from our platform.
* **💬 Customer Service Live Chat:** Communicate more efficiently with optical labs to check order statuses, make edits, and request additional information.
* **🔔 Patient Notifications & Tracking:** Keep patients in the know with one-click order notifications and our self-service patient order tracker.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69528&key=user_uploads/1251063/7a550fda-8c41-49eb-8cf3-c4478ff946f1)

_SpecCheck’s Dashboard_

### **⭐ Why Us?**

[Joe](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joe-demaria-15a15943/) began his career in the optical industry in 2012, working as an optician for several different offices. In 2016 he was recruited to work for a key industry player, Shamir Insight, and afterwards for Johnson & Johnson Vision as a sales executive. As he traversed the industry in various roles, Joe realized that thousands of other eye doctors and optical labs were suffering from the same problems and frustrations he had encountered during his career. 

When Joe approached his friend [Arnold](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arnold-villatoro-85629330/) about creating a new technology resource to unify the fragmented optical industry, Arnold was quick to see the vision (pun intended). Arnold’s career started at Workday building the infrastructure for an internal job scheduler. Most recently, Arnold was the lead staff engineer for the payments infrastructure and processing teams at Lyft. With his diverse experience designing scalable and easy-to-use technology solutions for millions of users, Joe and Arnold make the perfect co-founding team.

### 🙏 **Our Asks**

* **📣 Sharing:** Share this post with your network, and follow us on [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/speccheck)!
* **➡️ Referrals:** Connect us with any family, friends, or colleagues who work in the optical industry. 
* **🖥️ Product Demos:** If you’re in the industry and would like to learn more about [SpecCheck](https://www.speccheckrx.com/), please [contact us today](https://www.speccheckrx.com/contact).
* **🚀 Investors:** Please reach out to us at [investors@speccheckrx.com](mailto:investors@speccheckrx.com) to discuss investment opportunities.

We are Ian and Jacob, and we are on a mission to modernize code reviews. Sign up for the alpha on [**HeyPierre.app**](http://heypierre.app/)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69619&key=user_uploads/46928/b1f1d6e0-88b1-4a2e-b17c-0d5982d2543d)

Jacob (CEO) and Ian (CTO) met as early engineers at Twitter 14 years ago.

Jacob is the co-creator of Bootstrap (one of the largest and most popular open source communities on GitHub) and later went on to work as one of the first engineers at Medium. Ian was the first intern at Twitter, dropping out of college at 19 to TL the Twitter platform team.

Jacob and Ian co-founded a mobile app called Bumpers in 2016, which was eventually acquired by Coinbase. For the next 5 years, they led the Product Platform team at Coinbase and were the company-wide web and mobile DRIs.

### Github doesn’t solve today’s biggest engineering problems

In the decade+ since Github was built, tools that prioritize real time collaboration and discussion (Figma, Notion, and Linear) have exploded in popularity, but the circa-2006 code review experience hasn’t materially changed.

We’re building a new way to review code, and we’re starting with pull requests. As engineers with more than 15 years of experience, we’ve seen firsthand how cumbersome a pull request review is using Github — often, pull requests lack necessary context, take too long to approve, and cannot be viewed by non-engineers for feedback. Github’s comment features make it difficult to manage a conversation over time, and discussion is lost when engineers switch to Slack or Hangouts.

### Your code, conversations, and collaborators. Together.

Pierre enables engineers to shape the way that their code is reviewed. We’re starting with two of the biggest problems that engineers have:

1. How do you set better context?
2. How do you better manage discussions?

We’re taking features of the products you love most — the organized chats of iMessage, the real time collaboration of Figma, and the narrative structure of Notion — and we’re bringing it to code reviews.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69619&key=user_uploads/46928/2f0b02fe-d44b-4605-a704-f66aa7736c4f)

Using Pierre, code review creators can:

* Set context next to the code
* Reorganize diffs intuitively
* Break up large pull requests into digestible bites

And code reviewers can:

* Be anyone — no more waiting for the bug bash to get design and product feedback
* Comment on anything — code, images or text
* Conduct real-time conversations right next to the code
* Get up-to-speed on changes more quickly

### Why we built Pierre

We’ve been intimately using GitHub since it’s inception (Ian’s user id is #91). There’s been a lot to love about GitHub over the years, but innovation on the core experience is lagging and other pieces of our toolchain are making us expect more. This is only exasperated by Ian living in NYC and Jacob in SF.

Engineers deserve a realtime, collaborative software platform optimized for productivity - instead of a slow, feed-based social network for coding.

### Try Pierre Out!

* Head to [**HeyPierre.app**](http://heypierre.app/) and sign up for our waitlist. We’re in closed alpha, but we can’t wait for you to try us out.
* We’re looking for a handful of fast growing teams (with \~25-50 engineers) to pilot us. If you know a team that could be a good fit, email [rachel@heypierre.app](mailto:rachel@heypierre.app). **Earn a $200 referral bonus for each paying team you bring in.**

launches.tagline: We save patent lawyers hours of time on their slowest and most laborious task - drafting patent applications
launches.body:
**Tl;dr: Vaero is AI software to help patent lawyers work 5x faster. It drafts an entire patent application with AI based on invention information. The software includes a complete platform for patent lawyers to use AI for reviewing patent applications, responding to office actions, and enhancing invention disclosures.**

**🔬 The Problem:**

Patent lawyers spend hours drafting patent applications, which can be dozens and even hundreds of pages long. Patent applications include lots of detailed technical description about inventions in a formalistic way that is slow and laborious to write. Many patent lawyers find writing these technical descriptions to be their least favorite part of the job given that it can be tedious.

Moreover, the time-consuming nature of patent application drafting is also a major business problem for patent attorneys. Budgets per patent application have been on a flat or declining trend over the last two decades due to increased client demands. As a result, patent attorneys find themselves having to write patent applications with a smaller and smaller budget, which has led to increased time pressure. In some firms, patent application drafting has become an unprofitable loss leader that only serves to retain clients for more profitable legal services.

In addition to drafting patent applications, patent attorneys also deal with large volumes of documents in the other parts of their job. They often have to analyze long patent documents; they have to respond to patent application rejections from the patent office, which can be dozens of pages long; and they have to work with varying levels of invention information, which range from a few sentences to entire manuscripts.

**🪄 The Solution:**

Vaero is AI software built specifically for patent lawyers to speed up their patent drafting and other daily tasks:

* Vaero drafts an entire patent application using AI based on the same inputs that patent lawyers use
* Patent applications are written to the highest legal standards, based on our CEO’s ten years as a patent lawyer including at one of the biggest U.S. law firms
* Automatically review existing patent applications to assist with legal analysis
* Enhance invention disclosures from inventors

**⭐️ Why us?**

We are [Bryant](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bryant-lee/) and [Earl](https://www.linkedin.com/in/earlhathaway/), 2nd time founders whose prior startups have collectively raised $80M+.

He was a patent lawyer at Covington & Burling, one of the biggest law firms in the U.S., and graduated from Harvard Law School where he was on the law review. Prior to that he was a Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science at Carnegie Mellon.

launches.body:
### _TL; DR,_

1. _Customers connect all data sources (CRM, ads, web, and product analytics…) to HockeyStack to create a source of truth for customer engagements. No engineering work required._
2. _HockeyStack shows which channels, campaigns, content, segments, etc. drive the most revenue and active customers._
3. _HockeyStack creates lists of high-intent accounts that customers can use to launch the most efficient sales & marketing campaigns._

We’re Arda, Buğra, and Emir. We came from Turkey & dropped out of our first semester of college in the US to build [HockeyStack](https://www.hockeystack.com/?utm_source=launchyc), because we realized that every single B2B enterprise has the same exact #1 problem.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73647&key=user_uploads/307556/5a0ce469-00e7-416a-8af0-ba3a7b9f0718)

### Problem

Revenue-facing teams in B2B companies run all their operations on customer data, whether it is managing an advertising budget, launching integrated campaigns, closing deals, or retaining customers. But there is no central system of record for customer data that they can use to run their operations, so instead, they rely on tens of different data tools and spreadsheets.

The CRM was built for this purpose, but over 20 years it got outdated, and companies found themselves either having to find hacks to format their data to fit the CRM, or build a data warehouse from scratch.

### Solution

HockeyStack collects all data about customer interactions through a web analytics script, a set of integrations to revenue-related business systems (CRM, ads, marketing automation, email, etc.), and data partners.

Any non-technical person in a B2B company can use HockeyStack’s reporting interface to answer complex questions like:

* What marketing channel had the best unit economics this quarter?
* Which segment of companies do we have the highest account penetration in?
* What makes a customer buy our software faster?
* Who are the highest intent companies who have not yet booked a demo with us?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73647&key=user_uploads/307556/d86c6313-72ee-42ce-9500-4875f29a8a3b)

They click into the numbers, and can see a list of accounts behind the report, all of which have their entire history of engagement with the company displayed alongside important firmographics.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73647&key=user_uploads/307556/25f109b6-83e0-44d3-bb45-3a5ae267d2de)

This information can be used to create and export lists of high-intent accounts based on different segmentations out to various marketing and sales platforms to start or accelerate the sales conversation.

### **🙏 Ask**

We’d love to be introduced to marketing and sales leaders at B2B enterprises or scale-ups!

### 🤲 **Give**

We’d be happy to help any B2B founder with advice in generating inbound pipeline.

You can reach me at [bugra@hockeystack.com](mailto:bugra@hockeystack.com) or [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bgrgndzz/).

launches.tagline: Effortlessly extract web data at scale.
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** Reworkd automates your entire web data pipeline, end-to-end. It understands websites, writes code, runs scrapers, and validates results — all from one simple system. Today, we're excited to launch our self-serve tool!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88460&key=user_uploads/1285282/a0cd569c-51bc-4eba-9b2c-ad3f5472ddea)

# **😩 The Problem**

Collecting, monitoring, and maintaining a web data pipeline can be complex and time-consuming, especially at scale. Traditional methods often struggle with issues such as pagination, dynamic content, bot detection, and site changes—all of which can compromise data quality and availability.

To address web data needs, businesses are often faced with either building out an internal engineering team or outsourcing to a low-cost country. The former can be expensive, while the latter is often unsustainable and requires significant management oversight.

# **🚀 The Solution:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88460&key=user_uploads/1285282/1704dcda-c244-4f12-8812-c249b5a86829)

Recognizing the inefficiencies of traditional data collection methods, we have built a platform to provide co-pilot experience for scraping. Simply provide a list of websites along with your unified schema, and our platform automatically generates custom Playwright code for each site. You’re not locked into a black-box solution—you have full control to guide, tweak, or completely rewrite the code in our built-in IDE as needed.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88460&key=user_uploads/1285282/97652937-38a3-42ff-8c2c-9d7db6a852b2)

In addition, our platform offers:

* **Real-Time Dashboard:** Monitor your scraping projects in real-time. Track outputs, scraper failures, unique results, visited pages, website review status, file downloads, and more.
* **Scheduling and Deduplication:** Run scrapers at your desired frequency, choose between full or incremental scraping, and deduplicate data based on a primary key.
* **Bypass Anti-Bots:** We manage all proxy and anti-bot measures—including captcha solving and diverse proxy setups—so you never have to worry about managing residential, data center, or other proxy types.
* **Complex Data Types**: We take care of downloading and hosting files, ensuring data availability even as source websites evolve.
* **Seamless API Integration:** Easily ingest your scraped data through our API.

# **🙏 Our Ask**

* [**Support our Product Hunt Launch**](https://www.producthunt.com/)!
* **Share Reworkd** with anyone you know who is facing challenges in scaling their web data pipeline.

launches.body:
**tl;dr:** _Reworkd AI connects businesses to AI Agent automation. With an easy-to-use, no-code platform, Reworkd AI allows companies to eliminate tedious, repetitive tasks and accelerate their operations with AI Agents, all while integrating seamlessly with their existing tech stack._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73151&key=user_uploads/1285282/8c2f25ca-0406-47ae-af27-7f23a35cc45d)

Hello folks 👋 We’re the team behind Reworkd AI.

Initially our team developed AgentGPT, a web based platform for AI Agents which quickly attracted **150K monthly active users** and **25K ⭐️ on GitHub** in the last three months.

As we built out this platform, we noticed a growing trend: businesses were increasingly seeking automation through AI Agents.

### **❌ The Problem**

Today, the core of many business are comprised of **tasks that require time consuming and manual human intervention**. With the rise of AI Agents, many companies are turning to them to automate these processes in a way that existing workflow tools cannot. In building AgentGPT however, we realized that AI Agents could not handle business-critical processes due to the following problems:

* **Hallucination:** AI Agents make up information not grounded in any facts.
* **Unproductive loops/repetition:** AI Agents struggle to understand the current context of a task, leading to unproductive loops.
* **Probability of failure:** Each prompt completion has a certain probability of failure which only compounds with long-running agents.

### ⭐️ **Our Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73151&key=user_uploads/1285282/56351169-49c6-4eb4-bad1-efa723afe74e)

Our platform solves these issues by **coupling AI Agents with a structured workflow system**. This enables businesses to formalize and codify their core processes in a verifiably correct way while still enabling AI Agents to reason about the nuances of a problem.

As an example, one B2B customer in our pilot program vends data to over 30,000 different customers. They’ve leveraged Reworkd to create a workflow that runs an AI Agent through each customer’s website, validating that they are compliant against a set of unstructured rules. Based on these results, the platform will automatically follow up with their customer. This process previously took **an entire department and weeks of manual intervention.** Leveraging our platform, they’ve automated this process to only take a few hours.

### 👥 **The Team**

[Asim Shrestha](https://www.linkedin.com/in/a-shrestha/) **(CEO)**: Former AWS software engineer specializing in internal backend services within RDS. Contributed to ML pipelines and open source ML projects at BC Cancer Research.

[Adam Watkins](https://www.linkedin.com/in/awtkns/) **(CTO)**: Former software engineer at Article specializing in fulfillment logistics optimization. Worked in AI/ML at BC Cancer Research, developing ML deployment infrastructure for clinical nuclear medicine applications.

[Srijan Subedi](https://www.linkedin.com/in/srijansubedi/) **(COO)**: Former program associate at Stemcell Technologies with the New Product Introduction team. Conducted research at The Centre for Heart Lung Innovation (HLI) focused on biologic therapy for individuals with severe asthma.

## 🙌 **Our Ask**

* If you or anyone you know is keen on leveraging AI agents to automate business workflows, [please sign up for our waitlist](https://6h6bquxo5g1.typeform.com/to/qscfsOf1) 😁
* Have a tedious task you'd want to automate but don’t know if its possible? Email us at [founders@reworkd.ai](mailto:founders@reworkd.ai). We relish challenges and will explore solutions for you!

launches.body:
### **The Problem**

* [**Search queries are becoming more conversational**](https://blog.branch-ai.com/second-order-effects-of-ai-search-from-keywords-to-intent-63b3b9fa20e8) (ChatGPT effect). However, most Ecommerce retailers & brands still use keyword search tools resulting in lost revenue for tail queries.
* Search providers give you tools to build search engines, **but leave relevance engineering up to you** (i.e. tuning of the search).
* Tuning search to maximize conversions is [**complicated & expensive**](https://blog.branch-ai.com/what-it-takes-to-build-effective-search-8a2901a9a943) (involves stitching together embeddings, rankers, NLP models, heuristics & annotated feedback).
* DIY embeddings and models are easy to experiment with. But building **production-grade deployments requires catalog-specific tuning**, which can unlock 20-30% better accuracy & conversions.

### **The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78740&key=user_uploads/31801/a4c105e8-a6a6-41f0-977c-e09de9b09233)

**Step 1 - Upload/Connect Catalog:** Upload a list of products or connect to an existing search database or platform (e.g. Elastic or Shopify).

**Step 2 - LLM-powered Tuning**: This happens under the hood automatically. We use LLMs to train catalog-specific embeddings, rankers & query rewriters, bootstrapped from our proprietary Ecommerce-specific models.

**Step 3 - AI APIs**: With zero effort, businesses get:

1. _Search API_: Query → Ranked Products (for end-to-end query rewriting, hybrid retrieval & reranking)
2. _Query Understanding API_: User Query → Catalog-Aware Query (for DIY query expansion/relaxation)
3. _Embeddings API_: Query or Product → Catalog-specific Embedding (for DIY retrieval)
4. _Reranking API_: Candidate Products → Re-ordered Products (for DIY precision improvements)

**Step 4 - Preferences**: Users can control search behavior using:

* _Merchandising Strategies:_ Execute smart strategies using simple instruction templates (e.g. “boost Apple Vision Pros to visitors looking for gifts”)
* _Feedback:_ Demonstrate examples of preferred search results (models learn from these “few-shot”)
* _Maintenance Jobs:_ LLMs periodically evaluate search results (e.g. for queries with zero results) and produce training data to fix gaps

### **Our Ask**

* If you want a better search with lower effort for your Ecommerce store, contact us via [email](mailto:govind@branch-ai.com) or [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/govindchandrasekhar/).
* If you’d like a free evaluation of your site search, submit a request [on our website](https://www.branch-ai.com).

### **About Us**

* [Govind](https://www.linkedin.com/in/govindchandrasekhar/) was previously co-founder of [Semantics3](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/semantics3) (YC W13), an Ecommerce catalog AI company, from 2011 to 2020.
* Govind & [Praveen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/praveens07/) (founding engineer) built embeddings, rankers, and transformer-based sequence models at Twitter that directly drove 1MM+ DAUs.
* [Ishan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ishanagrawal/) was CTO at Funding Societies, the largest digital financing Fintech in Southeast Asia, where he built and scaled the technology and business from Seed to Series D.

### **Our Vision**

To serve as an Ecommerce AI platform for brands and retailers. We already see that our models do better than mainstream alternatives at out-of-domain tasks like recommendations, assortment curation, insight extraction (from query text), marketing content generation (from query text), in-session personalization, and event-based ranking.

# **tl;dr:** Readily helps healthcare organizations stay compliant as requirements become more complex. We connect their policies with regulations, making it drastically easier to find and close gaps.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXctpwpG1HfM12TBrl0_RXm7AOCE4BaRe-5VI_V3OaXJhtS2HRILw_YIdECGRLAeM2kHq-1GF7dfHD5_oeI3QgXS80w4hiJGViuj4YcBAiWb7Dgb3Ld1_BP9Sx1XobQqgRUjNhHNwxgpJRu-wCJMQNEg09BN?key=WOtv3UHkF8eR-G9ONpZmyQ)

# **Problem**

Healthcare organizations face growing backlogs and [**fines of up to $55M**](https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/formsandpubs/publications/oc/Documents/DMHCDHCS-JointPressRelease-LACare-Accusation-030422.pdf). It's getting harder to stay compliant as **requirements increase 30% every year** - many of which are frustratingly vague, leaving staff overworked.

Staff spend hours sifting through 100,000 pages of policies and regulations, finding specific references on how to stay compliant. But as their tasks grow in volume and complexity, **Excel and PDF search just don’t cut it anymore**.

# **Solution**

Readily makes **compliance straightforward** for healthcare organizations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83298&key=user_uploads/318129/784c1efe-98f4-4579-ab1d-57a5f6055010)

We connect their policies with regulations and **surface pertinent information** as their staff conduct research, analyze gaps, or prepare for audits.

> _It used to take me 10 hours to review an All Plan Letter, and a junior staff twice as long. This saved me hours!” - Manager, Regulatory Affairs_

For any new requirement, we identify which departments, policies, and procedures are impacted and **what actions are needed to stay compliant**. This saves them hours of work and helps prevent costly violations.

Share Readily with anyone you know in facing similar challenges keeping up with healthcare compliance or reach out to us (founders@readily.co). We'd love to help.

launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Asad](https://www.linkedin.com/in/asadsdar/) and [Daniel](https://linkedin.com/in/daniel-ruiz-a73818aa) from [Synch](https://www.withsynch.com/)!\
[ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PiHGtnI5qps)

# What is Synch?

Synch is a unified sales platform for both your Sales and Sales Ops teams. We work out of the box with Salesforce with no implementation time required.

# **The World Today**

Revenue tech is incredibly fragmented. Almost everyone uses Salesforce, but they don’t build auxiliary products well. This has led to a long tail of point-solution companies that only handle tiny portions of the sales team’s workflows. You buy one product for forecasting, one for pipeline management, another for lead routing, etc.

Additionally, even though all these point solutions pull customer data from a common spot (Salesforce), none of them "talk to each other."

We are building a company that gives you each of those SKUs while also giving you the tools to manage your SFDC environment. We want you to spend less time worrying about your tools and systems and more time worrying about your leads and prospects.

In our previous roles, it became increasingly clear that more time was spent on non-revenue generating activities than selling. Sales leadership spends an inordinate amount of time managing their tech stack, evaluating new vendors, and training their team on using tools - all at the expense of closing deals. 

# **Our Solution**

**For your Sales team**, we offer many different SKUs with a shared analytics suite so leaders can spend less time evaluating multiple vendors. Today, we offer forecasting, deal review, pipeline management, alerts, lead assignment, and other features that require zero implementation time. We share data between these products so information from our dashboarding tool (AE demo conversion rates) can automatically adjust your round-robin setup in your lead routing tool — "Turn my round robin into a 55-45 in favor of Tommy because he has a better close rate over the last two weeks", as an example.

**On the SalesOps side**, we provide you with tools to manage and maintain your SFDC instance. You can turn plain-text inputs into built-out Apex Code or flows, get robust dashboards with only a few clicks, and manage your Salesforce schema without ever needing to go into Salesforce.

**All of this works out of the box with SFDC. Just SSO & Go.**

**Ask**

[Feel free to grab time directly on my calendar here](https://calendly.com/danielsynch) if you want to learn more, or check out our blog post: [https://www.withsynch.com/blog/announcing-synch.](https://www.withsynch.com/blog/announcing-synch)

Hey everyone! We’re Asad Dar and Daniel Ruiz from [Magik](https://www.usemagik.com/)!

Magik automates Salesforce workflows and data reports using AI, allowing you to get insights from and build your CRM in a fraction of the time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73639&key=user_uploads/1124702/5bcc28c8-1998-4ebe-bcec-6a22a31ab085)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73639&key=user_uploads/1124702/846cf470-60c1-47cf-b404-a5d6e28988b2)

# **Why we built Magik**

Salesforce is complicated!\
CRMs and the customer data inside are essential for companies, yet most people don’t have experience with them. 

Junction objects, validation rules, and record-triggered flows sound confusing, and founders are intimidated. As a result, they turn to individuals with Salesforce certifications and address the problem in two main ways:

1. Hire a consultancy firm for $100-$200/hr. 
   1.  Your company hires an expensive consultant with misaligned incentives on how quickly the work should get done.
2. Hire an FTE

**Both of these solutions are slow to implement and expensive to maintain.**

# **Our Solution**

We leverage GPT models to streamline, simplify, and automate Salesforce workflows so that anyone can do the work of an expert-level RevOps employee. Our product allows users to build in Salesforce 15-25X quicker than before and receive recommendations they can automatically enable.

# **How does it work?**

* 🔗 **Connect** - Use Salesforce SSO to connect your environment to Magik.
* 📩 **Get Recommendations** - Once connected, Magik will make suggestions based on the event data in your environment.
* ✅ **Take action** -  Use natural language to describe your desired actions, and let Magik build them for you. Whether pulling data queries, automating workflows, or creating data visualizations, Magik helps you get it done in a fraction of the time.

If you currently use Salesforce or are considering it in the future, we could save you a significant amount of time and money 🙂, and ensure your CRM setup is perfect for your business.

You can email [founders@usemagik.com](mailto:founders@usemagik.com) for more information, grab time for a demo [here](https://calendly.com/danielmagik), and check out our [website](https://www.usemagik.com/).

name: Alguna
long_description:
We are Alguna, building a modern platform that helps B2B companies price deals, send quotes, bill customers, and collect payments - all in one place.

Our mission is to create the most efficient revenue engine for B2B SaaS.

Today, many companies run these processes with spreadsheets and a patchwork of separate tools. That leads to slow approvals, manual work, mistakes, and missed revenue—especially as pricing gets more complex.

Alguna replaces that mess by connecting the entire flow from **quote to cash**: what sales sells becomes what finance bills, automatically. We help teams automate invoicing, handle usage-based or custom pricing, and reduce back-and-forth between sales, finance, and engineering.

The result: growth-stage startups and enterprises can close deals faster, bill accurately, and scale revenue operations without adding headcount or building internal systems.
one_liner: AI-Native CPQ & Billing for Modern Pricing Models

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
**What is the core problem that Alguna solves?**

B2B companies struggle to turn what sales sells into what finance can reliably bill and collect.

Pricing, quoting, contracts, usage, invoicing, and payments often live in different tools—and the “glue” is spreadsheets, manual approvals, and one-off engineering work. As soon as a company introduces custom terms (discounts, ramps, multi-year deals, usage-based pricing, credits, multi-entity billing), the process breaks down: quotes don’t match invoices, billing becomes manual, and finance is stuck cleaning up exceptions every month.

Alguna solves this by providing a single platform that unifies **pricing, CPQ, billing, invoicing, payments, usage metering, and collections automation** into one **quote-to-revenue** system.

**Why is this a big problem?**

Because revenue operations scale poorly when the infrastructure is fragmented.

The impact is measurable:

\- **Revenue leakage:** missed invoices, incorrect pricing, unbilled usage, and manual errors compound over time.

\- **Slower deal cycles:** approvals and “can we even bill this?” questions delay closing.

\- **High operational cost:** finance and revops teams spend their time reconciling systems instead of controlling revenue.

\- **Engineering dependency:** product teams get pulled into custom billing logic, integrations, and edge cases.

\- **Harder forecasting and reporting:** when the source of truth is scattered, finance cannot trust the numbers.

As more companies adopt **usage-based**, **hybrid**, and **AI-driven** pricing models, the gap between modern monetization and legacy revenue stacks keeps widening.

**What made you decide to work on it?**

We saw the same pattern across fast-growing B2B teams: the product and go-to-market motion moves quickly, but the revenue stack stays stuck in old systems built for simpler subscriptions.

Teams end up running “mission-critical revenue” on spreadsheets and disconnected tools—because replacing them is painful, and building in-house is expensive and distracting. Yet the cost of doing nothing is continuous: every custom deal creates more manual work, more risk, and more leakage.

Alguna exists to modernize that foundation. We’re building the revenue management engine B2B companies need to sell flexibly, bill accurately, and scale without chaos—by unifying the quote-to-revenue lifecycle and automating the back office.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
We will know Alguna succeeded when **B2B monetization stops being a patchwork of spreadsheets, PDFs, and disconnected tools**—and becomes a single, programmable revenue engine that companies can run with speed, precision, and confidence.

The world today is stuck with legacy revenue stacks that were built for simpler subscription businesses. Meanwhile, selling is changing fast: companies sell across **PLG (self-serve), SLG (custom quotes), and enterprise procurement**, pricing models are shifting toward **usage, hybrid, credits, and outcome-based**, and deep integrations + two-way sync across systems are becoming table stakes. In that environment, “good enough” billing and CPQ breaks down.

Alguna’s vision is to become the **one source of truth for revenue**—the system that orchestrates pricing, quoting, contracting, usage, billing, invoicing, payments, and collections end-to-end.\
\
What will be different about the world

**1) Revenue operations becomes “real-time” and automated**

* Quotes turn into clean billing schedules automatically.
* Usage becomes billable without manual reconciliation.
* Invoices and collections run with far fewer human interventions.
* Finance teams stop doing back-office cleanup as a permanent job.

**2) Pricing evolves as quickly as the market**

* Teams can run pricing experiments safely across channels.
* Guardrails and approvals are built-in, not enforced by spreadsheets.
* Companies avoid pricing drift, one-off logic, and costly exceptions.

**3) Selling becomes faster, with less internal friction**

* Sales can confidently sell complex deals without engineering dependency.
* Deal desks can scale without becoming a bottleneck.
* Enterprise flexibility is supported without creating operational chaos.

**4) Businesses scale with smaller teams and higher reliability**

* A 10-person team can grow rapidly without inheriting a brittle revenue stack.
* Forecasting becomes more trustworthy because the underlying system is consistent.
* Revenue leakage becomes the exception, not the norm.

# **📝 TL;DR:**

> [Alguna](https://alguna.io) is a modern pricing, quoting, and billing platform for B2B SaaS. Companies use it to unify the quote-to-revenue process by automating complex and manual back-office operations. [Book a demo](https://alguna.io) to learn more.

# **❌ Problem**

As companies grow, they want to offer more customized deals to their larger customers, capture data around product usage, forecast revenue, and experiment with pricing. As they scale, instead of graduating to better tools, they default to using spreadsheets and manual processes to connect single-point solutions.

After interviewing over 100 company leaders, we’ve seen what consequences information siloes and fragmented solutions can have on the companies’ growth trajectories. \
From light issues like hiring people to copy/paste data between systems to fundamental ones like not trusting your revenue data or asking your customers to tell you how much they used your product.

> _In times of growth at all costs, companies could’ve turned a blind eye to these imperfect workflows; however, as 2023 loomed over the whole SaaS world, these revenue-impacting inefficiencies represent the line between company survival and the slow death of running out of money without even realizing it._

# ✅ **How Alguna works**

Our core premise is to enable our customers (growth-stage startups and enterprises) to flexibly close more deals faster without worrying about internal limitations and relying on finance and engineering teams.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76099&key=user_uploads/1225753/9b1a2f85-6a49-4420-8839-23d7193526fa)

> We’ve built **an end-to-end solution** covering the whole customer lifecycle while **complementing** existing **sales** (CRMs), **finance** (ERPs/Accounting), and **engineering** tools.

**Configure pricing & create custom quotes**

* Set up pricing and packaging across all sales channels while supporting any pricing model (including subscriptions, usage-based, platform fees, etc.)
* Create the most customizable plan options with custom product billing options, one-off integration fees, special discounts, and complex renewal terms.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76099&key=user_uploads/1225753/d5c62cfa-bb64-45bd-b544-4ff878cbc363)

**Streamline the contract signature flow**\
Alguna provides an embedded signature experience directly from the proposal you send customers. This is then automatically connected to tools upstream (CRMs) and downstream (ERPs), enabling the cohesive external (prospects/customers) and internal experience.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76099&key=user_uploads/1225753/f722da69-f9ef-4655-be51-676d57731dbb)

**Seamless and reliable invoicing experience**\
Since the pricing models and quotes are natively integrated, everything is automatically connected with the billing engine, enabling the accurate and reliable customer billing experience directly via Alguna or ERP tools of your choice (Stripe Invoicing, Netsuite, Xero, Quickbooks, Bill)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76099&key=user_uploads/1225753/8802ecb0-928d-4ff8-9bf2-d6593fae75a3)

**Source of truth for revenue metrics** \
Empower sales and customer success teams with usage data to drive more revenue and unlock new upsell opportunities with real-time revenue data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76099&key=user_uploads/1225753/f34387fc-134a-471f-bba3-0d38d1e992f8)

# **🏟️ Why us**

We ([@Jamie MacLeod](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jamie-macleod/) & [@Aleks Đekić](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aleksdjekic/)) met at a fintech startup where we helped scale the payments and automation teams and products. While trying to launch new products, we experienced this problem firsthand and decided to solve it once and for all. Previously, [@Aleks](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aleksdjekic/) led the product development of internal tools _just like_ Alguna for a 600-person commercial team at one of Europe's fastest-growing payment processing companies.

launches.title: Agentive—Audit Requests Clients Love
launches.tagline: Meet Agentive, the AI Workspace for Auditing and Client Collaboration.
launches.body:
**TL;DR** Agentive completely redesigned document requests to eliminate confusion and unnecessary busy work—reducing client rework by 25% and streamlining audits. Uploaded documents become AI-drafted workpapers aligned with your firm’s templates, cutting review time by 90%.\
<https://youtu.be/7V5hTATJm3E>

# **Improving the client-auditor relationship, one request at a time**

The toughest part of an audit isn’t issuing the opinion—it’s getting the right documents on time. Existing solutions still confuse clients, require significant training, and lead to re-work that strains relationships. Agentive set out to change this by making document requests seamless and user-friendly.

# **The current frustration**

Requesting documents (often called a PBC list – “Provided By Client” list) can be a nightmare:

1. **Confusing User Interface:**
   * Clients often need training just to see what’s outstanding and upload a document.
2. **Unorganized Sample Requests:**
   * For example, a client might receive a request with an Excel file listing 25 expenses, each expense needing multiple pieces of evidence (like invoices and bank statements).
   * They must gather and upload all evidence into an unorganized folder. This disorganization leads to many mistakes and re-work that can be prevented.
   * Auditors often take days—or even weeks—to review documents provided by the client; they must match each file to its correct item in the sample. Any missing or incorrect evidence requires re-work from the client.
3. **Constant Follow-Ups & Strained Relationships:**
   * Every missing document adds friction, but the longer it takes for clients to learn about mistakes, the more pain it causes.
   * Hours are lost chasing missing documents, leaving clients feeling nagged and auditors drained.

This **painful status quo** has been accepted as “just part of auditing” for far too long. Clients dread it, and firms worry that each request for info might annoy their client. The result? A process that should be straightforward often drags on with frustration on both sides.

# **The purpose-built solution**

What if providing audit evidence required zero training—and even felt satisfying? Enter Agentive’s new request flow, purpose-built to eliminate friction in auditing.

1. **Request with Samples**
   * **Native Itemized Requests:** Instead of downloading an Excel file to view the items in the sample, Agentive natively integrates the sample table into the request.
   * **Precise Uploads:** Clients attach specific evidence at the intersection of each sample row and document request column—eliminating guesswork and simplifying review.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88440&key=user_uploads/1097859/c3416ec7-7d91-4d2f-a49e-bd39a4474dbe)

2. **Engagement Board View**
   * **Instant Visibility:** Both auditors and clients see requests by status and category at a glance with drag and drop updates.
   * **Satisfaction:** Clients enjoy checking off completed items, ensuring everyone knows what’s done and what’s outstanding.
3. **Auditor Review Improvements**
   * **Flexible Upload**: Whether clients upload files one-by-one or in bulk, AI matches each document to the correct sample item—even in multi-page scans.
   * **Instant Citations**: Every value is automatically located within uploaded documents, with one-click navigation to its exact location.
   * **90% Faster Review**: AI-powered matching, detail testing, and analysis, let auditors quickly spot missing or insufficient documentation, slashing follow-up time with client.

Imagine your next audit kickoff: your client opens Agentive and says, **“Oh, this is nice!”** Instead of groans and procrastination, they begin right away—confident about what you need. Each step is transparent and even rewarding as they see their progress. What once felt like pulling teeth becomes a smooth collaboration.

# **Available Now: AI-Drafted Audit Procedures**

**In this post, our focus is on you and your clients**, and making sure the foundation of every audit – collaborating with the client – is as smooth and organized as possible. As former auditors, we’re equally dedicated to improving auditor job satisfaction. We do this by listening to you, our users, and solving your problems with **human-centered design** and **artificial intelligence.** Every document uploaded in a client request can easily be transformed into your firm’s audit workpaper template through our **AI-powered** document matching and AI prompts. We’re incredibly proud these workflows are set up in a few clicks and workpapers are ready for review in less than a minute after every client upload.

# **Ready to Delight Your Clients?**

[**Schedule a demo**](https://goagentive.com/) or email [founders@goagentive.com](mailto:founders@goagentive.com) to see how Agentive can elevate your firm for both clients and auditors.

launches.title: Agentive: AI-powered copilot for auditors
launches.tagline: We help accountants analyze financial records, perform audit procedures, and draft documentation in seconds.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Agentive.

**TL;DR** Agentive helps auditors unlock growth by shortening the time to perform audits. Auditors use our AI-powered copilot to analyze financial records, perform audit procedures, and draft documentation with 10x efficiency. If you’re an auditor, get in touch at [goagentive.com](http://goagentive.com)!

**Problem**

Audit staff spend 40% of their time searching, extracting, and manipulating data during audit procedures. And another 20% is spent preparing audit documentation. While it’s gotten easier to work with evidence provided by clients over the years thanks to OCR and other semi-automation solutions, it’s still painful. These audit procedures are rather standardized across clients and documentation is often identical year over year at the same client with only the current year data changing. The desire of audit staff to be involved in audit strategy is often in conflict with the amount of manual work that needs to be done at firms. This contributes to the high turnover in audit staff and the shortage of accountants entering the profession.

**Team**

While working as an auditor at EY, Danny Alberson felt underutilized due to the repetitive work involved in auditing. Nathan Turnbow, co-founder and CTO, built the first AI-powered education platform at Imagine Learning and honed his risk expertise as a cyber security engineer at Dell. Jason Draper, technical co-founder, led teams as an officer in the US Air Force and is a second time founder. Together, they're building Agentive to help auditors automate procedures and spend more time on audit strategy.

**Solution**

Agentive addresses this challenge by training large language models that cater to accounting and audit use cases. Agentive provides an in-browser spreadsheet editor and document viewer where auditors use natural language to have Agentive’s copilot analyze evidence, perform procedures, and draft documentation with 10x efficiency. It’s like working with ChatGPT during your audit. To review AI generated data we make it really easy to trace results back to their source. This not only speeds up preparing documents by audit staff but increases the efficiency of management and partner reviews as well.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72821&key=user_uploads/1097859/d436827f-1dd3-4314-a1d3-af9f37364114)

**What can you use Copilot for?**

1. **Extracting Text/Tables**: Extract text and data from documents like PDFs which can then be analyzed or moved to spreadsheets or workpapers for further processing.
2. **Compliance Checking**: Analyze the content of documents to check compliance with various regulations, standards, or policies, and provide reports detailing any areas of non-compliance.
3. **Content Search and Retrieval**: Enables auditors to conduct advanced content searches within documents, including searching for specific phrases, keywords, or patterns and retrieving relevant sections.
4. **Natural Language Querying**: Simplify data retrieval by extracting information from spreadsheets using natural language queries without complex formulas.
5. **Reconciliations**: Validate data within documents by cross-referencing it with other sources, such as spreadsheets, and highlight any discrepancies that require further investigation.
6. **Natural Language Summarization:** Automatically generate concise written summaries of financial data in spreadsheets, helping auditors quickly comprehend key insights without digging through raw data.

**Ask**

We’d love to connect with auditors! Please sign up for a demo at [goagentive.com](http://goagentive.com)

* For smaller teams, basic contract review and contract negotiation services with external counsel can be incredibly expensive and time consuming.
* For larger organizations, in-house counsels are burdened by high matter volumes that often position them as bottlenecks within sales cycles.

### **How is Docsum different?**

* **Extensible**: Currently, we are focused on being the best-in-class legal analysis and contract negotiation tool. We believe we can integrate into your existing contract life cycle processes.

* **💪🏽 Collaborative**: We believe that legal teams are essential for creating and preserving value for organizations. Our hope is to enable organizations to engage their legal counsel in a more strategic and efficient manner. We aren’t trying to replace lawyers with AI.

launches.title: Arcimus - AI-powered Insurance Premium Audits
launches.tagline: Arcimus uses a combination of AI and human judgment in the Insurance Premium Audit process leading to high quality, fast, and cheap audits.
launches.body:
**📌 TLDR**: When you hire employees, you’ll need Workers’ Compensation Insurance. The price for this insurance depends on your payroll and employee duties. Since your payroll and employee duties change annually, you’ll go through an audit process to determine the proper amount you should be paying. In the backend, this process is costly and inefficient, and you probably end up underpaying/overpaying. We use a combination of LLMs and human judgment, leading to higher-quality audits at half the price of traditional audit solutions.\
—

Hi everyone, we’re [Hussein](https://linkedin.com/in/hussein-syed-44115a164) and [Omar](https://linkedin.com/in/omar-dadabhoy), and we’re creating [Arcimus](https://www.arcimus.com/)! 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77849&key=user_uploads/977376/187811a1-ef85-43ca-9203-7a8e3eab50b5)

### **📑 Problem:**

Workers' compensation insurance pricing depends on a business’s total payroll and its employees' duties (a roofer is at higher risk of injury than a Software Engineer). However, these factors change as companies hire/fire and change salaries.

Every year, insurance companies contract auditing firms or individual premium auditors to hand review their customers’ information. They report changes in total payroll and employee duties, enabling insurance carriers to assign them a new premium.

This manual process can take auditors 1-3 hours per customer annually and is prone to human error. Insurance carriers are at a high risk of failing state compliance tests and getting fined due to human errors.

### **🤖 Our Solution:**

We use a combination of LLMs and human judgment to read a customer’s documents and compile their information into the same final report created by premium auditors. We can do this within minutes, at half the cost, and with higher accuracy than any singular auditor.

### **📖 Our Story:**

We were originally S23 but decided to demo with W24 because we pivoted mid-batch from AI meeting notes (yeah, we know…). 

We talked to dozens of insurance workers and eventually learned about premium auditors. After talking to \~50 premium auditors, we had an inkling that their processes were ready for innovation. To better understand their jobs, we decided to go back to school in the middle of YC and take a community college class on premium auditing. 

Like any other college experience, we graduated from YC with 9-5 jobs as premium auditors. After working as premium auditors for 3 months, we were able to write code to automate parts of the premium audit process. AI and humans together led to unmatched performance and dramatically less cost, better than any auditor alone.

### **🙏 Our Ask:**

**Are you an insurance carrier or premium audit vendor:** We’d love to meet and see how we could fit into your workflow! Email us! 

**Customer Intros:** If you have contacts at insurance carriers or premium auditing vendors we'd love an introduction to talk to them! Email us!

\
Feel free to reach us at [founders@arcimus.com](mailto:founders@arcimus.com)

Retailers are juggling a lot of internal and market pressures­–inflation, low margins, high turnover, etc. They don’t have the time and resources to stay on top of their entire operations. As a result, we discovered that they can’t keep track of the discrepancies between purchase orders and vendor payments, leading them to routinely overpay their vendors.

Retailers can follow up with the vendor or update the purchase order on their end.

We decided to focus on solving this critical pain point as our initial scope. Our long-term vision is to capture retailers by solving for this problem with a clear business case and expand our product suite to address retailers’ other challenges.

launches.title: Outset - AI-powered user interviews
launches.tagline: Turn weeks of work into (almost) instant insights
launches.body:
**TL;DR** - Getting answers to tough, qualitative questions from your users is extremely costly (in time _and_ money). Outset provides an AI-interviewer that conducts and synthesizes research interviews autonomously. Researchers get large-scale, in-depth data (almost) instantly.

### **Our asks**

* **Early startups: Give us feedback!** [Sign up here](https://outset.ai/login?utm_campaign=launch_yc), and get 50 AI interviews for free.
* **Larger teams: Book a demo!** Researchers or product/design leaders at mid-market or enterprise companies are our sweet spot. Whether you have researchers on your team or have research-oriented friends, we’d love to meet them! [Book a demo here](https://calendly.com/a-a-ron1/outset-demo).

### **Problem**

We’re Aaron and Michael, co-founders of Outset (YC S23).

Today, user and market researchers face an unfortunate tradeoff: do you want FAST insights (surveys) or do you want DEEP insights (interviews)?

We’ve felt this struggle. As a strategy consultant at Deloitte, Aaron facilitated dozens of research projects for Fortune 500 companies. He and his team would spend hundreds of hours on each project just to schedule and moderate a few dozen interviews. And both of us have seen first-hand the need for even faster, deeper user insights at growing software companies.

### **Solution**

Outset gets you both — fast **and** deep insights — with AI-moderated research.

Imagine if you could ask hundreds of people a complex, qualitative question (like ‘What motivates you in your career?’) and get back an actionable synthesis of the answers? Now imagine if you could do that in less than a day…

Our AI-moderated research platform uses GPT-4 to autonomously lead in-depth interviews with participants and analyze results. Designed for high-impact research teams at larger companies, Outset gathers valuable, large-scale qualitative data (almost) instantly, turning weeks of work into hours.

Outset users load up an interview guide, share a link with their participants, and watch AI conduct hundreds of interviews at once. AI follows up with participants to clarify, probes on answers, and creates a conversational rapport where responses get deep.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72213&key=user_uploads/1327240/bab1ab87-3b42-462f-a046-8fbead045dff)

For every question, AI generates themes, tallies up counts, and highlights powerful quotes to uncover the story. What used to be days of dedicated transcript analysis work is now almost instant.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72213&key=user_uploads/1327240/52d11205-52b7-48e9-9c32-a91f35695242)

### **Customer case study**

**With Outset, WeightWatchers put together an interview guide, shared it out, and conducted and synthesized over 100 in-depth interviews in under 24 hours, saving them over a week of work.** The results are now being used to propose a new internal framework for user segmentation.

_“The speed and quality of the responses were both outstanding. I expect Outset will afford my team the opportunity to significantly increase the speed of delivery and the volume of data they are able to collect.” - Wilson Readinger, Head of UX Research @ WeightWatchers_

---

**Our AI analyst is _not_ just another “text-to-SQL” chatbot that spits out random graphs.** Instead, it's an intelligent agent that operates Briefer's powerful data workspace to generate answers that are precise and reviewable.

Our agent can do anything a human analyst does in Briefer: write SQL, plot graphs, and even run Python for data manipulation and advanced analyses.

‎
