launches.tagline: Cenote eliminates administrative bottlenecks that slow down revenue.
launches.body:
### **tl;dr**

We work with specialist clinics to identify their biggest administrative blockers and deploy custom **AI** to resolve them. Right now, we’re automating **referral intake**, reducing the time it takes for clinics to process new patients and accelerate revenue collection.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u403AnLMSNE>

### **Problem**

Specialist clinics struggle with **slow, manual referral processing**, leading to revenue delays, administrative overload, and patient drop offs. The biggest bottlenecks we've uncovered:

* **Referral processing is manual and slow.** Clinics receive **thousands of referrals per month**, requiring extensive manual effort to extract and enter data.
* **Medical necessity verification is tedious.** Clinics must determine if a referral meets insurance criteria, often requiring **days of back-and-forth with primary care providers** for missing information.
* **Insurance approvals are a major roadblock.** Clinics waste **days negotiating with insurers** to confirm reimbursement eligibility before scheduling treatment.

These inefficiencies cause **40-60% of referrals to drop off and** costs the U.S. healthcare system **over $150 billion annually**. The administrative burden is also immense, with an average of **4.3 administrative staff per doctor** in the American healthcare system.

### **Solution**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXduwoVo9LiyuYd4ldqDHoJxHu2uaKzKbOzQnI4MZ0vlWDvKTY-nE2iokzaFTCR7-7PeqhwdI9FIqtRbpP1FkZ3ivWq6TdtuyftWnKoMCyzw-smhtrM7tZacSCTnDkJ45wF92PRK7w?key=9LANEIwzbMw6NQWGiMH6ii1e)

Cenote eliminates the **referral-to-treatment bottleneck**, allowing clinics to focus on patient care while accelerating revenue collection.

* **Automated data extraction:** We categorize and extract key referral details the moment they hit the clinic’s inbox.
* **Seamless medical necessity verification:** If critical referral data is missing, our system **auto-requests** the necessary information via the preferred form of digital communication.
* **AI-powered insurance authorization:** Our **AI callers** handle insurance approvals, freeing clinic staff to focus on higher-value tasks.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeGgHkFuty55KGO5k--WHuaGP852o6tN4i7BepjytmDTjp48gCAx7ZC2boYhxw4NV9-evAIo09IUWh61gICroHpapc2X2jAmN3plFp4tpHM7ib9RKHwuqyyvd4FXxx2qQe-r7D7Uw?key=9LANEIwzbMw6NQWGiMH6ii1e)

launches.tagline: Meet G LNK, the AI one-stop shop for all medical interactions
launches.body:
Hey YC!

We’re [Raouf](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2360566) and [Rayan](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2366179) — co-founders of G LNK

**TL;DR**

G LNK is an AI-powered platform that connects Pharma companies with doctors & researchers. Rayan worked on this as a consultant, where Pharma companies spent billions annually just to determine how much to pay doctors while staying within regulatory guidelines. Using LLMs, we’re automating the end-to-end process—from identifying candidates to compensation and compliance.\
<https://youtu.be/16oP6roNnZk>

**Problem**

Pharma companies spend over **$70 billion annually** on engaging doctors & researchers, yet a lot of that money is wasted on outdated and manual processes:

* **Outsourcing is expensive and slow**: Companies spend millions on third parties (consulting, recruiting, and regulatory firms)  just to find the right experts and to know how much to pay them compliantly.
* **Compliance risks are high**: Payment miscalculations can lead to regulatory violations and hefty fines
* **Data is scattered**: Contracts, payments and compliance tracking are spread across disconnected systems, making transparency and oversight difficult

<https://youtu.be/qDdFbMWO6eU>

**Solution**

**G LNK automates Pharma companies' entire healthcare professional (HCP) engagement process**—from identifying suitable doctors to engaging them. Here’s how it works:

1. **Identify HCPs:**
   * Identify a doctor from our database of over 3.2 million user profiles (growing 250% MoM).
   * Alternatively, if you know who you want to engage, simply upload the doctor’s CV and we will take care of the rest.
2. **Calculate Compensation:**
   * Instantly determine their compensation rates.
   * Adjust the rates dynamically based on factors such as service type and travel requirements.
3. **Engage Directly:**
   * Contact the selected doctors directly through our platform.
4. **Ensure Compliance:**
   * Maintain regulatory compliance and prevent compliance violations before they happen.
   * Leverage real-time data from trusted sources like NIH, PubMed, CBS, CMS, and more.

This step-by-step solution replaces multiple vendors with a single AI-powered platform, ensuring efficient, compliant, and cost-effective HCP engagement.

**Additional Features**

* **Built-in CRM** to track all HCP engagements
* **Comprehensive financial tracking**, including:
  * All Transfer of Value payments made to HCPs (date, purpose, associated drug)
  * Drug coverage breakdown
  * Monthly payment summaries
  * Payment analysis by Therapeutic Area
* **Tailored recommendations** for grants, conferences, and publications for HCPs
* **Centralized database** of regulations and Codes of Conduct across 150+ countries

**Team**

Rayan and Raouf have known each other for over a decade, with their professional relationship cementing itself during their time as researchers at the University of Chicago.

**Rayan (CEO)** worked as a Life-Sciences Consultant at PwC and was recognized as top consulting analyst in the US for pioneering automation in pharmaceutical compliance. He holds degrees in Chemistry & Economics at UChicago, where he was one of the youngest biochemistry researchers at Pritzker School of Engineering.

**Raouf (CTO)** worked as a ML-researcher at AxLab, where he specialized in developing neural network architectures for multimodal human-computer interaction with adaptive reinforcement learning. He has a multidisciplinary background, with degrees in Computer Science, Astrophysics, & Economics from UChicago

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88235&key=user_uploads/2366179/8a3b2573-1a0d-499b-b252-94260eb9ca1d)

**We are on a mission to help Pharma companies cut costs, enhance accuracy with better benchmarking, and save valuable time. By streamlining these critical processes, we empower Pharma to focus more resources on manufacturing, distribution, and supply—accelerating the delivery of life-changing treatments to those who need them most.**

**Our Asks**

We would really appreciate introductions to anyone working in the Pharma industry or any health-related verticals. Additionally, if you know any physician/research communities, we would love to talk and learn more!

launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Trata gives hedge funds un-biased, unfiltered stock analysis from anonymous Analysts at well-known funds. Our AI agents interview Analysts at multi-billion dollar funds, capture their thinking about the stocks they know and publish it anonymously.

### **Problem:**

1. It takes buyside Analysts at least 3 hours to figure out a company’s key narratives/points of debate - what outcomes are going to drive the share price up OR down? Examples: an ongoing lawsuit, a competitor going bankrupt, an Activist campaign, a new CEO, etc. This involves reading earnings call transcripts, initiation reports, talking to Investor Relations, reaching out to other Analysts, and piecing everything together yourself.
2. Because of the time it takes to do step 1, would-be winners/inflection points fall through the cracks all the time.
3. Current solutions (idea dinners, forums like Value Investors Club, Twitter DMs, independent research boutiques and even paid Substacks) are fragmented and biased.
4. The highest quality leads come from talking directly to fellow Analysts, but there’s never been a way to do this at scale, authentically. Until now.

### **Solution:**

We use LLMs to interview dozens of people a day, get their quick and honest takes on signals/points of debate they’re actually paying attention to, and turn that into a one-of-a-kind research product. Each conversation is with an anonymous hedge fund Analyst who is deeply familiar with the company – think an expert network where the hedge funds are the experts. Contributors share their knowledge to gain access to an exponentially bigger pool of expertise.

We don’t provide investment advice; we just get you up to speed – fast. We work directly with the compliance teams of multi-billion dollar hedge funds and have a team of human lawyers to ensure SEC compliance.

We are building the product I wish I had as an Analyst. Our first user interviews liked the idea so much (without any code built) that they are now our angels.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gE_Ovy1BiTM>

### **Here’s how to think about our value proposition:**

If a fund manages $300 million, one successful idea (3% position, +50% return) generates $4.5 million in profit and $900K in fees ($720/180K split between the Portfolio Manager and Analyst). This is a 750X, 120X, and 30X ROI on a $6K subscription for the Fund, Portfolio Manager and Analyst.

All it takes is one decent idea for Trata to be a home run.

### **Our Ask:**

If you are a hedge fund Analyst or know any hedge fund Analysts / public investors, please reach out! They don't have to be at a big fund like Citadel for us to be interested. We pay very well. They will most likely thank you for the intro. We guarantee anonymity. Contact us at [founders@trytrata.com](mailto:founders@trytrata.com).

Eric and Will met at Cornell as undergrads. Eric and Alex met in high school English and grew up in the same hometown.

[Eric](https://www.linkedin.com/in/emc329/): 4.5 years as a Senior Analyst at a Long/Short Hedge Fund covering tech companies globally. Applied Economics (summa cum laude) at Cornell. Posts on Value Investors Club for fun, Sohn Idea Contest Finalist in 2021, has traveled to 20+ countries in the past few years.

Full-time ML Engineer at Meta. CS/Stats/Math triple major in three years and a Master’s in CS his fourth year at Cornell. Globally ranked in certain online video games.

launches.body:
Hey YC,

We’re Ben, Brian, and Sejoon from **Nitrode.**

Nitrode is a research company focused on improving game development with AI. 

**The Problem - How do we advance game development with AI?**

We started by building an AI game engine. It got to [**#3 on Product Hunt**,](https://www.producthunt.com/products/nitrode-ai-game-engine) and we gained several useful insights:  despite recent progress in agentic coding, game development remains uniquely difficult for AI models because it requires **(1) strong spatial reasoning**, **(2) reliable tool use/tool-calling**, **(3) strong agentic coding capabilities** and the **(4) ability to operate in real-time environments for complex games**.

**The Solution** 

To advance game development, we believe AI models firstly need to be judged against robust evaluation frameworks that reflect the **actual complexity of the field.** Over the coming months, Nitrode will open-source a suite of benchmarks designed to measure where AI models truly stand in game development. Our first benchmark, [**GameEngineBench**,](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03525) evaluates agentic coding performance on C++ game engine tasks in real runtime environments.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104921&key=user_uploads/1654263/a084ce2c-86d5-431b-97a1-d2ccf07b3f04)

Our results are clear: model class and reasoning effort are strong predictors of performance, while model rankings align more closely with spatial reasoning benchmarks than with traditional agentic coding benchmarks. **This suggests that game development is fundamentally different from pure coding.** Success requires not only writing correct code, but also understanding space, tools, runtime behavior, and the interaction between systems.

We also observe significant complementarity across frontier models, indicating that different models exhibit distinct strengths within the game development task space. Mythos/Fable-class models point toward a potential step change in AI game development capability, where improved spatial understanding and stronger tool use combine to produce emergent behaviors that older model generations struggle to match.

Our benchmark has revealed clear model-specific performance gaps across game development tasks, with outcomes that diverge meaningfully from standard agentic coding benchmarks.

We are also building [Mint](http://mint.nitrode.com), a platform that onboards game development experts to work on custom datasets. Think engine programmers, technical artists, and developers with years of enterprise/indie game development experience. We already have hundreds of contributors across game development and creative software. Whenever you need a certain type of data, we construct and lead a team to produce:

* Post-training /SFT data captured from real workflows: how developers actually build, debug, test, and iterate inside engines and creative tools.
* RL environments and executable tasks where models learn through execution and feedback.
* Custom benchmarks and post-training for gaming enterprises: we pinpoint where models fail on real game development tasks, then post-train a custom model to close those gaps.

**Team** 

Ben and Brian studied Information Science and Computer Science at Cornell, while Sejoon studied Computer Science and Product Design at Stanford. The trio has been building things together for the last six years, from a sports team analytics tool to Nitrode, and are, unsurprisingly, massive gaming nerds. Sejoon is top 400 in the world at moving GeoGuessr and a certified Civ sweat, Brian is ranked in Tetris, and Ben used to be ranked in Minecraft speedrunning.

**Our Ask:**

1. If you need custom datasets or evals, let us know! Email us [research@nitrode.com](mailto:research@nitrode.com)
2. Are there any creative or gaming companies you could introduce us to?

**Thank you!**

launches.body:
TLDR: Cutting just 1 second off each customer call can save enterprise call centers millions of dollars. Calltree helps enterprises' VP of Operations understand how to make their call center more efficient. Our AI agent analyzes millions of minutes of call center recordings to find inefficiencies in workflows and quantifies the cost of each action. For example, when a rep is handling a credit card dispute, Calltree can identify that reps spend 30 seconds per call on manual data gathering and data entry, propose a solution, and measure the opex savings. Calltree surfaces these insights in an analytics tool and generates reports, making it easy for operation leaders to build business cases to prioritize improvements, realizing millions in opex savings.

Ask: If cutting every second matters to your call center, please email us [kun@calltree.ai](mailto:kun@calltree.ai) and [rob@calltree.ai](mailto:rob@calltree.ai) or [book a demo here.](https://calendly.com/kun-calltree/30min) 

[Checkout our launch video!](https://youtu.be/v-9hFgH_gCI)

**The Problem**

Large enterprises track every second of a phone call because **reducing average call time** can save millions of dollars each year. However, enterprises don't have a scalable way to find these inefficiencies. Manual time studies (in person shadowing call center reps, etc.) are tedious, unscalable, and expensive. 

**What Are Screen Recordings?**

Many contact centers don’t just record the audio of customer calls; they also capture **everything the rep does on their screen** for training, compliance, and quality assurance. **Less than 1% of these screen recordings** are ever reviewed by a manager or analyst and **miss 99% of calls**. This leads to blind spots and missed opportunities for massive cost savings.

**Our Solution**

* **AI agent that finds workflow inefficiencies** (e.g., toggling between multiple systems to complete a single task).
* **Quantify the time and cost** of each action (e.g., “Switching between these five legacy apps costs 20 seconds per call → $5M/year”).
* **Operation leaders use these insights** to build quick business cases to fix inefficiencies. After changes are implemented, Calltree measures the impact pre- and post-fix to **prove cost reductions**.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdf17k-TMCzITHR-cAuUjxmf1XRQMpsQRvVeVslxQKILE2Jv6xHq2NSXtJWSM1WyEDXZBON4FJ1U7A77AKzZt7VvkUe7HGq8ozwJT3lf8O4nUgM8CwHtfhZ60iIsEanYT077wTjFA?key=5B91WL3MPEXhLdY8htNQCHC6)

* After seeing how **little** of these screen recordings ever got analyzed—despite their huge potential value—we decided to automate that process end-to-end.

[Infinite](https://youtu.be/L0Zho4tT8w8)

#### **TL;DR: Fast-track your stablecoin integration**

Infinite makes it easy for developers to embed global stablecoin payment rails through a turnkey SDK. Our customers use us to move money cross-border on same-day with low fees, all without crypto complexity.

#### **The problem**

After talking to over hundreds of merchants and payment processors, we found that global payments are slow, expensive, and unreliable. Traditional financial rails such as SWIFT result in high fees and multi-day delays with little transparency on the state of their transfer. Yet companies, both big and small, struggle to adopt stablecoins due to complex compliance requirements and fragmented vendor integrations.

#### **Our solution**

We're building what merchants worldwide need: fast, affordable global payment rails that can be integrated in days instead of months. Infinite can process same-day payments to over 170 countries, enabling businesses to leverage stablecoins as a settlement network (a la SWIFT) for cross-border payments. Our network of on and off-ramps provides connectivity to local fiat funding and payout flows, enabling faster global money movement and our turnkey SDKs and APIs allow businesses to embed stablecoins into their applications faster. Today, our platform supports:

* **Customer Bank to User Bank** — US bank -> International bank (e.g., USA to LATAM), allowing businesses to send local currency payments with instant settlement to LATAM, Europe, Africa, and SEA
* **Customer Bank to User Wallet** — US bank -> user wallet, allowing businesses to send USD stablecoin payouts globally and instantly
* **Customer Bank to User SDK** — Embedded wallet and hosted links experience for payment beneficiaries to seamlessly receive and manage stablecoin payments without dealing with crypto complexity
* **Treasury Management** — Store balances in USD-denominated stablecoins earn a competitive yield and issue cards against wallet balances

* **Global Payroll** – Global payroll platforms looking to increase coverage, streamline tax compliance, and move money faster.
* **Logistics** – Import/export payments for businesses struggling with slow settlement times and high fees in cross-border trade
* **Marketplaces** – Marketplace payouts for platforms needing to send frequent, low-cost payments to sellers and service providers worldwide
* **Neobanks:** Traditional banks for SMBs or neobanks in emerging markets looking to hold stablecoin-backed treasuries and remit globally

We’re building this platform to solve pain points we experienced building financial products at scale at companies like [Sardine](https://sardine.ai) and [Coinbase,](https://coinbase.com) where we learned about customers’ needs firsthand.

We’ve started by automating the most complex part of CRE accounting: Triple-net (NNN) reconciliation. This process accounts for up to 1/3 of the accounting effort for a large CRE firm and often results in expensive human errors and audits.

launches.body:
Hello World, we’re [James](https://www.linkedin.com/in/james-k-he/) and [Patrick](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sharpe-patrick/) - founders of Artificial Societies 👋

**We simulate 1000s of stakeholders and how they react to information.** We help Fortune 500 enterprises simulate how their most important audiences - policy influencers, investors, buyer committees, etc. - react to their most important marketing and comms decisions. Find out more at [**societies.io**](http://societies.io).

# **Our Story**

We’re both behavioral scientists, but took different paths - James used machines to predict humans, while Patrick ran experiments in large organizations.

In 2023, James started tinkering with a crazy idea: what would a society of 33,000 AI bots look like? He wrote this into the first-ever large-scale [academic study](https://societies.io/pdfs/bjop-2025-ai-chatbots-collective-behaviour.pdf) on AI societies, and started turning it into a product.

One day in a London coffee shop in 2024, James used a simulation to recreate an experiment Patrick had spent two months on… in just ten minutes. That same week, Patrick quit his consulting job to co-found Artificial Societies with James.

We started by simulating a network of 1,000 VCs, and used it to raise a pre-seed and get into YC. Next, we built Reach, a tool that let anyone create an AI simulation of their own LinkedIn audience, to test posts before hitting publish. 

Now, we are focusing on enterprise customers and consulting partners who are demanding us to build a more exceptional technology:

# **Introducing Radiant**

We help marketing and strategic comms teams build bespoke AI simulations of high-value audiences, for insights on questions no one else can answer.

Radiant has already delivered over 18 million responses to global F100 enterprises, that helped shape over 100 million dollars’ worth of decisions ranging from [investor relations](https://societies.io/investor-communications-simulation), [high-value advertising](https://societies.io/advertising-testing-with-ai), [crisis communications](https://societies.io/crisis-communications-simulation), [reputation management](https://societies.io/reputation-management-simulation), and [corporate strategy positioning](https://societies.io/corporate-strategy-simulation).

**Here’s [Radiant in action](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/james-k-he_anthropic-gambled-millions-on-their-superbowl-activity-7426611068254322688-fyEq?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAACk3-R4BvvNrRdti8qSJ9yH6XurA_LAGBoc).**

To power Radiant, we’ve built over 2.5 million AI personas that are all grounded in real human behaviour – not just what people say, but also what they do, and who they are influenced by. 

But our enterprise partners choose us not just because we have achieved 1) [95% distribution accuracy](https://societies.io/publications) against human self-replication, and 2) 90% persona internal coherence, both on [empirically and theory-grounded evaluations](https://societies.io/how-accurate-are-ai-personas).

More importantly, they choose us because of our ability to deliver impossible research projects - such as having insights backed by millions of responses within 24 hours, such as being able to test sensitive strategies on high-value audiences with 100% security, without human risk.

# **What’s next?**

Our vision of Artificial Societies is a **Societal World Model** that enables infinite experimentation, so that every organisation can have awareness of outcomes, before making a decision. 

No planes fly without a wind-tunnel; no medicines are approved without clinical trials; and yet, the biggest decision societies face today are taken as bets. 

We see Artificial Societies as a historically inevitable technology, and see it as our lives' mission to bring it to life.

### **Our Ask 🙏**

**We are rolling out Radiant at marketing & comms teams globally.** If you are someone / know someone who lead strategic comms consultancies or enterprise marketing firms, please reach out or introduce us at [founders@societies.io](mailto:founders@societies.io).

## **TL;DR**

AI models need high-quality training data to effectively automate complex professional tasks - we provide that data. If you are building an AI model or need fine-tuning data for your agent, we’d love to help. 

\------------

## **Why We’re Building AfterQuery**

There is a dearth of high-quality training data.

Current AI models are trained to be smart but are not trained on the work of actual professionals in many fields. 

For example, current models are largely unusable to professionals working in finance (private equity, hedge funds, investment banks, etc). See our [paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2501.18062), where LLMs fail 60% of realistic daily tasks – but with some fine-tuning on high-quality training data, significantly improve.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeJndLBLBOQJVpf7yPJNA2WFddpffkxqdE1rFqmEfxo3FRmcSCVWqHnsOR793XuN1iCUm-ibeWfFj-FV_3FaswWhXetsEhembFLjln5Lwc9LA0tJV6uNq7MPWyjdDq7FTZSRdmekQ?key=_udDbu5NRw5fwLzMYyqM9i52)

_Chart showing LLM performance against FinanceQA_

And the lack of high-quality training data is everywhere:

* Domain-specific AI (legal, consulting, healthcare, etc.)
* Multimodal data (audio, multilingual, etc.)
* Foundational models looking to push the boundary on reasoning and grading

## **Solution**

We are building a platform to onboard experts to work on custom datasets. Think working professionals at top firms and the smartest students in various subjects (PhDs). Then, whenever you have a request for a certain type of data, we will construct and lead a team to produce:

* Post-training / fine-tuning data
* Human-Led Reinforcement Learning (RLHF) data
* Custom benchmarks

You will know the people making your dataset and their qualifications while we coordinate with you to ensure quality standards. We save you time and energy, so you can focus on the model and not the data.

## **Example Datasets We Provide**

_Foundational Model Advancing Coding Capabilities:_

* New data structures and algorithms problems with test cases and step-by-step answer reasoning 
* Computer architecture and system design reasoning
* Performance optimization code with benchmarks and reasoning

_Enterprise SaaS Company Building Internal AI Developer Tool:_

* Codebase-wide code snippets with corresponding refactoring suggestions and explanations 
* System and runtime errors paired with step-by-step debugging solutions 
* Database query optimization solutions and reasoning steps

_Startup Building an AI Agent for Law:_

* Answered legal questions with expert reasoning
* Computer use data for common tasks on legal project management software
* Contract redlines with expert corrections

**If AI is one day to replace jobs entirely, it can’t just be good, it needs to be near perfect. This transformation will require an immense amount of high-quality training data.**

## **Our Ask**

* Are you **working on a foundational model** advancing multimodal applications, nuanced reasoning, or domain-specific expertise?
* Are you **implementing AI in a specialized domain** where current models lack expertise (e.g., medicine, legal, finance, software, government, healthcare)?

We would love to meet you! 

## **Our Team**

Carlos and Spencer first met in high school at a summer program at Google and then interned together at Meta. Danny and Spencer met in high school, where they built a startup. They then both got into Wharton, sold that startup, and became roommates.

[Carlos](https://www.linkedin.com/in/carlossgg/) has built multiple software businesses on his own, exited an ed-tech startup, and has worked as a software engineer at Citadel Securities. He’s won the largest possible academic scholarship in all of Canada, competed in state and national sailing competitions, and has 8x his bankroll in poker.

He was the sole summer analyst at Silver Lake globally and has programmed numerous apps in his spare time (and sold some of them). He trains for half marathons and lifts in his free time between completing a master’s in computer science concurrently with his Wharton undergraduate degree.

[Danny](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danny1898/) competed and won international competitions in public speaking during high school while pursuing his interest in AI, winning an international Microsoft AI competition and conducting research at a machine learning neuroscience lab. He then learned how people build real estate, from grocery stores to billion-dollar luxury hotels, eventually working on the largest real estate IPO in history and the largest IPO in 2024. He also really likes movies and attended the world's largest film festival, catching premieres of films like Anora and The Substance.

Recruiting is a $1T+ industry, yet the most widely used recruitment platforms were built 20 years ago. They were never built for AI and have shown a clear lack of innovation, which has led to a growing reliance on add-on functionality. Most of today’s "AI features" are just layers on top of outdated systems that can’t properly understand, update, or act on data. This is despite the enormous potential AI has in recruitment.\

Spott is building AI agents for recruiting firms to replace legacy recruiting platforms like Bullhorn. Today, headhunters use our first agent to generate detailed candidate presentation reports in their template within minutes, using data they already own.

[Spott video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7w3Ae-KDHEU)

Headhunters create detailed reports for every candidate they propose to a company at the end of their search process. Manually writing these reports from scratch can take several hours, while most of the required inputs are readily available in their recruitment platform (think CV, cover letter, job description, interview notes). Similar tasks such as rewriting job descriptions and CVs are time and labor-intensive, adding up to \~10% of the total workload. These tasks primarily involve converting raw information into standardized formats, which is time-consuming and slows down the hiring process.

**📈Solution**\
Spott's candidate report writing agent streamlines this process by ingesting CVs, job descriptions, and interview notes to generate polished drafts in seconds. You can import recordings of in-person conversations and link transcripts from Zoom or Teams meetings to quickly create an 80% complete draft. Our context-rich editor, powered by AI, helps you efficiently finalize your report in minimal time. What sets Spott apart from ChatGPT and comparable solutions is the exceptional quality of its reports, the anonymized processing of sensitive client data, and the ability to export directly to your custom Word or PowerPoint templates. Our solution allows exec search recruiters to truly create reports in minutes rather than hours.

Founders [Manu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/manuvanderveeren/), [Samuel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/samuelsmeys/), and [Lander](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lander-degr%C3%A8ve/) bring recruiting expertise from McKinsey, BCG, and Bain. launches.body:
**We're Yash and Ishan, co-founders of Ergo.**

**Ergo is the revenue infrastructure for teams growing faster than their systems can keep up.** We connect the conversations your team is already having, across calls, email, Slack, and more, and build a unified data layer that moves deals forward.

Teams like [Rho](https://rho.co), [RetellAI](https://retellai.com), [Whop](https://whop.com), [Agency Cybersecurity](https://getagency.com), [Corgi](https://corgi.insure), and [Greptile](https://greptile.com) are already running on Ergo.

**📉 The Problem**

Revenue teams are drowning in fragmented data. Your reps are on six different communication channels. None of it connects. None of it acts on itself.

* Deals slip because no one followed up at the right moment
* Leadership asks reps what's happening instead of just knowing
* Marketing sequences run on empty fields because the right data never made it in
* AEs walk into calls without context because handoffs live in someone's Slack DMs

The conversations are happening. The signal is there. It just never goes anywhere.

**📈 The Solution**

Ergo plugs into every channel where your team talks to prospects and customers and builds a unified data layer across all of it. Every call, email, and message gets structured into a single source of truth your entire revenue org can act on.

* **For revenue teams:** Structured deal data captured automatically across every call, email, and message, without touching your CRM
* **For reps:** Follow-ups drafted and surfaced at the right moment, every time
* **For managers and founders:** Real-time pipeline visibility without chasing anyone for updates
* **For RevOps and marketing:** Clean, structured data that actually powers your sequences and reporting

**⚙️ How It Works**

1. **Connect your channels** — Zoom, Google Meet, Gmail, Outlook, Slack, dialers. Wherever your team talks to customers, Ergo listens.
2. **Structure the signal** — Every conversation becomes structured, actionable data across your pipeline.
3. **Execute on what's next** — Follow-ups drafted. Deals surfaced. Pipeline moving. No manual work required.

**🎬 Our Story**

We started at Georgia Tech, and got our first real signal at a YC-backed startup in SF. We spent four days embedded with their sales team and watched 15-20 daily calls evaporate into missed follow-ups and stale records. We built a first version over a weekend that unlocked $75K in closed contracts. That problem turned out to be everywhere.

Today Ergo supports revenue teams running their entire bottom-of-funnel motion, from first conversation to close to expansion, without the admin.

launches.title: Frekil - Scale AI for Medical Scans 🚀
launches.tagline: Scale AI for Medical Scans
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Nikhil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhiltiwari-iitb/) & [Shivesh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivesh-gupta-iitb/), co-founders of Frekil!  👋

## TL;DR

Frekil is an end-to-end platform to procure and annotate medical imaging datasets like Xrays, CTs, MRIs, etc 10x faster with AI assistance. We’ve partnered with radiology chains for large-scale imaging data, and have a global marketplace of radiologists for rapid, high-quality annotations.

https://youtu.be/2MYjUFp3r0Q?feature=shared

## ❗The Problem

AI is transforming healthcare, but the biggest bottleneck is still **access to medical images from hospitals and annotations by expert doctors**.

Healthcare AI and life sciences companies spend millions collecting medical images and hiring expert radiologists. But annotations? They're still:

📝 Manual\
🐢 Slow\
🔍 Hard to QA

Finding expert annotators with deep domain knowledge is tough, which means R&D teams waste months and large budgets on a process that should be seamless.

Medical annotation itself is uniquely challenging because it involves:

📦 Gigabyte-scale files\
🧠 Complex, multi-dimensional data that’s sensitive to loss\
🎯 Accuracy that’s absolutely critical

Yet most teams still use open-source desktop tools like 3D Slicer, built decades ago for solo researchers. These tools:

🚫 Require local machines\
📉 Offer no real-time collaboration\
📊 Force spreadsheet-based coordination\
🔐 Risk compliance and data security

And the result?\
Highly trained radiologists are stuck doing repetitive tasks manually wasting time, slowing innovation, and compromising data quality.

## 🧠 Our Solution

We transform the way healthcare AI teams prepare data by **accelerating and streamlining the entire annotation pipeline** — cutting timelines from months down to days.

Here’s how:

✅ Deliver fully annotated **medical datasets** tailored for AI research needs

✅ Provide certified and benchmarked **radiologists** for annotation and quality assurance

✅ Offer advanced, browser-based annotation tools for all kinds of medical images—radiology, pathology, histopathology, including X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, etc

✅ Use **AI assistance** to make annotators **10x faster**

✅ Enable customizable clinical workflows with multi-stage reviews & annotations

✅ Ensure **FDA-Ready** annotation versioning, consensus checks, and full audit trails

✅ Track annotator performance in cost, time, and **accuracy** - all built in

### 🤝 The Team

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXctdUlgsBRg891fZ4XU-Ve5trM2bw_h1PYuoQCy0NxrUigEoWMrHYVBO3D3IoAaUC7UPvtDzGxg0C_x2gyO0ujmyJs3_FxtXpLzIVPiUfIZqDKotuf5oeOiGmHyyPRLAzeDm9ORsA?key=Rm0k0m7MflJlURnfdp3zng)

Nikhil (left) and Shivesh (right) have been friends since their days at **IIT Bombay**, studying and building together. While working on healthcare AI projects, they experienced firsthand how painful annotation can be especially for large, multi-dimensional medical images that demand extreme accuracy.

[**Nikhil**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhiltiwari-iitb/) (CEO) - Former software engineer at **Stripe, Amazon**, and Marsh McLennan, where he worked on infrastructure, performance optimization, and low-level systems. He graduated from **IIT Bombay** last year, where he led technical initiatives in the student body SARC and built platforms used by 10,000+ students.

[**Shivesh**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivesh-gupta-iitb/) (CTO) - Former systems software engineer at **Sony Japan**. He holds an engineering degree from **IIT Bombay**. During his time there, he worked on healthcare AI research and also led the institute’s web and coding club.

## 👋 Our Ask

Know someone building AI in healthcare whether it’s diagnostic models, clinical trial workflows, or robotic surgery? We’d love to connect.

We have special offers for academic research, connect us with professors at your university working in healthcare AI!

Got questions or want to chat? Reach out anytime at [founders@frekil.com](mailto:founders@frekil.com) !

**TL;DR**

Using your go-to AI chat or coding agent for data analysis is great until you want to set up a recurring report or collaborate with your team.

We built an analytics layer for your favorite AI tools to generate hosted reports and live dashboards.

Get started in minutes, for free at [app.bitboard.work](http://app.bitboard.work)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100824&key=user_uploads/2002154/615b65c7-eb00-480f-ba27-cceabe248a50)

**Problem**

The most capable AI tools still treat data analysis as ephemeral, making durable reporting and collaboration a nightmare.

Legacy BI tools weren’t intended for AI users, so they bolt on clumsy chatbots and can’t offer meaningful control to the agents you’re actually using.

**How BitBoard works**

Connect your preferred AI chat or coding agent to BitBoard to build living dashboards and analysis you can share with your team. BitBoard works with any MCP client, including Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Cursor.

Hosted workbooks let your agent pull data, build visualizations, and add commentary by writing SQL, code, and markdown that’s stored and executed within the workbook.

Work in BitBoard is traceable and repeatable. Logic and outputs are persisted and named so context isn't lost in chat threads or terminals.

Analysis stays fast and cheap as the workbook grows. Small queries stay local, results are cached until the underlying data changes, and your warehouse only returns the rows each query needs.

**Connecting your data**

Want to get started with minimal setup? Just push data from your agent to piggyback off of your agent’s existing connections and we’ll host it.

For ongoing access to live data, securely connect to your apps, databases, and data warehouse from a single point in BitBoard.

**Onboard in minutes, for free**

1. Connect your AI chat or coding agent to BitBoard via MCP. Works with any MCP client, including Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Cursor.
2. Push data from your agent. We'll host it, no setup required.
3. When you want live data, configure connections to your apps, databases, and warehouse from a single point in BitBoard.

Try pointing your agent at BitBoard for your next KPI review, product analytics investigation, or post-mortem.

Hey everyone! We’re [Siddhartha](https://www.linkedin.com/in/siddhartha-javvaji-23b81617a) and [Pratham](https://www.linkedin.com/in/prathamhombal/), co-founders of [Stratify](https://www.trystratify.com) and we’re saving companies millions by helping them understand their users better.

# **TL;DR**

Failing to understand _what_ your users truly want can kill a company. Stratify uses AI agentic workflows to instantly recruit participants, conduct dynamic user interviews, analyze responses, and provide actionable feedback. With simple queries like "What do users think of our new checkout flow?" or “Which prototype resonates most with users?”, Stratify delivers authentic customer feedback within a few hours.

[Stratify Launch Video](https://youtu.be/j0Py7pKyuy4)

---

# **🤦‍♂️ The User Research Problem**

**Here's the brutal truth**: 90% of product failures happen because teams don't truly understand their users. You can’t really blame them because traditional user research **is broken**:

1. **💸 Focus groups are expensive:** $15K+ for 8 people in a room for 2 hours. Half of them drop out last minute, and you're left wondering if these insights represent your actual users.
2. **📅 Manual interviews take weeks:** Booking user interviews feels like herding cats. Calendars stay empty for weeks while your launch deadline approaches. And big ideas _cannot_ wait.
3. **📝 Surveys are unresponsive and impersonal:** Generic forms with dropdown menus can't capture the _why_ behind user behavior. You get some data, but absolutely no story.

**The result?** Teams ship based on assumptions, not insights. Features flop. Users churn. Millions of dollars wasted.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90668&key=user_uploads/2549216/0e975083-d540-4aed-91ac-ea337164777b)

---

# **✨ Introducing Stratify**

What if you could ask "What do users think of our new product?" and get answers from hundreds of real users in under a few hours? That's exactly what Stratify does.

1. **🚀 Define your Research Questions:**

   Simply describe what you want to learn about your product or upload product materials: _"How do millennials feel about our pricing?"_ Our vetted AI researcher transforms your query into a comprehensive study framework in seconds.
2. **🎯 Smart Participant Matching:**

   Set demographic and behavioral parameters or simply specify a query like "U.S., Gen Z, Online Shopper, Foodie". Our AI automatically finds the perfect participants from our network of millions of real users or directly within your own company’s customers.
3. **🎥 Uncover Real Insights:**

   Watch our AI agents conduct hundreds of interviews simultaneously, asking follow-up questions that dynamically adapt to each participant’s unique responses. Uncover the _why_ behind user behaviors that surveys and focus groups miss completely.
4. **🧠 Instant Analysis:**

   Transform hours of interview content into actionable intelligence instantly. Search conversations semantically, generate reports and slides presentations, or simply chat with your data to find exactly what you need to know.

---

---

# **🎉 Our Ask**

* **🚀 Building something new?** Try Stratify before your next feature launch, whether that’s your website, onboarding flow, product prototypes, etc. It could save you months of building the wrong thing—seriously.
* **💬 Know any product managers, product designers, or founders?** They'd love this. User research is their biggest pain point.
* **🙌 Support us** with a follow or share. Every bit helps us reach more teams who are tired of guessing what users want.

---

# **👥 The Team**

[**Siddhartha**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/siddhartha-javvaji-23b81617a) (CEO) and [**Pratham**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/prathamhombal) (CTO) have studied computer science at Stanford, where they’ve conducted AI and high performance compute research at renowned labs. They met in their freshman dorm at Stanford and have been roommates and building together since.

They’ve been in your shoes. They’ve launched features that flopped, ignored user feedback until it was too late, and learned the hard way that assumptions kill products. Now they’re making sure no other team has to learn it the hard way.

---

---

launches.title: Freesolo: Post-Training Built for your Agent
launches.tagline: Small models, frontier performance
launches.body:
Not every AI interaction is best served with a large frontier model. There is a long tail of trillion-token use cases, from tagging to search, best served by a sub-10B-parameter model that runs in milliseconds and costs many orders of magnitude less than the frontier. However, engineers historically had to choose between model size and quality; as models got smaller, performance, adherence, and recall dropped linearly. Post-training on production data closes that gap. We built Freesolo Flash to make training loops like SFT and RL easy and end-to-end completable through your coding agent.

We accomplish this in a few different ways

* Upfront pricing: instead of billing by GPU hours or tokens spent while training, we quote the cost of the entire run upfront, so your agent can accurately tweak the dataset, model size, and algorithms it uses while staying in your budget before it starts the run.
* Our GPU infrastructure is optimized to make your specific run as in-expensive and fast as possible. This optimization means training with flash is 8x less expensive for SFT and 5.5x less expensive for GRPO (RL) when compared to Tinker.

Flash is built out of our own frustrations with current managed post-training solutions, especially for SLMs. We believe that unlocking frontier capability for a narrow task into a small model will prove to be the best improvement for all agentic product UX. Flash is our first step towards solving this. Just grab a Freesolo API Key, point your agent at the training package, and watch it push your lightweight model beyond the frontier.

Flash is publicly available today at  <https://freesolo.co>[ ](https://freesolo.co/). Train on!

launches.body:
Enterprise sales teams spend 50% of their time on research that misses the mark. Here's why — and how we're fixing it.

Hey everyone! We’re Saarth & Christopher – the founders of Sixtyfour. 👋

**TL;DR**

Sixtyfour AI is the Bloomberg Terminal for sales. We work with hypergrowth companies to deploy custom research agents that map their Total Addressable Market and deliver real-time market signals, fully tailored to what matters most.

Customers like **Mercor**, **Traba**, **Hockeystack**, and **Conduit** use Sixtyfour to stay ahead of the curve.

<https://youtu.be/s45NR6diBPo>

**🧠** **The Enterprise GTM Problem**

If you’re selling into a niche or regulated market ( health systems, manufacturing, fintech, govtech, and so on), you already know: generic data platforms don’t work.

Here’s why:

**💡 “Intent signals” are too broad**

Most tools will tell you someone visited a pricing page. That’s not useful when you’re selling a $250K solution into a regional hospital network or a logistics hub in the Midwest.

**🧱 The nuance is everything**

Enterprise sellers ask real questions:

Did that manufacturing facility just expand its fleet?

Does it have two or three parking bays?

Did that nursing home file a new Medicare cost report?

Is the new VP of Ops a better entry point than the outgoing admin director?

These are the signals that drive pipeline and predict fit, and no off-the-shelf platform can give you that.

**🔍 Static filters can’t model your ICP**

Try finding “companies that just adopted Drift, expanded their marketing team by 30%, and hired a new CRO in the past 90 days” in traditional tools. Impossible. Our agents live in that world

**✨ The Sixtyfour Advantage**

We don’t sell contact lists. We build intelligence infrastructure for your GTM engine.

**📍 Custom TAMs, always current**

We work with your team to define and continuously update your market using real-world, dynamic data — regulatory filings, facility attributes, staff movements, and even track infrastructure like parking lot size.

**📡 Proprietary real-time signals**

From Medicare cost report changes to decision-maker exits to new vendor adoption — we detect what matters to your team, as it happens.

**🧠 Deployable custom ML models**

Have internal data on close rates, deal velocity, or expansion triggers? We plug it in.

We can train and deploy custom ML models to estimate buyer readiness, ICP fit, churn risk, and more, directly tailored to your pipeline data.

**🤖 Agents that think like your best rep**

Our AI agents mirror your go-to-market motion, tracking, qualifying, and notifying you at the exact right time.

**👥The Team**

We’re both repeat founders who have built and sold into complex markets.

Saarth is a UC Berkeley Data Science grad and ex-Whatnot (YC W20), Deepgram (YC W16), and Stanford researcher. He built one of the earliest conversational AI agents (Dart) and has been shipping products since he was 10.

Christopher, a Cornell dropout, led GTM at Onyx (YC W24) and built sales AI tools at Symbl. He’s a CalHacks AI winner and ex-analyst at Cornell Atkinson, with deep experience across AI, ops, and consumer tech.

We’ve lived the pain of building GTM systems by hand, and we’re building the platform we always wished existed.

**👋 Our Ask**

🏢 Know a GTM, RevOps, or sales leader at an enterprise or hypergrowth vertical SaaS company? Send them to [sixtyfour.ai](http://sixtyfour.ai) — we’d love to chat.

💬 Frustrated with generic signals and shallow filters? Let’s build something that works for your team.

Every intro, share, and shoutout means the world. Thank you — we’re just getting started.

Hey YC!

We’re [Jennifer](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jennifer-y-song) and [Adam](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adam-mhatre-5b8aaa230/) - cofounders of Photonium.

**TL;DR**

Photonium automates optical system design with AI, replacing costly manual iteration with end-to-end system optimization.

**🚨 The Problem**

Optical systems are mission-critical across many high-growth sectors — including quantum technology, biomedical imaging, LiDAR for defense and autonomous vehicles, and metrology for semiconductor fabrication.

But designing them is a nightmare:

* Companies pour millions into teams of 20+ optical engineers
* Projects take months or years to go from R&D to production
* Tools are fragmented and outdated
* Optimization is manual and often based on trial-and-error

Engineers spend countless hours on repetitive workflows — constrained by tools that haven’t changed in decades.

**⚙️ Our Solution**

Photonium is building the electronic design automation (semiconductor EDA) for optics. We work with complex optical setups across industries and handle the entire design process — from system generation and optimization to simulation, tolerancing, and sourcing.

Photonium enables companies to:

* Generate and optimize designs from product specs
* Predict tolerance impacts without slow simulations
* Recommend data-driven alignment and manufacturing tweaks
* Optimize for cost, size, and performance trade-offs
* Seamlessly integrate with existing CAD workflows and optics simulation tools
* Automate the full design-to-sourcing pipeline

[Launch Video](https://youtu.be/YvX3Xr2_Gt8)

**🚀 The Team**

Jennifer studied physics, math, and CS at Harvard and built quantum optics experiments across Harvard, Stanford, and QuEra (a Google-backed quantum computing startup).

Adam studied computational physics at Stanford, and worked on plasma simulation for fusion and large-scale astrophysical modeling of black holes.

We’ve both felt the pain of inefficient engineering design firsthand — and built Photonium to fix it.

⚛️ **Why This Matters**

Optical systems are foundational to cutting-edge technologies, from quantum computing to semiconductor fabrication. Yet, outdated tools and fragmented workflows slow innovation and inflate costs. We hope to eliminate these bottlenecks and accelerate innovation across industries.

name: Clidey
long_description:
WhoDB is an open-source platform for modeling organizations and running decisions on top of their data.

It lets teams define their core entities (customers, accounts, assets, workflows), the relationships between them, and the rules and objectives that govern how decisions should be made. WhoDB continuously ingests operational data and keeps this model up to date in real time.

Instead of building dashboards, writing ad-hoc queries, or maintaining scattered business logic, teams express decisions declaratively—what should happen, under what conditions, and with what constraints. WhoDB evaluates those decisions automatically as data changes and produces actions, recommendations, or state updates.

Everything is transparent and inspectable: data models, decision logic, and outcomes are fully auditable and can be extended in code.

Hello world 🏄 we are [Hemang](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hemangkandwal/) and [Anguel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ahristozov/) from [Clidey](https://www.linkedin.com/company/clidey/), and we are building [Docucod](https://docucod.com/)!

**TL;DR:**

**Docucod automatically generates and maintains complete, always-up-to-date documentation—straight from your codebase.**

Demo video: https://youtu.be/SAaZq9UHAic

# **❗** What is the problem?

On average, developers spend **20–30% of their time** maintaining documentation—and that doesn’t even include the time it takes to create it in the first place. That’s nearly **12 hours in a standard 40-hour week**, often more if you're part of a fast-growing team.

Most tools are still manual and time-consuming, stealing hours better spent building, selling, or scaling.

Great documentation isn’t just helpful—it’s a **growth engine**. Look at Stripe: their docs earn trust and convert users.

The truth? At most companies, documentation is an afterthought (we haven’t written ours yet either!) And we get it—“documentation specialist” usually isn’t on anyone’s job title.

# 💡 What is the solution?

**Docucod auto-generates and maintains always-up-to-date documentation—straight from your codebase.** You continue building, we’ll focus on the documentation.

It fits effortlessly into your workflow, whether you’re a small team or managing complex repos.

From onboarding guides to API references and system diagrams, Docucod delivers clear, comprehensive docs with zero manual work.

Fully editable and always in sync, it lets you ship fast **and** document well—without compromise.

# 🧠 How it works:

* Connect your GitHub account and select a repo.
* Docucod scans your repo to understand its structure and functionality, building an intelligent knowledge graph that maps out components, features, code flow, and so on.
* It creates a structured documentation plan, outlining sections, navigation, and individual pages.
* Docucod generates rich content with diagrams and contextual clarity.
* Finally, it automatically pushes the documentation back to your repo for deployment.

# 😎 Want to see some real examples?

https://github.com/clidey/whodb-docs - deployed at http://whodb-docs.docucod.com/

https://github.com/clidey/todos-docs - deployed at https://todo-docs.docucod.com/

We’re Hemang and Anguel—friends, builders, and longtime hackathon teammates. After years working at places like Palantir, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley, we saw one issue everywhere: documentation gets rushed, postponed, or skipped—and the fallout is always the same.

We built Docucod because this isn’t a people problem—it’s a systems problem. The fix isn’t better habits. It’s automation.

> **We’re here to make documentation sexy again.**

# 🤔 Is Docucod right for you?

**Don’t use Docucod if:**

🚫 You enjoy rewriting GitHub auth instructions.

🚫 You love writing and maintaining docs by hand.

**Use Docucod if:**

✅ You want docs that stay up to date—automatically.

✅ You want new hires productive on Day 1.

✅ You’d rather ship than document.

launches.tagline: Turn your complex private data into grounded answers
launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋 We’re Adi and Arnav, co-founders of Morphik (https://morphik.ai).

### **TL;DR**

* **Problem:** Knowledge workers spend a lot of their time searching complex documentation with diagrams, tables, or spreadsheets, just to find relevant information. Text‑only RAG misses details, hallucinates, and provides half-baked responses.
* **Solution:** Morphik embeds whole pages (image + text, no OCR), auto‑builds a knowledge graph, and serves it through a UI, SDK, or REST API. We have 90 % accuracy on arXiv QA (and we can fine-tune for your use case 🙂).

Watch our demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3adZQhm5JZY

### **Problem**

RAG breaks the moment documents stop being blobs of text.

* Knowledge workers spend a lot of their time (people we spoke with said 50-70% time just in the research phase). eg. electrical engineers finding perfect PCB spec, pharma companies trying to search ELNs for similar experiments.
* 80% of enterprise knowledge lives in diagrams, tables, images, CAD, scanned pdfs, not .txt.
* “Multimodal” models still hallucinate or miss key context because the retrieval step sees only text, or they rely on tools to retrieve diagrams, or context. (https://docs.morphik.ai/blogs/gpt-vs-morphik-multimodal)
* Teams glue together OCR, vector DBs, and regex‑heavy ETL that becomes a brittle monstrosity.

### **Solution**

Directly embedding and search over page images

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdzvQJeEBmnvZI1Mkl2ZYCtsN0AG4Mx5JpcN4RtivMfndGshgTkj1uZcb8BkFAkXXNCpg9TPqeIKsqCXscaLzGDNO2e8TFn8naJPkJ_XtceDHlwNrAAcV69QGYlzSOwvdofI7FksQ?key=wmYsqYRKzN1ploJFaFpgwCeu)

When you ingest in Morphik, in addition to OCR, we create direct embeddings for the image of a page (or frames in a video). When you ask “Colpali comparison to standard RAG”, the LLM sees the actual page image, so multimodal models can reason over arrows, labels, scales, and colours just like a human.

### **Rules Engine**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcOXXa3wTpZV26zi8kaucVOt2QuUgKKfrdvlyqlFfeHmDUudWpNaS-r6KNm5--4Joz4rE5tsiu_NDqlHnRE914l7ad4YtKRRLc_X1gm7BteBR0aMN446aia7LGA1l7b2UJMor97?key=wmYsqYRKzN1ploJFaFpgwCeu)

When ingesting, you can define rules for data extraction (which would again consider tables, diagrams), or define natural language rules for PII redaction, or content transformation.

### **Deployment ready, scalable**

Morphik comes built in with folder scoping, end user scoping, GPU accelerations, and fine grained permissions, so you can prototype and deploy with enterprise grade features. It’s end‑to‑end, so you don’t scramble to make duct tape fixes.

### **One more thing…Morphik Research Agent**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcL9LvkrH861vRDhuFlYlBy0LsjlhMOYVBLRLdnj903G5L3QMgx12ziGZJhO_h2SzAakjD27e0Yeu4XZwmsE4Yv1BGNRj-OGc41i798xy_UW9MVHISzJy0GBrTsOWWqWBGdtGKhmg?key=wmYsqYRKzN1ploJFaFpgwCeu)

Our research agent uses Morphik’s retrieval, graph, and extraction APIs as tools. It chains them automatically, jumping from doc to doc, node to node, seeing figures, till it finds the needle in the haystack, or has enough context to answer your questions. “Describe the third pin on the USBC21 diagram” will get the diagram, find the pin, jump to the table with pin descriptions, jump to page 13 to “find more details on page 13”.

### **Why we might be interesting to you**

* Building an internal ChatGPT over messy manuals? Morphik is the fastest way to ship something users _trust_.
* Developing an AI product? Swap your vector‑DB‑plus‑duct‑tape stack for a single SDK call.
* Researching graph‑RAG? CAG? We have it all.

### **Our Ask 🙏**

1. **⭐ Star / watch** https://github.com/morphik-org/morphik-core – open source momentum matters.
2. **Introductions** to teams drowning in technical docs (healthcare, manufacturing, legal, electrical engineers).
3. Tell us **what still hurts in your RAG stack**, comment, **DM, or email** [founders@morphik.ai](mailto:founders@morphik.ai) or [book a call](https://cal.com/adityavardhan-agrawal-x6jyhq/30min).

Thanks for reading!

Adi & Arnav

**TL;DR**\
Hotels rarely see what guests wanted before they booked or why they didn't book at all. Anana captures the demand signals buried inside calls, chats, and emails, completing the commercial picture with the intent and friction that transaction data misses.\
\
<https://youtu.be/OxO4FR-M7lI>

## Problem

Hotels are good at measuring outcomes: bookings, revenue, channel mix, and occupancy.

But the signals that explain those outcomes are buried across thousands of guest interactions. A family asks about connecting rooms and books elsewhere. Early check-in questions suddenly double. A repeat guest mentions an anniversary.

At scale, these are commercial signals. They reveal where direct demand is breaking down, what guests repeatedly want, and where hotels can personalize, convert, or win guests back.

Most hotels have no practical way to analyze this information at scale, so the insights disappear and their dependence on third-party distribution continues.

## Solution

Anana turns these signals into a commercial intelligence layer that hotels can analyze alongside booking and operational data.

Commercial teams can see where direct demand is being lost, which guest needs and segments are emerging, and what is driving conversion. Anana then reuses that intelligence across workflows—from improving marketing and the direct booking experience to identifying revenue opportunities and personalizing a guest’s stay.

Every guest interaction becomes an input into the next commercial decision.

## Our ask

We're looking to meet hotel owners, operators, and commercial leaders at multi-property hotel groups—particularly teams responsible for revenue, marketing, distribution, reservations, or commercial strategy.\

launches.title: Theta: Self-Learning for AI Agents
launches.tagline: An Intelligent Memory Layer for Real-time Learning
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Theta is building self-learning and real-time adaptation for AI agents.

We’re starting with an intelligent memory layer so agents can remember and learn from previous interactions. With a simple four-line addition to your existing code, our memory layer uses real-time learning to analyze every run for mistakes and optimizations. The relevant insights are then passed on to your agent during future runs. 

We’ve already improved the accuracy of OpenAI Operator by 43% with 7x fewer steps taken. If you’re building AI agents where reliability and speed are priorities, book a meeting [here](https://calendly.com/d/cndj-84h-9qz) or contact us at [founders@thetasoftware.ai](mailto:founders@thetasoftware.ai).

\
https://youtu.be/TRNWfhyUI4E

### **The Current Approach**

Agents struggle to adapt to complex, real-world workflows. Workflows are dynamic, but agents remain static.

* They get stuck in loops, repeating mistakes and requiring constant human guidance in the right direction. Your prompts get longer and longer as you try to hard-code solutions.
* Even when your agent successfully completes a task, this long process starts all over again for any future run. Starting a new Cursor chat or Operator session means losing all of the insights and “aha moments” your agent had.

Learning is fundamentally iterative, but agents can’t learn because they have no memory across runs.

### **How Theta Works**

Theta is building the infrastructure for agents to self-learn and adapt in real-time. The first component is an intelligent memory layer that learns from your agent’s previous runs. Just add four lines of code to your agent stack to get started:

* At the end of the current run, Theta generates and embeds an analysis of your agent’s trajectory. It identifies critical steps and assesses overall performance.
* Before the next run, Theta generates a detailed plan based on the specified task. It gathers relevant insights and optimizations based on previous runs.
* With real-time learning, the memory layer continues to improve with more runs—meaning your agent gets better and better with zero human intervention.

Using this memory layer, we were able to improve the accuracy of OpenAI Operator by 43%. With optimized trajectories, Operator also took 7x fewer steps, resulting in better speed and cost.

### **Our Ask**

If you’re building agents that need to perform dynamic, real-world workflows at the highest accuracy and speed, reach out to [founders@thetasoftware.ai](mailto:founders@thetasoftware.ai) or book some time [here.](https://calendly.com/d/cndj-84h-9qz)

### **Our Team**

Rayan has previously done ML research as Head of Product at DeepSilicon. He’s been childhood friends with Tanmay since third grade, who previously built an AI browser and developed browser agents at MultiOn. During Rayan’s freshman year of college, he met Gurvir, who built distributed ML systems at Cornell, focusing on post-training and RL.

No more rigid scripting. No more emulator-only limits. No more test maintenance hell.

Our AI agent self-heals, handles dynamic pop-up content, navigates unexpected UI changes, and catches bugs like a pro.

**TL;DR:** We are building Cursor for Lawyers. We turn Microsoft Word into an IDE for contracts, and build agents operating in the background. Our initial focus is on Transactional Law Firms, and agents built for quality-assuring projects and documents according to the firm’s best practice.

We have already rolled out Vesence firm-wide at our first enterprise client with a lot of love from both associates and partners.

Know any Transactional Lawyers? Let’s connect: [founders@vesence.com](mailto:founders@vesence.com).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nr1Q7S6A84I

**Problem:**

Imagine programming in Apple Notes.

No linting, no cursor, you are on your own.

That is how it is for many lawyers to draft and review contracts in Microsoft Word.

At law firms, the stakes are extremely high. Every mistake can hurt your reputation badly. Associates need to deliver under time pressure, partners demand extreme attention to detail, and your clients will not accept any blunders.

Given the attention to detail needed in the work, working on complex projects under constant time pressure, we are starting with quality-assuring agents (i.e. a linting system for contracts).

The consequences of shipping "bugs" in a legal document can be catastrophic, but even the best firm still rely on manual review to catch mistakes.

**What We’ve Built**

Vesence offers quality assurance AI agents available straight in Microsoft Word to handle tasks such as:

* **Apply firm-wide Standards**: Apply writing style guides and best practices consistently across all practice groups in the firm
* **Ensure project-level alignment**: Flag inconsistencies across multiple deal documents, for example auto-checking the SPA against the original term sheet
* **Verify document consistency**: Catch defined term slips, bad cross-references, logical gaps, and miscalculations within a single document

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90570&key=user_uploads/2486274/99f83828-eeb2-4d36-9c69-e8401e4ab7b5)

“You saved me 4 hours last night.”

**Associates** love Vesence as they can produce exceptional internal deliveries under less pressure to seniors and partners. **Partners** love the tool as their teams hand them better quality work and follows the firm’s best practices.

The interest we have seen from transactional law firms is great, but we also received inbound from other professional service providers that care deeply about quality and the reputation of their firms, including Investment Banks and Management Consultants.

Basically, the holy trinity of where the ‘pls fix’ culture thrives.

launches.body:
Hi! We’re [Dmitry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dmitrykarpov/), [Sergey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yudovskiy/), and [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/odinalex/) — co-founders of [Adentris](https://www.adentris.com/).

**TL;DR:**

Every year, **250 million insurance claims — worth billions of dollars — are denied due to documentation errors**. Many are never recovered. We connect directly to hospital EHRs, monitor clinical staff activity logs in real time, and use AI agents to detect and fix compliance issues before they become risks. **Since the beginning of YC, we’ve reached $54k ARR** and have a growing number of commercial pilots with hospitals and clinics across the U.S. and PoCs with healthcare enterprises.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PrcEY8WgmSk

**Problem:**

One small documentation mistake — like recording a medication time incorrectly — can destroy a family’s finances.

These errors are often made by exhausted clinicians after 12-hour shifts and are caught by automated insurance systems that instantly deny the claim.

**Hospitals don’t discover the problem until it's too late** — after the claim is denied, the audit triggered, or the reputation damaged.

Documentation errors are the invisible threat in modern healthcare. They’re not caused by negligence, but by broken systems: cluttered interfaces, overworked staff, and legacy EHRs that make it easy to click the wrong time, forget a discharge note, or miss a required signature.

**And it’s not just claims** — these small errors lead to failed audits, regulatory fines, delayed discharges, and increased burnout.

Hospitals end up with compliance teams that are reactive — chasing mistakes days or weeks after they happened, often without resolution. The cost isn’t just money. It’s morale, trust, and patient safety.

**Solution:**

Adentris is an AI compliance autopilot that prevents small documentation errors from becoming costly disasters in real time.

We integrate directly with hospital EHRs, monitor clinical activity in real time, and use AI agents to detect and fix issues — like missed discharge notes or wrong medication times — before they trigger claim denials or audits.

When a problem is found, our AI opens a quick conversation with the responsible staff member to confirm and correct it immediately.

**We don’t just alert**. We resolve — and help hospitals run smoother, reduce pressure on teams, and recover revenue that would otherwise be lost.

**What Experts Are Saying:**

"Adentris’s proactive approach is a game‑changer in reducing preventable errors and enabling real‑time accountability in care delivery.”

— [Joel N.H. Stern, PhD](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joel-n-h-stern-07a4342/)\
Professor of Neurology & Molecular Medicine, Zucker School of Medicine at Hofstra/Northwell

**Team:**

[Dmitry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dmitrykarpov/) (CEO) and [Sergey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yudovskiy/) (CPO) are second-time YC founders with a strong track record in building B2B enterprise products and go-to-market channels. Sergey comes from a full medical family and has deep personal ties to the problems we're solving in healthcare. [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/odinalex/), (CTO), is a seasoned engineer who built apps used by 25M+ people worldwide and led the development of a full AI agent architecture at his previous multimillion-dollar startup.

**Asks:**

We're actively looking to connect with:

* **Hospital executives and clinic owners** who want to stop losing revenue to preventable compliance errors and team burnout 
* **Providers' CFOs and compliance leaders** who are tired of fighting with clinical staff over documentation and want a system that just works
* **Medical institution advisors and operators** who care about transforming broken workflows
* **Reporters and storytellers** covering the untold side of healthcare — the back office chaos that leads to financial disaster

If you're building, reporting on, or fighting to fix this problem — DM us, email us at [founders@wrkdn.com](mailto:founders@wrkdn.com), or grab 15 minutes with us here [Book a call](https://calendly.com/d/cnpv-x29-nzc/workdone-demo).

launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋 We’re Lalit and Catherine, co-founders of Pelica Health.

## **TL;DR**

Pelica is the AI operating system for value-based care. We pull claims, EHR, pharmacy, lab, and hospital feeds into **one canonical record**, then run AI copilots that read and write to it: risk adjustment, Stars and quality, pharmacy, provider network, and care management, plus an AI data analyst you can ask anything in plain English. The copilots **do the operational work themselves**: capturing HCCs in real time, closing gaps once across every payer, and making outreach calls in the member’s language. HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II, and RADV-defensible.

We’re live with a physician-led IPA in New York, one of the largest independent medical groups in the Northeast: **2,500+ hours saved** and higher CMS Star Ratings so far.

▶️ Watch their story: <https://youtu.be/2CGmyif9Yd4>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/e873acc4-f206-4eca-8617-9bf7f70f3b62)

_An AI agent works one gap end to end: provider office, pharmacy, the member in their language, the payer portal, then a live call. Closed in 3 minutes of staff time._

## **🚩 The problem**

Value-based care pays a medical group or health plan to keep a whole population healthy, and billions in CMS bonuses ride on it. The teams who own those contracts decide whether the org makes money, and they cannot operate:

• Their data lives in 8 to 15 systems. By the time a problem surfaces, the submission window has closed.

• Risk calls a member. Quality calls the same member. The practice calls again, sometimes in a language the member doesn’t speak.

• The best predictive model is worthless if it never reaches the provider.

• The rules keep moving. Hybrid HEDIS is retiring into ECDS volumes many times higher per measure, and the V28 phase-in costs the average MA plan about 3% of RAF.

Every new gap gets a new point vendor, each with its own portal, data model, and login. These teams do not need another point tool. They need an operating system.

## **🛠️ What we built**

One canonical record, with an AI workforce next to every team. Six copilots:

• **Risk Adjustment:** real-time HCC capture with trumping logic and RADV-defensible chain of custody on every code.

• **Quality and Stars:** gap closure unified across every payer, with year-round forecasting for the post-hybrid HEDIS world.

• **Pharmacy and Part D:** PDC lift on the three triple-weighted measures that move Stars the most.

• **Provider Network:** auto-built practice agendas that cut meeting prep from 90 minutes to 15.

• **Care Management:** ADT-driven transitions-of-care worklists, with no duplicate calls across teams.

• **AI Data Analyst:** plain-English questions against the record, in place of the BI ticket queue.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/13a2d9aa-5ac8-4ab4-bf2c-b61fe8bccb56)

_Risk Adjustment: the agent works the EHR and payer portals like a person and captures a defensible HCC._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/cfb57b8c-bf75-43d1-9dc3-d29da891d8e9)

_AI Data Analyst: ask your RAF in plain English, get an answer and a chart in seconds._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/4bbf9afb-abc0-4221-9e5b-bf4602654e32)

_Provider Network: reps walk in prepped, and the visit is captured into tasks automatically._

It runs on the systems VBC teams already use: Epic, Cerner, Athena, eCW, payer SFTP, PBM feeds, ADT, and labs, with SMART-on-FHIR overlays in Epic and Athena. A new source onboards in days, and the copilots start working the day after.

## **📈 Early proof**

That physician-led IPA went from three uncoordinated calls per member to one outreach, in the right language, that closed three gaps at once. No new headcount. One of their leaders put it simply: “You don’t just get software, you get partners.”

## **👫 Why us**

Catherine and I met at YouTube and have built large-scale systems together since. We saw the same gap from two sides: clinical AI that could not operate, and operations software that could not reason clinically.

• **Catherine** led AI work on Gemini and enterprise agents at Google, did clinical AI research at Stanford School of Medicine, and saw front-line care at clinics in California and New Hampshire. BA in Computer Science from Dartmouth.

• **Lalit** spent 8 years building software for regulated industries at Google and YouTube, most recently as engineering and ML lead on YouTube Payments, running a 45-person team on products driving $16B+ in revenue. Wharton MBA, ACM-ICPC World Finalist.

Backed by Y Combinator, SurgePoint Capital, Upside Partnership, ISEED Ventures, and Progressive Ventures.

## **🙏 Our ask**

• Warm intros to VPs of Risk Adjustment, Stars, Quality, or Pharmacy at MA plans, IPAs, MSOs, or ACOs.

• Intros to ACO executive directors running MSSP or REACH.

• If you run risk-bearing contracts at a health plan, IPA, MSO, ACO, or medical group, email [lalit@pelica.com](mailto:lalit@pelica.com) or book a demo at cal.com/pelica/pelica.
