launches.tagline: Transform Value Based Care with AI Agents
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋 we're [Lalit](http://linkedin.com/in/lalitkundu) & [Catherine](http://linkedin.com/in/cat-catherine-zhao), co-founders of [Pelica Health](https://pelica.com).

## TL;DR

**🚀 Pelica is the operating system for value-based care.** One canonical record across claims, EHR, pharmacy, lab, and ADT, with six AI copilots reading and writing to it. Risk adjustment, Stars, pharmacy, network, care management, plus an AI Data Analyst. HIPAA-compliant, RADV-defensible, real-time.

Use Pelica to:

* Capture HCCs in real time, before the submission window closes
* Close Stars gaps once, across every payer, with no duplicate outreach
* Lift PDC on the three triple-weighted measures that move Stars more than anything else
* Replace 8 to 15 point vendors with one shared record
* Cut per-practice meeting prep from 90 minutes to 15

**VBC teams using Pelica run risk, quality, pharmacy, and care management from one record**. A physician-led IPA in New York went from three uncoordinated calls per member to one outreach in the right language that closed three gaps at once. No new headcount.

If you run risk-bearing contracts at a health plan, IPA, MSO, ACO, or medical group, email [lalit@pelica.com](mailto:lalit@pelica.com) or book a demo at [cal.com/pelica](https://cal.com/pelica/pelica-demo).

## 🚩 The Problem

VBC teams own the contracts that decide whether the org makes money. They cannot operate. Today:

* Data lives in 12 places. By the time a problem surfaces, the submission window has closed.
* Risk calls a member. Quality calls the same member. The practice calls again. Sometimes in a language the member doesn't speak.
* The best predictive model is useless if it never reaches the provider.
* Hybrid HEDIS is retiring. ECDS volumes run 35 to 75 times higher per measure. The old infra was not built for it.
* V28 phase-in finishes in 2026. The average MA plan loses roughly 3% of RAF.

Point vendors keep stacking up. One for retrospective coding. One for HEDIS. One for adherence. One for ADT. Each with its own portal, its own data model, its own login.

VBC teams need more than another point tool. They need an operating system.

## 🛠️ Our Solution

We built Pelica, an AI operating system for value-based care. Three layers, six copilots, one canonical record.

* **🌐 HIPAA + SOC 2 Type II:** Tenant-isolated, encrypted end-to-end, zero-retention with every LLM provider in use.
* **🔌 Connects to every system:** Epic, Cerner, Athena, eCW, payer SFTP, PBM feeds, ADT, labs. SMART-on-FHIR overlays in Epic and Athena.
* **⚡ Live in weeks, not quarters:** A new data source onboards in days. Copilots start working the day after.

What Pelica can do:

* **🧾 Risk Adjustment Copilot:** Real-time HCC capture with trumping logic, MAO-004 awareness, and RADV-defensible chain-of-custody on every code.
* **⭐ Quality & Stars Copilot:** Unified gap closure across every payer, with year-round glide-path forecasting for the post-hybrid HEDIS world.
* **💊 Pharmacy & Part D Copilot:** PDC lift on the three triple-weighted measures. The 5 points that separate 4-star from 2-star.
* **🤝 Provider Network Copilot:** Auto-generated practice agendas. Meeting prep from 90 minutes to 15.
* **🏥 Care Management Copilot:** ADT-driven TOC worklists, 5-day follow-up tracking, no duplicate calls across teams.
* **📊 AI Data Analyst:** Plain-English questions against the canonical record. Replaces the BI ticket queue.

A Director of Risk Adjustment told us: "**Our data lives in twelve places. By the time we know there's a problem, the submission window has closed**." A Stars Program Manager told us: "We are solving the same problem five times." Same root cause. One shared record fixes both.

## 👫 The Team

Catherine and Lalit met at YouTube and have been building large-scale systems together ever since. They saw the same gap from two sides: clinical AI that could not operate, and operations AI that could not reason clinically.

**Catherine led AI work on Gemini and enterprise AI agents at Google**. She did clinical AI research at Stanford School of Medicine and saw front-line patient care at clinics in California and New Hampshire. BA in Computer Science from Dartmouth.

**Lalit spent 8 years building software for regulated industries at Google and YouTube**. He was Engineering and ML lead on YouTube Payments, running a 45-plus person team in Commerce Billing on products driving $16B+ in revenue. Wharton MBA. ACM-ICPC World Finalist.

Backed by Y Combinator, SurgePoint Capital, Upside Partnership, ISEED Ventures, and Progressive Ventures.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90407&key=user_uploads/1494518/dc1935e3-d2b0-4d83-9f63-b5cd8ae73e7b)

## Asks

* Intros to VPs of Risk Adjustment, Stars, Quality, or Pharmacy at MA plans, IPAs, MSOs, or ACOs.
* Intros to ACO executive directors running MSSP or REACH.
* Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/pelica-health), [X](https://x.com/pelica_health), and learn more at [pelica.com](https://pelica.com).

Outbound: Warm leads, dormant customers, and unworked estimates get proactively contacted - driving repeat jobs, cross-sells, upsells, and referrals without adding headcount.

The $150B home services industry is still running on voicemail and spreadsheets. We're building the system that changes that - one answered call at a time.

launches.title: StarSling Runners - Self-Driving CI
launches.tagline: Fast GitHub Actions runners with AI agents that continuously improve your CI to make it up to 6x faster and 13x cheaper.
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We're Yonas & Daniel, co-founders of [StarSling](https://www.starsling.dev).

**TL;DR: [StarSling Runners](https://starsling.dev/)** are an AI-native drop-in replacement for ubuntu-latest that continuously make your CI up to **6x faster** and **13x cheaper**. On day one, StarSling Runners are faster and cheaper. From there, AI agents analyze your pipelines and continuously ship optimization PRs.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IxcYY5cuSXA>

**🤔 Why now**

Coding agents made writing code dramatically faster, and they’ve pushed PR volume up, which compounds CI times and cost fast.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104233&key=user_uploads/7866/2149565f-569b-4f8d-b4b3-9eab341daf0f)

Everyone has the option of getting fast CI runners now. What nobody has is **CI that adapts and improves itself**.

Meanwhile, keeping a CI pipeline fast is a constant manual chore: caches break, tests get flaky, build steps pile up, and someone has to notice and fix it, over and over. We believe DevOps tooling like CI should be as agentic as coding is, and that's the unlock behind self-driving CI: the optimization work that used to be a recurring human task now runs continuously in the background as part of the infrastructure running it.

**🔥 The problem**

Keeping CI fast is nobody's job and everybody's problem:

* **Pipelines rot.** Caches get misconfigured, dependency installs get slow, tests turn flaky, build steps stop being parallel. Performance quietly degrades until someone carves out time to fix it.
* **Fast runners alone don't solve it.** Swapping in faster hardware helps once, then your setup drifts right back as you add more code and tests and they get more complex. Plenty of products give you faster runners. None of them keep your pipeline optimized for you.
* **It's getting worse.** Recent GitHub Actions pricing changes hit teams running lots of jobs, and GitHub's focus has clearly moved elsewhere. When we surveyed companies looking for DevOps AI solutions, a GitHub Actions agent was the single most-requested solution engineers wanted.

**🧯 The solution: self-driving CI**

StarSling Runners are an AI-native, drop-in replacement for ubuntu-latest\
that get faster the longer you use them:

* **Fast infrastructure on day one.** 5th Gen AMD EPYC (\~30% faster than GitHub), actions/cache compatible with zero config, unlimited concurrency.
* **AI agents that optimize your CI for you.** Agents continuously scan your workflows, jobs, run logs, and machine telemetry, then open optimization PRs: fixing caching, speeding up dependency installs, parallelizing build steps, sharding tests, and restructuring workflows. This is the part nobody else does. Real PRs our agents opened and customers merged: [sharding E2E tests across 3 parallel jobs](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/15888) (Mastra), [optimizing Playwright browser installs](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/8073) and [fixing turbo cache config](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/7950) (Better Auth).
* **Cheaper, with no surprises.** $0.008/min vs GitHub's $0.012/min (33% cheaper), queue time never billed, no seat fees.
* **You stay in control.** Every agent-authored optimization ships as a PR your team reviews and merges.
* **Secure by default.** Every job runs in its own single-use, hardware-isolated microVM that's destroyed after the run, the same isolation model GitHub-hosted runners use. Secrets pass directly from GitHub to your job and are never stored by StarSling.
* **One-line install.** Install the [StarSling GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/starslingdev) and copy our AI install prompt to swap ubuntu-latest\
  for starsling-ubuntu-24.04. You're on faster runners immediately, with 2,000 free minutes your first month. The optimization agents are in early access right now, so request access and we'll turn them on for your repos. **👇**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104233&key=user_uploads/7866/a91c193f-d5e1-4d00-a93c-1dfd6381666b)

**📈 Traction**

After being in private beta for the past four months, StarSling has now run over **one million CI jobs** for fast-moving teams like Better Auth, Mastra, Partcl, and more, and the self-driving AI agents is what won them over:

* [**Mastra**](https://starsling.dev/customers/mastra) got **6x faster** CI:
  * _"The runners are just handled, so nobody on my team thinks about CI infrastructure anymore, and the agents keep optimizing for the one thing I care about: minutes saved."_ - Abhi Aiyer, Co-founder & CTO at Mastra (YC W25)
* [**Better Auth**](https://starsling.dev/customers/better-auth) got **2x faster** E2E:
  * _"StarSling agents are like a CI engineer we never had to hire. They find the slow spots, test out fixes, find the ones that work and open the PRs themselves."_ - Bereket Engida, Founder & CEO at Better Auth (P25)
* [**Partcl**](https://starsling.dev/customers/partcl) got **13x cheaper** CI, and the agents proved themselves on day one:
  * _"Within a day of migrating to StarSling Runners, their agents opened up a PR that literally made our Rust CI tests 2x faster!"_ - Vamshi Balanaga, Co-founder & CTO at Partcl (YC P25)

Full case studies: <https://starsling.dev/customers>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104233&key=user_uploads/7866/10826f60-8e4d-41a8-a800-32026a78bfc8)


**🏋️ Team**

**Daniel** led the 12-person engineering team at Netflix that built their Internal Developer Portal ("Netflix Console"), the central hub for Netflix's 3,000+ engineers and the highest-DAU internal developer tool at the company. Before Netflix he was on Facebook's AI Camera team, building computer vision that powers camera effects for 100M+ DAUs across Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp.

**Yonas** built StackShare, one of the largest online developer communities (1.5M+ registered developers), with an enterprise offering used by Fortune 500s to surface tech stack data across thousands of internal codebases. StackShare was acquired by FOSSA in 2024.

We've spent our careers on developer tools, and self-driving CI is the first part of a suite of tools we always wished we had.

**🔮 Vision**

DevOps should be as agentic as coding. CI is just the start. We're building toward a world where your entire pipeline improves on its own and AI agents take on the slow, manual engineering work that’s left after your coding agents finish, across the whole SDLC, so your team ships faster.

**👇 Our ask**

* **Try it.** If your team runs CI on ubuntu-latest, you're a one line change away from faster runs: <https://starsling.dev>. YC companies get 50% off the first year.
* **Intros.** If you know a CTO or VP Eng at a company drowning in CI time or cost, we'd love an intro: 📧 [founders@starsling.dev](mailto:founders@starsling.dev)

Happy Slinging!

\- Yonas & Daniel

launches.tagline: Agentic internal developer portal that automates your tasks across deployments, performance, incidents, and bugs
launches.body:
Hey everyone! 

We’re Yonas & Daniel - Co-founders of [StarSling](https://www.starsling.dev).

StarSling (https://starsling.dev) is a developer portal that turns your daily unplanned work from all your dev tools into one-click actions, powered by AI. Open your homepage, click on a GitHub, Linear, or Sentry issue and you’ll see an Autofix button that triggers an agent and opens a Pull Request with a fix, all without leaving your portal. It’s AI agents for the tasks that live outside of your code editor, across deployments, performance, incidents, and bugs.

https://youtu.be/-rbrSNyguHY 

**🌄 Our Story**

Daniel led an engineering team at Netflix that built their Internal Developer Portal (IDP), called Netflix Console. It was the central hub for Netflix's 3,000+ engineers, managers and leaders and became the highest DAU internal tool for developers at Netflix.

Yonas built StackShare, one of the largest online developer communities that had over 1.5M registered developers and an enterprise offering used by thousands of companies that integrated tech stack data into their IDPs and other internal tools.

Both of us have seen the challenges that developers at large companies face in keeping their tech stacks healthy across thousands of codebases. We’ve also seen the benefits that a high-quality single IDP brings to engineering teams. We believe that AI agents have created a unique opportunity for developers to get the benefits of an IDP with automation baked in from the start.

**🔥 The Problem**

Developers typically spend \~20% of their time on annoying eng tasks outside of their code editor:

* Fixing exceptions
* Patching flaky CI builds and tests
* Updating engineering docs and changelogs
* Investigating and remediating incidents
* Optimizing slow database queries
* Debugging preview and staging environments
* Rotating expiring credentials and keys

These tasks are spread out across many different developer tools and workflows: Sentry, GitHub, CircleCI, PagerDuty, Supabase, Vercel and many more. StarSling is unifying these tools and bringing AI agents to the rest of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).\
**🧯 Our Solution**

We're building a system of AI agents that perform engineering tasks using the deep context that only exists in an internal developer portal (IDP). One central command center that houses internal services, applications, APIs, documentation and has AI agents continuously improving them. We bring your tools into one system and give you powerful workflows by orchestrating AI agents across these tools.

Our first offering is an agentic developer homepage that shows you your aggregated task list along with actions that AIs can take on your behalf. In your homepage you’ll see: your open PRs, exceptions, tickets, notifications, and more alongside AI agents.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90469&key=user_uploads/7866/d4f9f3c3-e7b9-485b-9920-3d04e80d385f)

Soon StarSling will orchestrate agents across the more complex tasks like investigating incidents. Our immediate goal is to be the interface and “portal” to all the AI agents for the dev tools you already use.

**🔮 Our Vision**

To create a system of AI agents that allows every engineer to spend close to 0% of their time dealing with deployments, performance, incidents, and bugs.

**👇 Our Ask**

If you’re a developer working on a production system, we’d love to show you StarSling and get your feedback!

👉 Signup for the waitlist: https://starsling.dev

📧 Email us: [founders@starsling.dev](mailto:founders@starsling.dev)

launches.body:
**TL;DR**

**Docket lets you write tests in plain English. Then we keep those tests in sync with how users actually interact with your product — no more flaky selectors or stale test scripts.**

---

### **The Problem**

E2E tests are a _pain_ to write — and an even bigger pain to maintain.

* Writing Cypress or Playwright tests is time-consuming and brittle
* Even no-code tools require manually defining flows or relying on flaky CSS selectors
* Every UI change risks breaking your suite, forcing teams to either spend hours fixing tests or just give up and test manually

Most teams hit the same tradeoff: **move fast and break things** — or slow down to ensure quality.

### **Our Solution**

Docket lets you:

* Write tests in plain English ("Log in, Search for Y Combinator t shirt, Add 2 shirts to cart")
* Skip the brittle selectors — we use multimodal agents that interact with the page like humans
* Automatically keep tests up to date with real user session data

---

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90473&key=user_uploads/296302/5977d1c3-f564-4d67-b623-319bb6252efd)

### **Meet the Team**

We’re **Nishant** and **Boris** — two engineers who dreaded writing tests so much, we started a company to fix it.

We met while working at **AWS**, and between us, we’ve built and shipped products at **Stripe, Citadel, Brex, and Patreon**. But testing was always the drag. Writing tests took forever. Keeping them working was even worse. We constantly felt the pain of choosing between moving fast and having confidence in our code.

So we’re building the tool we wish we had: **Docket** — tests in plain English that stay up to date, without the maintenance burden.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90473&key=user_uploads/296302/f2b9cf37-f50c-4c40-8ca9-6a43d5069a0b)

---

### **Launch Offer**

As part of our launch, we’re offering **free complete test suite implementations** for our next 10 customers. Book a demo [here](https://calendly.com/nishant-docket/docket-intro-meeting)!

\
— Nishant & Boris

launches.title: truthsystems: AI Governance Agent for Regulated Industries

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdVRq9G6zxM14SvFxiMBUF0pK8ArLuZpJJePm0rkpzFPHtEaCYoGI4uz_9DnEJ7YYY4QM5FsGVm5DOO3Ja05maM1DW0_2TQHPom4vPTWbbpDuMg3qZNbtmYD9hOeyZZnu8OFh2muQ?key=RHZIlJDEf1i3HROkoIzKug)

## **💬 TL;DR: GenAI introduces compliance & governance nightmares to all firms in regulated industries. We solve this by building an AI governance agent that monitors AI use and flags potential policy violations to end users.**

## **💬 The Problem**

Law firms, banks, and other firms in regulated industries want to use more AI, but doing so without robust governance tools risks compliance breaches and client trust loss.

The problem is most acute in law firms, which we observed firsthand as AI researchers at Stanford Law School. **It stems from three primary challenges:**

* **Unmanaged Liability:** There is no room for mistakes at law firms. Simple actions, such as uploading confidential files to AI tools or relying on AI-generated citations, can result in millions of dollars' worth of breaches and, more importantly, erode client trust.
* **No Operational Control:** Firms can't see or control how employees use different AI tools, and they have no way to enforce the policies they write. 
* **Conflicting Client Mandates:** One client may require prior written approval for all AI tools, another might forbid their data on a specific matter from leaving the country, and a third bans AI entirely. Manually enforcing these unique rules for every client and their respective matter is impossible.

**The result:** Firms hesitate to fully embrace AI, fearing reputational damage and costly mistakes; many ban AI or have already paid millions for errors discovered too late.

**🏆 The Solution**

Truth Systems provides firms with a compliance AI agent that reads firm policies and client guidelines, then converts them into dynamic guardrails that can be enforced on top of all AI usage

Here’s an example of how it works:

[Truth Systems - August 2025 Demo](https://www.loom.com/share/7cb045b4d9134727936f25dec2083c0f)

## **🖖 Why We Build Truth Systems**

We are a team of AI nerds, researchers, and product builders who believe that responsible deployment of technology is the key to unlocking meaningful innovation in regulated industries.

Our co-founders, [Alex Mac](mailto:alex@truthsystems.ai) and [Nam Nguyen](mailto:nam.nguyen@truthsystems.ai), were childhood best friends and AI researchers at Stanford Law under Dr. Megan Ma, collaborating with top law firms to address their concerns about this technology. Our founding engineer, Mikolaj Bochenski, was the 2nd hire at Legora, one of the largest Legal AI companies in the world, and understands intrinsically how legal AI is built and deployed. 

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdbC9GGtu-LK9MRGBCZ221JfsrfUvbLH0mwzGkSbLxxc6uVoBNvQrpedx3mIwvKClEP_K388qiV0_BoOYrYv29ysqqYI375twgSmROoTYp5Dd36Q33W5Fl0wQkgge5OTfn3TihV0g?key=RHZIlJDEf1i3HROkoIzKug)

We’re already working with two law firms with $2 billion in revenue combined, and helping nearly 1,500 attorneys use generative AI safely and responsibly. 

## **📈 The Opportunity**

Our vision is to continue being the leading software that governs all AI use in regulated industries. Law firms are only the first steps for us. They are trusted advisors on governance and an important customer that helps us expand into other regulated industries. We envision a future where every knowledge professional can confidently and safely adopt the latest AI capabilities.

## **⭐ Our Ask**

We are live and are onboarding law firms daily. If you know any:

* Lawyers, Innovation folks, or Governance/ Info Sec Teams at Big Law, we should talk to
* Front-end Devs who are passionate about cracking the hardest security problems in regulated industries

 

Please drop us a note at [nam.nguyen@truthsystems.ai](mailto:nam.nguyen@truthsystems.ai)

Many thanks for your support! ❤️

name: OnDeck AI
long_description:
OnDeck is the infrastructure layer that makes Vision Language Models accessible and scalable for enterprise. Our model, Perception-0, let organizations instantly find any object, behavior or event, in any footage, without needing to train a model or collect any training data.

The Pain: Creating vision models usually takes months: collecting training data, training, then deployment.  Worse yet: 
+ it’s often impossible to get enough data for a specific task, and 
+ even the best cv models struggle to generalize across diverse camera setups, workflows and environments. 

To overcome these blockers, we bet early on the power of VLMs and built a vision engine that can generalize across any task and doesn’t need any training data. We published a NeurIPS workshop paper showing our new methods with VLMs beat traditional CV even at niche tasks. Now, our model Perception-0 beats the best VLMs including Gemini at long video understanding.

Our current customers include:
- National Defense Organizations
- Robotics Research
- Security cameras
- Behaviour analysis for port monitoring
- Off-shore oil & gas monitoring

launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re Alexander and Sepand, cofounders of [OnDeck AI](https://ondeckai.com).

### TL;DR

OnDeck lets you analyze any video, without training a model. Instantly find any event, behaviour, or object without needing any training data.

### Ask:

**Do you know anyone who needs to analyze tons of video or imagery? Please introduce us!**  [alexander@ondeck-ai.com](mailto:alexander@ondeck-ai.com)

\[[https://youtu.be/MafiM94IkV8\\\]](https://youtu.be/MafiM94IkV8%5C%5D)

### The Pain:

Creating vision models can take months of engineering time: collecting training data, training, then deployment.  Worse yet: 

* it’s often impossible to get enough data for a specific task, and 
* even the best cv models struggle to generalize across diverse camera setups, workflows and environments.

 

### Our Magic:

To overcome these blockers, we bet early on the power of VLMs and built a vision engine that can generalize across any task and doesn’t need any training data. We **published a NeurIPS workshop paper** showing our new methods with VLMs beat traditional CV even at niche tasks.

Why this is good:

* We never train on customer data, unlocking sensitive use cases.
* Deploy instantly and skip months of R&D.
* Identify things that have never been seen before.
* Unlike traditional cv, OnDeck can **_understand_** qualitative behaviour and sequences of events.

This summer we’ve analyzed thousands of hours of footage across:

* Fleets of Autonomous Surface Vessels 
* Robotics Research
* Security cameras 
* Behaviour analysis for port monitoring
* Off-shore oil & gas monitoring

### The Team:

Sepand (CTO) has a Master in ML from Cambridge and worked at the European Space Agency, Amazon, and swarm robotics research labs. We both studied cs in university together and we’ve been best friends since grade 6. We originally started OnDeck to automate fisheries monitoring (counting fish in video 🐠). We generated six-figure revenue before pivoting in January.

**Frizzle is an official [White House](https://www.whitehouse.gov/edai/) partner for bringing AI into education!**

**❌ The Problem**

Teaching is one of the most important jobs in society, yet teachers are among the most overworked professionals. Many work 50–70 hours a week, often grading late into the night and on weekends.

Across the U.S., there’s a national teacher shortage where 1 in 8 teaching roles remain unfilled. Superintendents and principals consistently mention that teacher time is now their most valuable resource. But teachers lose 10+ hours every week just grading math assignments, time that could be spent supporting students. 25% of all their work is spent grading!

Existing grading tools handle essays or multiple-choice questions, but fail with math, especially handwritten step-by-step work. Classrooms are also moving back to pen and paper, but teachers are left with more paperwork than ever and no scalable way to manage it.

This has created a massive bottleneck in the classroom, adding to burnout and pushing talented teachers out of the profession.

Until now…

**✅ Our Solution**

At Frizzle, we’re a team of former math nerds and AI experts building the first system that actually handles math grading at scale.

Teachers simply upload or snap a photo of student work and instantly get back:

* **Accurate grading** ✏️: Every step graded in seconds, whether it’s handwritten or typed.
* **Actionable insights** 📊: A class dashboard highlighting where each student is struggling across assignments.
* **Student-friendly feedback** 🧑‍🏫: Clear explanations that help students learn from their mistakes, not just see a score.

launches.tagline: Build yourself an AI coworker that actually takes work off your plate
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Local coding agents can't do real end-to-end work at your company. Proliferate is the open-source, self-hostable platform for building company-specific background agents that can. Agents get their own sandboxes with secure access to your internal services, trigger from any event, and expose a live, multiplayer preview so your team can verify the work together. MIT licensed.

**Star the repo:** <https://github.com/proliferate-ai/proliferate>

**Get started self-hosting:** <https://docs.proliferate.com/>

**Sign up for self-serve waitlist:** <https://proliferate.com/waitlist>

**The Problem**

Coding agents today hit a wall the second they need to do real work. Fixing an actual bug means querying your staging database, reading internal Datadog logs, hitting proprietary APIs. You can't hand those keys to a generic cloud SaaS agent.

So you run agents locally. But that ties up your machine, forces you to babysit a terminal, and traps all the context on your laptop where nobody else can see it.

The most forward-looking engineering orgs- Stripe, Ramp, coinbase- spent months building custom infrastructure to solve this. Some are now merging 50+% of their PRs with agents.

Proliferate open-sources that infrastructure so every team can do the same.

**What teams use Proliferate for:**

* **On-call triage:** Sentry exception fires → agent reproduces the issue in a cloud sandbox → writes a fix → shares a live preview link in Slack for the team to verify.
* **Flaky test sweeps:** Cron job runs overnight → agent isolates flaky CI tests by running them 1,000x → PR is waiting by morning.
* **Mass migrations:** Bump React versions or internal API contracts across 50 microservices and fix the resulting breaking changes- automatically.
* **Team verification:** Agent gets a feature 80% done. Instead of reading the diff, the team clicks a live preview URL. A developer jumps into the shared terminal to fix the last failing test. Feature is merged.

**Demo: [https://youtu.be/H84HrOJx4QM](https://youtu.be/H84HrOJx4QM)**

**What makes it different**

Every agent gets its own sandbox with your Docker containers running, secure access to your internal services via our action catalog, and can be configured to respond to any trigger. Your code and data stay in your control- fully self-hostable, MIT licensed.

Another large difference comes with how your team interacts with the work. Reading AI-generated code is tedious. So every session produces a live UR. Sessions are multiplayer. Anyone on the team can jump in, check logs, or steer the agent in real-time.

**Our ask:** ⭐ Star the repo- we just open-sourced it. <https://github.com/proliferate-ai/proliferate>

If you're tired of handholding local agents and want to move them to the background with real infrastructure access, reach out. We're working closely with a handful of teams to help improve their engineering velocity and adoption of AI. [Book a demo](https://cal.com/team/proliferate/demo) or email [pablo@proliferate.com](mailto:pablo@proliferate.com).

---

# **TL;DR**

**Stockline** is an **AI-native ERP** for food wholesalers — automating manual order entry and replacing their clunky software from the 90s.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92425&key=user_uploads/2131140/29e05c95-954b-4073-9a4c-32fa93e0e7a2)

---

# **WHY WE CARE**

Mariem’s father is a fish wholesaler. 🐟 Back in high school, she spent her summers helping him — and watched him waste hours every day retyping orders, chasing invoices, and drowning in paperwork. ✏️

That’s where the idea was born.

Mariem and Moncef met at **École Polytechnique** in France, where we went through years of military training, rigorous math, and team projects.

We were both admitted to **MIT** and **Stanford**, but chose to focus on **Stockline’s mission**: bringing tech to an industry long overlooked by digital transformation.

---

Most food wholesalers still rely on software from the 90s.

One symptom among many: **Orders come in through WhatsApp, SMS, email, or phone calls — and get retyped manually into their ERP.**

Admin work takes over.\
Headcount grows just to keep up with repetitive tasks.\
From quoting to delivery, everything is **manual, error-prone, and slow**.

They barely use data. **Prices are set by instinct**, with no visibility into stock or margins. And most tools out there just don’t match how they actually work.

This leads to:\
→ Mistakes\
→ Tight margins\
→ Food waste

---

# **THE SOLUTION**

**Stockline replaces outdated ERPs with AI at the core.** The game-changer? **No more manual data entry**.

Our AI captures orders from every channel — **WhatsApp, SMS, email, even phone calls** — and feeds them straight into one unified system.

We centralize:\
• Communication (WhatsApp, emails, SMS…)\
• Operations (billing, inventory, CRM…)

Once you have all the data in one interface, the sky’s the limit! And the broader vision is to rethink ERPs entirely so that wholesalers finally get to focus on what really matters:\

Most teams lose ≈ 40% of their productivity on repetitive manual tasks. 

Routine work like chasing updates, filling docs, coordinating teams, and handling support drains hours, breaks focus, and slows execution.

launches.body:
**TL;DR**

We are Lovable, but better because the backends we generate actually work and are easy to debug and evolve.

https://youtu.be/bjpR5A-Ib6k

## Who We Are

We're Alessia and Elia, Computer Science and Data Science graduates from Stanford and ETH Zürich. We've spent years as full-stack engineers building no-code tools that empower non-technical users to create complex systems. Now we're using that experience to help anyone become a full-stack developer through AI.

## The Problem

Prompt-to-app tools like Lovable are incredible at generating beautiful frontends, but they completely fall apart when you need real business logic, integrations, or debugging capabilities.

Here's what every developer using these tools faces:

* **Black box backends:** you can't see or understand what the AI actually built for your server-side logic
* **Debugging nightmare:** when something breaks, you're stuck re-prompting the LLM and hoping it magically fixes the issue
* **Integration hell:** you're forced to manually stitch together Lovable + n8n + Supabase + other tools, creating fragile workflows that break easily and are painful to maintain

This affects thousands of developers who want to build real applications but get stuck when they move beyond simple prototypes.

## Our Solution

VibeFlow transforms prompts into full-stack applications where every single component, frontend AND backend, is visible, understandable, and editable.

### How it works:

* **Visual Backend Editor:** See and edit your app's backend logic like you'd design a UI in Figma. You can edit visually or continue using prompts.
* **Transparent AI Generation:** Unlike other tools, you can see and understand what the AI built, making debugging straightforward
* **Powerful Integrations:** Built-in database and prewired service connections, no external tools required.
* **All-in-One Platform:** Build, debug, deploy, and maintain everything in one cohesive environment

## How We Got Here

We saw builders doing hacky workarounds, connecting n8n and Supabase to power Lovable frontends, creating Frankenstein apps where they didn't even own half the pieces. People were desperate for backend control but stuck with fragmented solutions.

### Get in Touch

* **Build your full-stack app with VibeFlow**: https://app.vibeflow.ai/

* **Book a 15-min call**: https://vibeflow.cal.com/founders/15min (we'll help you build something cool!)

Ready to build full-stack apps that actually work? Try VibeFlow today and see the difference transparent AI development makes!

Hey everyone, we're the team behind [**mcp-use**](https://github.com/mcp-use/mcp-use), the open-source MCP framework with **10k GitHub stars** and **\~10M+ downloads**.

[**Manufact**](https://manufact.com/) is the cloud platform that gets your product onto the **Claude Connectors marketplace** and the **ChatGPT (Codex) Plugin Store** via MCP.

<https://youtu.be/Pyh_3tKDXuU>

## The problem

Paul Graham recently tweeted: "_AI apps are the new browsers_". \
Your customers now do most of their work inside Claude and ChatGPT, and the connector marketplaces are a new distribution channel: someone installs your product in one click and uses it inside the chat they already live in.

We listed Manufact on Claude and saw a **surge of signups** that is still going on now.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107462&key=user_uploads/859771/65a0b3fd-75cf-4eea-a2ee-02590e3256ba)

But shipping a production-ready MCP server is its own project:

* MCP is a protocol evolving fast .
* Auth is easy to get [wrong](https://manufact.com/blog/authentication).
* Every client behaves differently.
* The stores have their own conformance requirements, and review can block you for weeks.

## How Manufact works

Manufact is the cloud built specifically for MCP:

* **Push to deploy.** Connect the GitHub App once and [every commit ships a new version of your MCP server](https://manufact.com/platform/hosting), with a preview deployment for each PR.
* **Test every MCP tool and MCP-UI widget** in the [cloud inspector](https://manufact.com/platform/cloud-inspector).
* **Know the moment your MCP breaks** in ChatGPT or Claude with [automatic cross-client testing](https://manufact.com/platform/cross-client-testing).
* [**Publishing checklists**](https://manufact.com/platform/publishing-checks) so your MCP app doesn't get stuck in marketplace review.
* **Auto-generated submission assets** (logo, copy, screenshots).
* **Analytics, session replay, and traces** built in for MCP, so you can see [how it's used and why tools fail](https://manufact.com/platform/analytics).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107462&key=user_uploads/859771/ee30e016-9fb5-4958-890f-74febc54de3c)

## Your product's UI inside the chat

A plain MCP server lets the agent read and write your data. \
An **MCP App** goes further: it's an MCP server that can return a UI as the result of a tool call, so your actual product interface renders inside Claude or ChatGPT. The user sees your charts and forms instead of a wall of text.

Ferruccio Balestreri (Amplitude) [put it well](https://x.com/0xferruccio/status/2028966278971670979):

> since mcp ui was released in claude we got a 2x boost in retention.

With the [mcp-use SDK](https://github.com/mcp-use/mcp-use) you write a normal React component, drop it in, and it registers as an MCP UI resource automatically.

## Backstory

We've been building on MCP since the protocol shipped. It started with the mcp-use SDK, the full-stack framework for MCP servers and apps. We kept watching companies struggle to take those servers to production, so we built the cloud for it (mcp-use is to Manufact what Next.js is to Vercel).

Manufact is now the **#1 recommended deployment option in OpenAI's docs.** 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107462&key=user_uploads/859771/ddba2350-67c4-43d5-8150-30847d4375a2)

We've helped startups from recent YC batches like **AgentMail** and **Item** get onto the Claude Connectors marketplace, and larger companies in finance, insurance, and marketplaces run their MCP apps on Manufact in production.

## Our asks

1. Have an MCP server? **Deploy it on [Manufact](https://manufact.com/)**.
2. Thinking about building an MCP App? [Copy our prompt for agents](https://manufact.com/prompt.md) and your coding agent will guide you.
3. Trying to get listed on the marketplaces? [Book a call with us](https://cal.com/team/manufact/chat). We have publishing checks and direct contacts on the MCP teams at Anthropic and OpenAI.

Hope to see your MCP on [manufact.com](http://manufact.com), or that you at least learned something new. 🙂

One codebase, deployed everywhere users and agents already live: the ChatGPT Apps Store, Claude Connectors, Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code, and more.

<https://cal.com/team/manufact/chat> \
or shoot a message to us: +1 (628) 899-2498 \

### **Our story**

When MCP came out, we couldn't believe such a powerful protocol was locked into IDEs and Claude Desktop.

So we built mcp-use, the open source framework that lets any developer build MCP Apps and Servers in code, in a structured and composable way.

It got adopted fast: 7M+ downloads across Python and TypeScript, almost 10k GitHub stars, and dev teams at top companies shipping with it.

But OSS is only half the story. Once teams had something working, they hit the wall every infra team knows: deployment, auth, secrets, observability, scaling. Stitching that together for MCP is a multi-week project. That's what Manufact solves.

### **Make something agents want**

MCP unlocks something most products have never had access to before: real estate inside ChatGPT and Claude.

800M+ users already spend their day in those chats. \
With MCP, a product can show up there as a native app or connector, with no separate UI to build, no app to install, no new login flow. \
The user just asks, and your product does the work.

### **Problem**

The catch is that "build once, ship everywhere" is its own infra problem. ChatGPT Apps, Claude Connectors, Gemini, and the long tail of agent surfaces (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenAI Agents, Mastra, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) each have their own quirks, auth flows, and submission requirements. Manufact lets you build one codebase and ship it to all of them.

### **What Manufact does**

Connect your MCP repo once. Every push auto-deploys.

3. **Publish.** Get your app in front of users in the ChatGPT Apps Store and Claude Connectors. Submission assets, marketplace checklists, and an embeddable chat widget for your own site, docs, or campaign pages.
4. **Iterate.** Cloud Inspector debugs from any browser against real clients. Swap models. Run evals on every deploy.
5. **Monitor.** Analytics, session replay, JSON-RPC traces, and alerts on regressions, so you catch issues before users do. Less than 60 seconds from _git push_ to a live MCP App or Server, available across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and any agent surface that speaks MCP.

Motives is a team of AI agents that runs qualitative research for consumer brands. Running a focus group can cost $20k+ and take 1-2 months to recruit participants, interview them, and analyze the results - Motives AI runs that whole process in 1-2 days.

**The problem**

Enterprises with complex vendor supply chains produce vast amounts of incoming vendor invoices each year. A typical **mid-market enterprise processes \~100k incoming invoices** **yearly**, and today, an accountant tops out at \~10-20k invoices per year because the real grind is still manual:

launches.body:
Coding tools have 10x’d not only dev speed, but also the surface area for bugs. The bottleneck has shifted to validating that features and fixes _actually_ work. 

Your team is probably spending hours doing at least one of these things:

* Manually testing for regressions
* Writing and maintaining brittle E2E test scripts
* Saying “f\*ck it, ship it,” way too often

All while still having users complain about bugs that slip into prod…

“Can’t my coding agent just write my E2E tests for me?”

Sure - but now you’re stuck maintaining them as your app evolves - broken selectors, missing element IDs, new user journeys, non-deterministic environments, evolving infra requirements…

Not to mention the cases that are nearly impossible to test with scripts in the first place: Apple Pay, in-app browser flows, complex swipes, drag-and-drop, magic links, OAuth, cross-app auth, etc…

This is why we built **Autosana** - **the agentic E2E testing layer to close the loop with your coding agents.** Fully vision based, testing your app like humans would.

* Runs locally and in our cloud for multi-env testing
* Code review + E2E testing in your PR with video proof
* Tests evolving with your codebase, creating & running tests based on PR context and code diffs
* Works across iOS, Android, mobile web, and desktop web

Tools like Cursor and Claude Code boost dev speed by 10x, but lack the runtime context to write E2E tests, especially for complex and non-deterministic flows.

Maintaining traditional end-to-end scripts using frameworks like Appium, Espresso, and XCUITest wastes valuable engineering resources (trust us, we’ve been there).

OS3 is building the platform that makes intelligent robots accessible to every business.

Today, robotics is constrained by two fundamental bottlenecks: hardware is too expensive to deploy at scale, and robots are difficult to train because high-quality robotics data is scarce and costly to collect. 

We built OS3 to solve both.

Our two-person team designed and a US-made mobile humanoid robot for a fraction of the cost of commercial alternatives. On the intelligence side, instead of relying on expensive robot-generated training data, we trained our own video-action model on 150,000 hours of real-world video spanning more than 2,000 tasks. Every deployed robot feeds new experience into our reinforcement learning pipeline, self improving robot fleet over time.

This creates a robot that can be deployed across industries to automate repetitive, physical work without requiring a new robot or training pipeline for every task. Our robots are already deployed in hotels, with customers now expanding the platform into biotech, hospitals, and data centers, including a wet lab at Stanford.

Our mission is to do for robotics what Apple did for personal computing: take technology that was once expensive, specialized, and inaccessible and make it powerful and usable at massive scale. We’re building toward a world with billions of intelligent robots, and OS3 is the platform that makes that possible.

GD&T takes years to master. Engineers must encode their design intent into a dense syntax that manufacturers must decode, and not everyone gets it right. 

Put ten engineers in front of the same drawing and you may get ten different interpretations. Which means errors often surface later in interface stack-ups, manufacturing, or in the field - when they’re far more expensive to fix.

That’s why we built F4 - the platform that analyzes GD&T to determine whether your designs are ready for production.

Drop in your drawing and 3D file. F4 analyzes every element of your GD&T to assess whether your design is clear, manufacturable, and production ready. To make the drawing easier to understand, engineers can visualize their datums, reference frames, and tolerance zones directly on the 3D model. F4 also calculates tolerance stack-ups instantly - directly from the drawing. What once took hours of manual work now takes seconds.

When issues are found, F4 flags them and guides engineers toward resolving the problem.

After analyzing your drawing, F4 also automatically generates design and inspection reports - stack-up tables, FAI reports - ready to share with your team.

And it does all of this locally on-device with no AI used for analysis. Producing deterministic results engineers can trust.

launches.title: F4 - Automated compliance checks for engineering drawings
launches.tagline: We help hardware teams 10x how they redline & interpret engineering drawings
launches.body:
# **What is F4 in a nutshell?**

We’re helping hardware-rich teams 10x how they redline and interpret engineering GD&T drawings. With backgrounds at Tesla and SpaceX, we’re building a platform that finally treats drawings like code—automatically validating every dimension, tolerance, and GD&T symbol against standards so noncompliance is caught instantly.

https://youtu.be/SYzqZ4XWmCA

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/a6d6c66e-7e58-4405-b4e2-48c30b354495)

# **The Problem & Why We Built F4**

Drawing literacy is one of the weakest skills across hardware teams. Yet drawings are made every day.

These aren’t just illustrations—they’re effectively business contracts between designers and manufacturers, defining what’s acceptable in production. Drawings carry the bulk of design intent—fit, form, function, and fabrication—and act as the important source of truth across production, quality, and supply chain.

GD&T standards from ASME and ISO exist to formalize this communication. But they’re dense and confusing. Across major revision years, there are thousands of pages of definitions, edge cases, and revision quirks. Designers are expected to know it all, leads are expected to catch every mistake, and suppliers are expected to interpret drawings flawlessly. One mistake means scrap, delays, or worse.

# **Our Solution**

Why is something so critical still so manual? Why can’t drawings be validated and interpreted more quickly and robustly —like code? Why can’t hardware dev be more like software dev?

We’re changing exactly that!

F4 treats drawings like code—they either execute or fail immediately. Our platform checks every dimension, tolerance, and GD&T symbol against standards in real-time, ensuring full compliance before a drawing ever reaches the floor. No more total reliance on manual redlining and reviews.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/1aa5904c-3086-4722-8838-ffda9c0d7a85)

F4 ensures engineers never release noncompliant drawings—and suppliers never misinterpret them. F4 helps industrial teams eliminate costly scrap, rework, and miscommunication at the root.

# **How It Works**

1. Upload a drawing (dxf…and very soon pdf)
2. Select GD&T standard of choice (ASME Y14.5 - 1994, 2009, & 2018)
3. Get instant compliance score graded against a desired GD&T standard using **deterministic logic**
4. Get recommendation to correct any asset (FCF, FOS, datum, basic, modifier, and/or dimension) of the drawing that is noncompliant with references to ground-truth sources
5. With a compliant drawing - get standard definition, inspection plan, and tolerance analysis interpretations on any drawing asset of interest

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/accc67da-db20-423d-84b0-7ec4904ad800)

## **Hardware Platform Built by Hardware Engineers!**

I worked at Tesla as a Mechanical Design Engineer and took 6 parts from clean sheet design to production for the CyberCab and SEMI drive system programs. I was also the lead engineer for Tesla’s global drive unit heat exchanger program with +3 million unit annual production volume.

Aidan worked at SpaceX as an Avionics Test Engineer, where he designed and owned testing hardware (PCB boards and testing apparatus) for the Raptor 3 Engine - the most advanced rocket engine in the world. 

In college, we led The University of Alabama’s Rocket Team where we achieved the university’s first-ever liquid rocket engine hotfire! I built the rocket engine and Aidan built the electrical/software for our propulsion system.

https://youtube.com/shorts/rBwsqu_sdeg?si=RgRU_eqib7_-qLcV

## **Ready to Ditch Manual Redlining?**

If you're tired of pretending to be good at GD&T:

* Email us: [paul@f4.dev](mailto:paul@f4.dev) and [cantu@f4.dev](mailto:cantu@f4.dev)

Hey 👋, we’re Haz and Wyatt, the founders of Pally.

We’re building Pally because in a world full of ‘AI SDRs’, our warm connections become more important than ever… Yet today, keeping track of thousands of connections across countless social platforms is impossible. 

We forget to respond, we miss important moments, and we lose touch.

We’re building Pally to solve that.

If this resonates, we’d love your early feedback. Download Pally here: [www.pally.com](http://www.pally.com)

# Demo

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g97sd_roD14

## How does it work?

We bring together all your connections, across all your socials (inc. iMessage, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Google, Email, Calendar, and X), and then our AI researches everything they’ve ever posted online.

Pally uses this deep understanding of each relationship to help you:

* Prepare you for meetings
* Stay in touch with your potential customers/hires/investors (or just remind you to ring your mum from time to time)
* Search over your network to find the right person for any query (”who do I know in New York that I’ve not spoken to in a while?”)
* Add people to pipelines

We also added some fun relationship stats, so you can see how social you are compared to other Pally users, how each relationship is growing/declining over time, how long you take to reply vs how long others take to reply to you, and more.

## Who’s it for?

We’re mostly focused on founders and investors, but we’ve also seen salespeople, recruiters, agency owners, and creators get a lot of value from Pally; essentially anyone in a role where relationships are a primary focus (and honestly, we believe in the world of AI, that’s _everyone_).

## What's next?

We're excited to launch this into public beta today, learn from what our users are loving, and where they’re wanting more, and build that. 

Our roadmap includes adding integrations with AI meeting note takers, so all your relationship context is in one place, adding an iOS app so you have all your data on the go, and adding more agentic capabilities.

# Ask

Please upvote us here and on [Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com/products/pally-ai-relationship-management), and give Pally a test and let us know how you get on! 

We’re also hiring! If you’re interested in working with us, please email [hiring@pally.com](mailto:hiring@pally.com) with your cv.

Thanks for your support,

Haz + Wyatt 🫶

name: Certus AI
long_description:
Certus AI is replacing the restaurant phone line with Voice AI.

Restaurants lose up to $100,000 per year per location from missed calls, lost orders, and abandoned hold lines. Staff are overwhelmed. IVRs frustrate customers. Call centers are expensive and impersonal.

It’s 2025. Guests don’t leave voicemails or wait on hold. They just move on.

Certus is an AI voice agent built for restaurants. It answers every call, 24/7 — taking orders, processing deliveries, booking reservations, upselling, and handling complaints in English, Spanish, French and more. Certus is built to manage the phone line end to end, from the customer call to the restaurant tech stack, with zero human intervention required. It currently integrates with industry-leading systems like Toast, Square, Clover, UberEats, DoorDash, and more.

We’re building the voice layer of the modern restaurant — the employee they’ll never fire.

We started Certus because we lived the pain. Gurveer (CEO) grew up answering phones in his family’s restaurant and helped operate them, growing from 1 to 11 locations in 7 years. Later, he and Adam (CRO) ran a restaurant growth startup to help others increase revenue, but kept watching clients bleed cash because no one picked up the phone. So we built the solution the industry always wished existed.

Until now, this problem was considered unsolvable. But Voice AI has finally crossed the conversational chasm and 72% of consumers now prefer AI over humans as long as it means faster and better service.

More importantly, the market is begging for this. The North American restaurant industry crossed $1 trillion in 2024, and it's projected to hit $1.5 trillion in 2025. Yet over $100 billion is still lost annually to missed calls, human error, and outdated tech. As the market continues to grow, so do the losses!

Our customers say it best:

- “Certus changed my life overnight.”
- “We were losing the ability to give great in-house service — the phone was killing us.”
-  “70% of my business comes through the phone. That’s mine and my 16 staffs livelihood.”
- “Before Certus, I used to lose 40 - 60 calls a day…. now my printer just stays printing!”
-  “I’ve been in the business 38 years. I’ve been waiting for this since then.”

Certus is here to fix the $120B phone problem — one call at a time.

And in doing so, we’re redefining how the restaurant industry communicates forever, starting with the phone line.

launches.body:
Hey everyone! We are [Varunram](https://www.linkedin.com/in/varunramg/) and [Sai](https://www.linkedin.com/in/saisamrit-surbehera/), and we’re building Lapis.

The way we access information is fundamentally changing and ChatGPT is the new default for a large number of people. Unlike Google which shows you a list of blue links to click on, ChatGPT adds additional context and traditional SEO elements like rank and authority are no longer relevant.

Here’s a fun video that encapsulates this perfectly: https://youtube.com/shorts/A1zkkdpXsjM?si=TIR2PpnO9Du4DV2O

# What is Lapis?

Lapis helps you rank on AI Search Engines (we currently support ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Grok) without generating hundreds of blogs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94694&key=user_uploads/482153/d7152bae-e95b-49de-b222-45d4b18a7359)

We manage to do this by extensively analyzing Model responses and a combination of real-time content fixes, technical SEO, and linking websites on domains that are mentioned in models.

# Analyzing AI Search Models

We spend over 650M tokens a day understanding responses for our customers. We construct a super detailed graph of all websites that show up for a given question, analyze the referenced content, and organically insert content on similar pages. This gives us accurate knowledge on what works and what doesn’t work. We want to learn from the models themselves, not create a rough set of heuristics on what might work.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94694&key=user_uploads/482153/fd2bcb1a-26e6-4e76-bf93-34b66739c122)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94694&key=user_uploads/482153/cd700a82-7da5-4eb8-9002-fd9152235052)

# Changing Website Content Dynamically

We dynamically change your website content in real time for AI Search Engines. If Lapis is deployed on a company that does payroll software and a user asks a model “What is the best payroll software”, we highlight them as being the best payroll software and if a user asks “Can you create a comparison table with the top 10 payroll softwares”, we can highlight exactly where the company shines wrt other payroll providers. This removes the guesswork from landing pages for sales and marketing teams, and users and AI Agents get the information they are looking for.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94694&key=user_uploads/482153/d950c296-eaf8-4146-bc19-2d5ef8b2b621)

# Removing the black box from Technical SEO

We fully take care of Technical SEO. For long, SEO has been this black box which no one understands. We solve that through Lapis Agent, which can automatically add meta tags, title tags, Opengraph URLs, sitemaps, and much more. For marketers, this means they don’t have to write code or trouble the engineering team. This also means they don’t have to spend hours with SEO teams on something that can be easily automated.

# Discovering Hidden Markets

Many times, teams don’t know that there’s a huge untapped market waiting for them. With our extensive analysis of prompts, we show all the queries for which businesses are actually showing up for, which means teams get insights into verticals where there’s huge untapped potential.

We want businesses to understand AI Search without the buzzwords. We want them to organically position themselves for this new shift, and to do so without generating spam content that actively harms website reputation.

We support over a hundred fast growing startups like Warp, Reducto, and Greptile on Lapis, and if you’re a founder or marketer, I think you’ll find a ton of value in using us.

And its free to start, so check it out at trylapis.com!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lq9ouROmRHA

**The Problem**

In India, phone calls remain the backbone of how businesses operate - from banks chasing loan repayments, to edtech companies qualifying leads, to e-commerce brands confirming deliveries. Millions of such calls happen every day. But the system is broken:

* **20+ Languages, 200+ Accents/Dialects**: Building a team that can handle all is impossible. Calls often switch mid-conversation (Hindi → Hinglish → Gujarati), and only a natural, adaptive AI can follow along and give a personalised experience to each caller.
* **Context-Dependent Requirements**: A delivery driver in Bangalore needs a low-latency, Kannada-capable model with high noise cancellation. A recruitment call to an engineer requires a slower but higher-quality reasoning model. There is no “one model to rule them all,” and integrating and managing 100s of models at scale is an unwanted hassle for businesses.
* **Cost Efficiency at Scale**: In India, every rupee matters. Voice AI must be engineered for efficiency - pre-recorded messages for common utterances, smaller vertical-focused models, and intelligent routing to minimize token usage.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94216&key=user_uploads/1427127/bb2d0f37-0050-4606-8271-c8664a3d541b)

**The Solution**

Bolna is a **Voice AI Platform** purpose-built for India’s scale, linguistic complexity, and cost sensitivity. We enable enterprises to go live with thousands of concurrent calls in days, not months.

* **Enterprise-grade performance**: Sub-500ms latency, interruption handling, multi-language (10+) and accent (50+) adaptation, fluent in natural multi-language conversations (Hinglish, English + Tamil etc.)
* **India-specific routing**: Bolna automatically picks the optimal model blend for the context, regardless of language, region, or use case.
* **Cost-efficiency engine**: Calls are optimized with pre-recorded inserts, cheaper small models where possible, and routing logic that prioritizes ROI without sacrificing experience.
* **Complete control**: Enterprises define workflows, tone, and intelligence. Bolna handles everything behind the scenes.

Today, Bolna powers **500K+ minutes of calls every month** across BFSI, e-commerce, and recruitment. Customers achieve **higher pickup rates, lower costs, and faster deployments** than with any alternative.

For Indian enterprises, Bolna is not just automation, it is the fastest path to scaling voice operations profitably.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95349&key=user_uploads/476131/f682e615-6b6a-487a-b532-58158884d410)

**The Problem**

Biotechs spend months preparing the documentation required to start human trials. Most of the time goes into organizing results, rewriting information across many documents, and keeping everything consistent.

Companies often hire Contract Research Organizations(CROs), which run clinical trials and also help prepare these submissions. But their document assembly process is still manual and slow, so timelines stretch and costs rise.

Every update requires repeating the same work. This delays trials and wastes $$$ before a single patient is treated.

**The Solution**

Scoop turns your internal data and study reports into a continuously updated submission workspace.

Our system generates the draft documents in the required structure, keeps everything consistent when new data comes in, and flags anything that needs review. Teams focus on approving content, not assembling it.

What used to take months can now be completed in days.

**Impact**

We're compressing IND assembly from the order of months to days. For a typical biotech, that means:

* Getting to first-in-human trials 2-5 months faster
* Saving $100K+ in CRO fees per submission
* Reducing rejection risk through automated compliance checks

**About Us**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95349&key=user_uploads/476131/5591f53a-d15a-449b-857d-c723e3535665)

We met at UPenn 16 years ago (yes, it’s been a minute) and have been best friends ever since.

Jay was a tech lead in Google Search AI and previously worked at biotechs including Genentech, and has helped file INDs and led statistical design work for a Phase 3 ALS clinical trial. He holds two MS degrees in both Biotechnology and Computer Science.

We've seen both sides of this problem: the AI capabilities that can solve it and the regulatory complexity that makes it hard.

launches.body:
Point our CLI at your agent project, run `dari deploy`and get a production-ready agent API.

<https://youtu.be/Y6CdktXcF24>

## What it is

[dari.dev](http://dari.dev) turns an agent project into a **versioned, stateful API endpoint**. We’re building on top of the best open-source harnesses starting with **Pi**. Support coming soon for **Hermes** Agent. Book a call to deploy your proprietary harness.

### How it works:

* Drop a dari.yml + tools + skills at your repo root
* “dari deploy .” uploads a snapshot and publishes a new version behind a stable agent URL
* Clients open a **durable session** and stream multimodal events (text, files, images)
* The platform runs the harness, spins up a sandbox workspace per session, and handles logs, retries, and credentials
* New publishes create new versions. In-flight sessions stay pinned to the version they started on

## The problem:

If you're building an agent right now, you're probably:

* Stitching together durable execution + a sandbox provider + Postgres + a secret store yourself
* Losing state when a turn crashes mid-execution
* Shipping “agents” that can’t survive a 30-minute task
* Rebuilding the same infra (auth, retries, workspace, logs) on every project

Most agents break mid-task.

## With [dari.dev](http://dari.dev):

* **Durable sessions:** Long-running tasks survive crashes, restarts, and redeploys. Resume from the same session_id days/months/years later.
* **Versioned deploys:** Every publish is a new version behind one stable URL. Roll forward without breaking live sessions.
* **Bring your own sandbox:** Sandboxes run under your provider account and API key. You control limits and data. E2B today, Daytona / Blaxel / Modal coming soon.
* **BYOK with OpenRouter / any OpenAI-compatible API endpoint:** Use your own key, pick your model, control spend, keep logs.
* **Custom tools**: Drop Python or TypeScript tools under tools/<name>/. We run them with retry policies you define.

**The API:**

Publish once. Then, create a session and send messages + stream responses.

We provide full observability, session-level event logs, per-turn state, and workspace file outputs attached to the session lifecycle.

## Why we built this

We started building browser automation agents and kept hitting the same missing primitive, a durable control plane underneath.

We built it for ourselves, then realized every other team shipping agents (coding, research, ops) is rebuilding the same layer.

If you’ve wired together durable execution + a sandbox provider + Postgres + a secret store just to run one agent in prod, this is for you.

## Get access

* App: [app.dari.dev](http://app.dari.dev), docs: [docs.dari.dev](http://docs.dari.dev)
* Install the CLI, run `dari auth login`then publish from your repo
* Pricing: Either you pay your providers directly (E2B + OpenRouter/OpenAI) or use our managed Anthropic/OpenAI/OpenRouter offerings. No markup from us initially.

Book a call: calendly.com/avyay-dari/30min or email me at [avyay@dari.dev](mailto:avyay@dari.dev).

Running regular browser use agents as-is has limited viability for repetitive tasks. They're too slow, too expensive, and too unreliable. And forget about authenticated sites: most agents can't handle 2FA at all.

Dari is different. We're purpose-built for production use, combining intelligent caching with automatic 2FA handling so your automations actually run reliably, day after day.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94481&key=user_uploads/870512/3282af1a-0e2b-4e5b-a6ef-24962de4c65e)

**2. ⚡ Intelligent Caching: Fast and Reliable**

* **Run once, cache forever:** After running a workflow with an LLM once, Dari can replay the workflow using deterministic DOM steps
* **Fallback intelligence:** If a site changes, Dari automatically detects it, adapts, then caches the new path
* **Why other agents fail:** Regular browser-use agents call LLMs on every single run. Dari only uses AI when needed.

**3. 🧩 Built for Developers: Real Integration, Not Toys**

* **Chat-to-automation:** Describe your workflow in plain English and get a working automation in seconds.
* **API-first triggers:** Start workflows via POST request, integrate directly into your stack.
* **Webhook & Wait:** Call your backend mid-workflow, run custom code, and continue the automation seamlessly.

**💥 Real Impact**

* A voice AI company automated data entry and form filling tasks, saving 10+ hours per week.

**🧑‍💻🧑‍💻 How we got here**

We’re two Caltech CS grads who have previously worked on software at Amazon and Uber. 

We’ve been building with browser use agents since the initial model releases and were constantly frustrated by how unreliable they were for production use-cases. We built Dari to fix the problems we’ve noticed since the start.

Sign up or schedule a demo at [usedari.com](http://usedari.com) or contact us at [founders@usedari.com](mailto:founders@usedari.com).

name: Minro
long_description:
Minro helps companies stay close to their users as they scale.

Today, most startups have thousands of product events flowing through tools like PostHog, but still have no real understanding of who their users actually are, which users are quietly about to churn, or what outreach actually brings them back. Founders care deeply about their users, but staying close to them becomes operationally impossible very quickly.

Minro plugs directly into a company’s analytics stack and turns product activity into living customer intelligence. We enrich every user with context like their company, role, LinkedIn/GitHub/Twitter, background, and likely use case, currently matching users to the correct online identity with ~80% accuracy starting from just name + email.

We then identify which users are most likely to churn based on behavioral patterns, persona similarity, and historical retention signals, and help founders proactively reach out before those users disappear. Minro drafts highly contextual founder-style outreach, tracks which conversations actually convert into retention, and continuously improves the system over time.

The result is a customer intelligence and retention layer that helps companies understand their users better, build stronger relationships, and reduce churn before it happens.
one_liner: Identify churn risk and stay close to users at scale

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
We’re cousins who’ve been building things together since we were kids. Samika had already founded a company before Iris building scalable enterprise agents. Siddhant has been coding since he was 11 years old and loves building complex systems in the form of consumer applications (12 apps in production, 2500+ active users)

Iris started as something we built for ourselves. We were constantly overwhelmed by scattered calendars, inboxes, and tasks and every “assistant” tool felt either too rigid or too dumb. So we decided to build one that actually understood us, combining the reliability of deterministic systems with the intuition of LLMs.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer:
We started Iris as a side project to fix our own scheduling chaos with a good user experience. The first prototype synced our calendars and emails, and within hours it was already making our days smoother. That’s when we realized how big this could be.

A major inflection point was meeting Adam Cheyer, the founder of Siri. His advice reframed how we thought about the problem - it wasn’t just a UX challenge, it was an engineering problem. We then brought on one of Siri’s founding engineers as a technical advisor, which shaped our architecture around deterministic logic combined with adaptive LLM reasoning.

That shift (from “AI wrapper” to hybrid intelligent system) became the foundation of Iris.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
The core problem is cognitive overload because people are drowning in context switching between calendars, emails, and apps just to stay organized. Productivity tools today still expect you to manage them. They don’t understand how you work and make you configure rules and routines that fall apart when real life changes.

We felt that pain deeply ourselves. Both of us are neurodivergent so motivation wasn’t the issue, context was. We didn’t need another to-do list but we needed something that understood our rhythm and made intelligent decisions for us.

Iris exists to eliminate that friction. It learns how you work, automates the repetitive decisions, and keeps you focused on what actually matters. This problem is universal, everyone struggles to stay on top of their time. Solving it unlocks human attention at scale.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
In the future, everyone will have their own Iris: an assistant that actually knows them - how they work, who they meet, where they go and helps them stay a step ahead. When two people both use Iris, their assistants can coordinate directly, handle logistics, and clear out the noise before it reaches them.

At scale, this becomes the foundation for how individuals and teams organize time - from one person’s calendar to entire companies. Iris is how people will work when AI truly understands context.

Most B2B revenue still runs through **phone calls and emails**, not websites.

Teams struggle to:

* answer every inquiry

* apply the right catalog + pricing rules

Questom trains **AI sales agents** that do all of this automatically, using your workflows, your rules, your language, and your systems.

Our agents live directly inside the communication channels B2B teams already use:

Across wholesalers, distributors, field-service companies, custom-order shops, foodservice, industrial supply, packaging, labels, and more — the story is the same:

Every day teams handle:

• “Can you do this?”

• “How much will it cost?”

People think “chatbots” solve this, but bots don’t understand:

* catalogs
* pricing rules
* discounts
* exceptions
* minimums
* production timelines

B2B sales is _not_ FAQ automation.

It’s conversational problem-solving.

# **💡 The Solution**

They learn:

* your catalog

launches.tagline: We build APIs to parse multimodal unstructured data and convert it into LLM-ready formats. Our vision is to make documents as computable and queryable for AI Agents as your data sitting in an RDS.
launches.body:
Hey YC, we are [Aman Mishra](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aman005/) and [Adnan Abbas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adnan-abbas-903b711a2) from [Unsiloed AI](https://www.unsiloed.ai/).

**TL;DR:** _Unsiloed AI is building the most accurate APIs for ingesting multimodal unstructured data like PDFs, PPT, DOCX, tables, charts, and images, and converting it into structured Markdown and JSON for downstream LLMs and AI Agents._

We are already processing millions of pages of complex documents each week for Fortune 150 banks, NASDAQ‑listed companies, as well as early‑stage startups in accuracy-sensitive domains like finance, legal, and healthcare.

https://youtu.be/ULDK5dgfgzM

**The Problem**

More than **80% of enterprise data is multimodal and unstructured**. AI teams spend **6+ months** building accurate document‑ingestion pipelines that keep breaking.

* From the tons of open‑source solutions out there, it’s still tough to achieve superior accuracy on even mildly complex cases.
* Traditional OCRs are static and break with changing layouts.
* LLMs, although good at comprehension, suffer at **deterministic extraction**, making them unreliable for accuracy‑sensitive domains like finance and healthcare.
* Early‑stage vertical AI teams end up becoming **document AI companies**, reinventing the wheel, as evident from **300+ conversations** we’ve had with AI teams of all sizes.

**Solution (What we built)**

We combine **vision models** with **OCR‑based models** to accurately extract information from complex documents.

**1) Pre‑processing & Segmentation**

* We segment data into **texts, tables, images, and plots** using specialized models for each task.
* We use a **heatmap‑based chunking** technique that first generates **pivot elements** from the document. Pivot elements are the elements of importance, e.g., **numbers and merged cells in tables**.
* This chunking strategy ensures all related pieces of information are preserved in the **same chunk** (e.g., a table spanning multiple pages, rows split across pages), while unrelated information is split across chunks. The result: retrieval feeds **only accurate, complete‑context chunks** to LLMs.

**2) Dual‑Stream Representation**

Post pre‑processing, we pass the segmented chunks through **two parallel streams**:

* **Data Stream:** preserves the **extracted content**.
* **Layout Stream:** preserves the **actual layout & hierarchy** (indentation, alignment, clause/sub‑clause structure).

This matters because the data is not just text and numbers the **structure carries meaning** (e.g., a right‑aligned cell in a financial table or the way clauses/sub‑clauses are arranged). The dual stream captures both **semantic content** and **structural cues**.

**3) Domain‑Specific Decoder**

* A decoder consumes both the streams and structures the outputs as per the required **JSON schema** or **Markdown**.
* We incorporate **domain‑specific ontologies** (finance, healthcare, legal).
* An in-built **RL pipeline** to train the decoder when outputs involve internal terminology that is hard to capture using a general LLM.
* We generate **confidence scores** for each extracted item; **low‑score items** are collected over time to run **fine‑tuning jobs**

We can run all of this under fully air-gapped on-premise environments as well for privacy-sensitive verticals.\
\
**Here are some sample outputs generated by our Vision Models:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95076&key=user_uploads/879419/fdfed5e7-994a-47d3-9357-b20b1d2a3b67)

PIE Chart formatted markdown

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95076&key=user_uploads/879419/7e78481c-6898-4bfe-a6d8-c49ada7cef52)

JSON output from handwritten, scanned docs, along with confidence scoring and citations.\
\
**Our Progress:**

We are already processing millions of pages for Fortune 150 banks, NASDAQ‑listed companies, as well as early‑stage startups (including 10+ YC startups) across finance, legal, and healthcare. On public benchmarks, we consistently outperform solutions from LlamaIndex, Gemini, Mistral, and [**Unstructured.io**](http://Unstructured.io)**,** among others.

Here is a representation of the volume of pages we have processed, stacked on top of each other.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95076&key=user_uploads/879419/849f06b2-5d8d-4c77-8b73-40f6661a3f92)

**Our Ask:**

Parsing **PDFs, images, PPTs,** or **Excel files** for your **Vertical AI** use case or **RAG** pipeline? Give [**Unsiloed AI**](https://www.unsiloed.ai/) a try. We turn months of ingestion work into one API call for every document type.\
\
Sign up on [**unsiloed.ai**](http://unsiloed.ai) to give it a try (no credit card needed)\
