Hey everyone! We’re[ Sukrut Oak](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sukrut-oak/) and [Abel John](https://linkedin.com/in/abel-john-85a7551b6) from[ LogosGuard](https://logosguard.com/).

**TL;DR**

Enterprises are racing to adopt AI, but often don't have the right controls in place or know how to verify vendors are compliant. LogosGuard turns AI policies into executable controls, stress-tests your AI products, and continuously monitors changes, giving enterprises the confidence to scale AI responsibly.

**The Problem**

SOC-2 wasn’t designed for AI. Without the right controls in place, enterprises are having to rely on outdated standards or navigate a fragmented landscape of nascent AI frameworks (think NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and CSA AICM). The result: slow approvals for new projects and vendors, inconsistent and insufficient reviews, and no reliable way to prove an AI product still meets policy after it changes.

**The Solution**

**LogosGuard** is an AI governance and assessment platform that fits into your existing procurement and compliance systems, and produces reports your teams can act on:

* **Build your AI Controls baseline.** We translate leading controls frameworks, including NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001, and your internal policy, into a clear set of AI controls. We help you understand and choose controls tailored to your industry, and keep up to date with the continuously changing state and federal regulations.
* **Stress test the AI features.** We run targeted evaluations for prompt-injection, harmful guidance, PII mishandling, access-control gaps, transparency failures, robustness, and more.
* **Continuous monitoring.** When vendors update models and features, we re-run the key tests continuously and alert you if risk rises over time.
* **Painless reporting.** We provide executive summaries, auditor-ready evidence, and a searchable record of decisions so compliance, information security, and leadership see the same truth.

**Impact**

* Vendor risk reviews in days, not months
* Maintain a robust set of AI controls, with regulatory compliance informing policy updates
* Catch drift before incidents occur with continuous monitoring

launches.title: Agentic Fabriq: Okta for Agents

launches.body:
Hey everyone! This is Paulina & Matthew from Agentic Fabriq. 

**TL;DR:** AI agents are entering production — but identity systems weren’t built for them. Agentic Fabriq is the identity and governance layer built specifically for AI agents.

Our launch video: <https://youtu.be/6_iIijfy0Mg?si=YMEZHYwgIa8obZ8T>  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98377&key=user_uploads/2840984/7ee786fe-0377-4c6d-9e0e-e8032c2998a7)


**The Problem**

Agents are moving fast. Security isn’t.

Teams are shipping AI agents that call tools, trigger workflows, access internal data, and act on behalf of users. But the identity layer underneath them was designed for humans logging into apps — not autonomous software acting across systems.

Today, teams hardcode tokens into workflows, drop user identity once an agent runs, and re-implement OAuth for every integration. Security teams lose visibility into what agents are accessing and doing, and no one can confidently answer a simple question: **who did this agent act for?**

OAuth, IAM, and IdPs were built for humans and apps. They were never designed for agents calling tools, calling other agents, and operating autonomously across environments. Engineers get stuck rebuilding auth, IT struggles to govern permissions, and security teams are left without clear audit trails.

**What We Built**

Agentic Fabriq is the identity, governance, and visibility layer for AI agents.

We sit in the middle of every agent’s calls and manage both agent identity and user identity. We handle token exchange and authentication, enforce least-privilege access, and enable fine-grained, per-user permissioning for every agent. Every action is logged centrally for audit and compliance.

Instead of wiring OAuth, scopes, and policies for every agent and every workflow, you call us once.

You connect your tools, register your agent, define the permissions — and we handle identity propagation, authorization, and logging.

Here’s a demo of our permissioning feature with OpenWebUI: <https://youtu.be/ayiZ_7d7jCY?si=M3UK8d1B0tvt-8wE>

**What This Enables**

* Per-user agent access
* Agent + user pair permissioning
* Full visibility across tools and workflows
* Instant revocation and policy control
* Compliance-ready audit trails

We make it easy for companies to make their agents secure.

**Why Now**

Every major computing shift forced identity to evolve. 

SaaS required SSO. 

Cloud required IAM. 

APIs required OAuth. 

\
Agents are the next shift – and they need their own security platform. 

We’re building it.

**Our Ask**

If you’re building internal agents, shipping AI into enterprise, or thinking about agent governance and security, we’d love to talk.

**CONTACT**

* email us: [founders@agenticfabriq.com](mailto:founders@agenticfabriq.com)
* book a meeting: <https://calendly.com/paulinaxu/agentic-fabriq-meeting>
* website: <https://www.agenticfabriq.com>

**TEAM**

Paulina and Matthew met @ MIT admit weekend and have been friends since. They dropped out before their second year to work on Agentic Fabriq

Paulina was studying AI + Physics and doing CS/ML research at MIT Kavli Institute, MIT Haystack Observatory, and INAF Padua.

Matthew was studying AI + Math and doing CS/Econ research at MIT Futuretech Lab and Computational Biology research at MIT CSAIL.

launches.title: Agentic Fabriq: Okta for Agents

launches.body:
Hey everyone! This is [Paulina](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paulina-xu-5bba0821b/) & [Matthew](https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthew-xu-b32a36271/) from Agentic Fabriq.

**TL;DR:** Agentic Fabriq is Okta for agents. Fabriq ensures that employees can’t access data or do actions with agents that they themselves would not have permissions to do.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/d57b9148-8a8a-44a0-8c53-1292f611641b)

Our launch video:[ https://youtu.be/V4dTw58ZeTQ?si=ykoz3x06_fTgEXeK](https://youtu.be/V4dTw58ZeTQ?si=ykoz3x06_fTgEXeK)

The field of agentic AI is brand new, and everyone is rushing to build and ship their own agents. But there’s a critical gap appearing: **how do you guarantee an agent can’t do more than the employee using it?**

**THE PROBLEM**

AI is rewriting how work gets done, but most companies still can’t let every employee harness it with **their own, permissioned data**. The market is full of tools and agents, but **the core organizational layer is missing**. There’s no unified place to enforce per-user + least-privilege access, separate tenants, or audit what an agent did, with which user, and why, across all of your internal agents and tools.

Today, there’s only scattered solutions to this with identity and permission systems that were built for humans, not for agents acting as humans. Agentic Fabriq solves this issue **for the first time** by giving IT and admins a way to ensure their agents are always constrained to the **exact permissions of the employee asking** - no more, no less.

**OUR SOLUTION**

Agentic Fabriq is the secure fabric that simplifies data permissioning for all your agents, tools, and employees. We handle the auth & integration so IT & admin can manage employee permissions, agent permissions per employee, and tool connections. We’ve solved the security and identity hurdles so you can connect to a tool in minutes and personalize **what your agents can do and access per user**.

On Fabriq,

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/07608446-8a9e-4906-88ff-57c9bd5cb1d4)

register a tool connection,

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/8e2c2fb2-38b9-4253-b87a-5894da56de89)

register your own AI/agents,

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/f703ec51-0cd0-47e3-99ca-8d330c6fe157)

and manage your entire organization

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/6b9fad2b-5606-4ed6-8e3f-af21f966357b)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95246&key=user_uploads/2840984/4bbadb2e-6cb7-4858-9343-0b63b8938458)

launches.title: Logical: The Proactive Desktop Copilot
launches.tagline: Logical makes every knowledge worker 5x productive
launches.body:
Hi everyone,

We’re [Sam](http://linkedin.com/in/samurdhilbk) and [Anushka](http://linkedin.com/in/anushkaidamekorala/), co-founders of [Logical](https://trylogical.ai).

**TL;DR:**

**Logical is a copilot that lives on your desktop and proactively assists with things like drafting emails, meeting insights and tracking to-do items.**

Instead of waiting for you to prompt, Logical suggests context-aware actions in many common apps and services. It’s like Clippy, but actually good.

https://youtu.be/XfyPZb14LZM?si=aaJMF37-ipwkJBDV

### Problem

Prompt-first AI is fundamentally flawed. We waste hours every week writing lengthy prompts, context-switching and copy-pasting to get a chatbot to understand what we're doing. The context surrounding our work (emails, meeting notes, knowledge bases etc.) lives in siloed services that don't talk to each other. A truly helpful AI must live where we work: on the desktop.

### Solution

Logical lives on your desktop, observing your work to build an understanding of your intent and the context that surrounds it. As you switch between apps and tabs, Logical transfers that context with you.

It proactively suggests actions based on what you're doing—whether you're in Gmail, Slack, or Excel. This turns Logical into an all-in-one assistant: it's your email drafter, to-do manager, AI note-taker, and chatbot, all combined.

**📨 Email & Messaging Assistant:** Get quick drafts. Fine-tune, revert, and apply. Works with Gmail, Slack, iMessage and Apple Mail.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95304&key=user_uploads/2175254/ab0e8f09-c58c-45d7-8eef-0be23b97d326)

**✅ Automatic To-Do Detection**: Detects and drafts deliverables. Plus, it reminds you to get those done.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95304&key=user_uploads/2175254/afe169f0-7103-4fe7-aec1-a17e72157c74)

**🪄 Logical Lumos:** Get real-time assistance on any task. In Excel, it can suggest formulas and analyze errors; in a doc, it can explain terms as you highlight them. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95304&key=user_uploads/2175254/596d5046-364b-43b4-86c1-b63ea1b82b1a)

**🔗 Connect your services:** Bridge Gmail or your Calendar for deeper context. Search your email with natural language, or get quick calendar availability lookups.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95304&key=user_uploads/2175254/2b2a7df8-ff33-41f7-8770-5878ab4070af)

### Our story

Sam and Anushka have been friends since they met in grade school at 6 years old.

Before Logical, Sam worked on AI model optimizations at NVIDIA and previously dropped out of a PhD in applied AI. He's a medalist at both the IPhO and APhO and received a President’s Award for Scientific Research from the Government of Sri Lanka. Anushka dropped out of his PhD in context-aware predictive AI at UVA, and previously led B2B SaaS engineering teams.

Working in both academia and industry, we saw firsthand how most AI tools create friction and frustrate users. Our unique backgrounds – context-aware AI and AI model optimization – convinced us that an AI agent that lives on the desktop can identify user intent and provide proactive help, without compromising on speed or quality.

### Our Ask

If you're reading this, Logical can help you (yes, you!) get more done. Try it out at [**https://trylogical.ai**](https://trylogical.ai) – we offer generous free credits. Help us with feedback on how Logical can better fit your workflow.\
\
If you’re an enterprise, help your team miss fewer deadlines and spend less time context-switching. Plus, you can stop paying for 10 different AI add-on subscriptions – Logical can do it all. Contact us at [**hello@trylogical.ai**](mailto:hello@trylogical.ai) to learn more and book a demo.

launches.tagline: Search files with much higher accuracy than RAG (Avg improves 78% → 95%)
launches.body:
**TL; DR**: Captain delivers **the most accurate** general-purpose **knowledge search** engine **ever built.** 

If you need to search through large text or multimodal files, and:

* Don’t have time for **a tedious RAG sprint** -or-
* Your current search pipeline lacks accuracy

We should talk. → [runcaptain.com/sales](https://runcaptain.com/sales?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=launchyc&utm_campaign=launchyc&utm_content=weshouldtalk1) or [founders@runcaptain.com](mailto:founders@runcaptain.com)

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/RxMPHqou94o

In a world where **90% of enterprise knowledge** cannot be stored in traditional databases, this ‘unstructured data’ is an **untapped goldmine** for decision-making. 

The issue is that current RAG solutions have poor retrieval quality overall and are only performant on pre-optimized question types. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95291&key=user_uploads/2044865/425e4da0-2c47-43ea-a2c5-5dc32b2168fd)

**Captain** unlocks **better responses** thanks to an effectively **Infinite Context window**. We distribute it across many LLMs in parallel + some embeddings sprinkled in, and then ‘Map-Reducing’ responses down to a single output.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95291&key=user_uploads/2044865/4be36851-322b-4836-be35-8e447cea51cd)

Without context limits, we have great freedom to optimize our retrieval engine for maximal accuracy. We can now play with a truly dynamic top-k or just run the LLM exhaustively (if a full knowledge audit is needed).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95291&key=user_uploads/2044865/e373def8-4aec-4add-b2a6-7d5fd9a02cb3)

**We’re two lifelong builders** obsessed with data! 

* Lewis (right) solved hallucinations for code generation through his previous startup. 
* Edgar (left) researched NLP+AI and has built production RAG pipelines for the past 3 years.

We’ve seen the pains and limits of these systems from the start, and **the industry is primed for a more accurate alternative.** 

This past summer, we met with every engineer we could at **Snowflake** and **Databricks**, and we kept hearing the same thing again and again: 

> There’s **no good** scalable **unstructured** data **search**.

Until **today**.

**Captain abstracts the engineering of retrieval entirely.** Connecting files is all that’s needed, and we’ll beat your RAG's accuracy. Guaranteed. 

**Our Ask**

If you know a **CTO** or **Head of AI** at a mid-market or enterprise **AI-native** (or are building one yourself), we would love an introduction!

Check us out at [RunCaptain.com](https://runcaptain.com?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=launchyc&utm_campaign=launchyc&utm_content=website)\
or reach us directly through [founders@runcaptain.com](mailto:founders@runcaptain.com)\
\
Happy Shipping! 🚢

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
We (Anas and Pierre-Habté) met at UC Berkeley in 2017 and immediately started working together on tech projects. After co-founding Snipfeed, scaling it to 20+ people, and selling the company in 2024, we knew we wanted to build again together.

The idea for Bravi came from a very personal pain point: my family runs a shutter installation business in France, and I saw firsthand how many calls and leads were missed every day. On top of that, I launched a side business, Volet Dumont, selling shutters online, and experienced the same chaos with quoting and customer communication.

We realized installers were losing 30–40% of potential revenue just from slow follow-ups, missed calls, and disorganized workflows. With our background in automation and product scaling, we decided to tackle it head-on.

That’s how Bravi was born: combining our founder-market fit, validated by hundreds of conversations with installers, with the conviction that AI assistants could transform how home service companies capture and convert leads.

Law firms & legal departments spend countless hours drafting, reviewing, organizing, and managing documents.

Unlike other LegalTech tools, Lexi integrates directly into your workflow, acting as an AI associate that learns your team’s standards, tone, and processes to handle your workflows end to end.

**Lexi saves lawyers 10+ hours of manual work every single week.**

[Lexi Launch Video](https://youtu.be/3LSrawsmCfI)

### 🔴 **The Problem**

Lawyers are drowning in low-leverage work.

70% of a lawyer's day is spent on tasks that don't require legal expertise: summarizing documents, drafting routine correspondence, building chronologies, organizing files.

Existing tools don't solve this—they're point solutions that force lawyers to juggle between multiple platforms and subscriptions, slowing them down instead of speeding them up.

The result? Clients wait for updates, strategy gets postponed, and burnout rises. Even top-tier firms struggle to scale without adding headcount.

---

### 🟢 **The Solution**

Lexi doesn't just "help" with legal work—it does the work. From intake to delivery, Lexi acts as a trained associate that learns your firm's style, standards, and processes.

**What used to take 8 hours now takes 20 minutes.**

**Document Intelligence**\
Transform scattered emails, PDFs, and transcripts into organized, searchable case files. Analyze thousands of documents and extract key information with reliable accuracy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95269&key=user_uploads/2650346/de522fac-c1ec-4375-a762-74e096a803f6)

launches.title: Patent Watch - AI for patent infringements 📜
launches.tagline: Upload your patents, we find infringing products so you can sell licenses or litigate.
launches.body:
[**Patent Watch Launch Video**](https://youtu.be/9rLBsb_cX6E)

**Problem**

My co-founder, [**Andreas Stroe**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andreasstroe) (also my brother), was doing research at Philips. He applied for 4 patents while he was there. After spending way too much time talking to the IP team, he realized that they hold 50,000 patents with a team of \~10 people to defend them.

A little background: a **patent costs** around **$50k** to obtain and maintain. $17k is non-negotiable, paid directly in fees. That means their **portfolio costs $850M** to **$2.5B**. The best part is that they, and pretty much every company in the world, rely on Googling competitors and sending salespeople to trade shows to hear about new products that could be infringing. This whole **portfolio** is **making** little to **no revenue.**

I guess you can see why we started building this right away.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94773&key=user_uploads/1250636/63eddfc4-bbda-4f22-b80e-7d4f0f15ced3)

_Can you tell we’re brothers?_

**Solution**

Super simplified to keep it easy to understand:

✅ We let companies upload their patents and get a list of claim charts showing what **products are infringing and how**, in 20 minutes instead of months.

✅ When companies get sued, they can **use us to find counter litigation**, since the person suing them is most likely infringing on some of the patents they hold too.

✅ The most common way to get these cases thrown out of court is by considering a patent invalid. That means there is some proof, like other patents, research papers, or products that existed before your patent was filed. We find all these and **confirm your patents will hold up in court.**

There is more, but you can consider this our “core”.

**Proof**

As you can imagine, pretty much everyone we work with has us under NDA. What I can tell you is that we work with private inventors up to Fortune and Global 500 companies.

**Why now?**

Of course, AI …

But also, the US Patent Office is tightening the rules for challenging patents in its review court. The director is being pickier about which cases get heard, and some evidence no longer counts.

🚨 It’s going to be a lot harder to attack a patent and a lot easier for owners to defend one🚨

**Ask**

If you hold patents and have more applications pending, you can probably use us.

Outside of that, we’d really appreciate intros to:

* Patent attorneys
* IP managers
* Licensing managers
* CTOs or heads of R&D at hardware, biotech, industrial, and large software companies

My email is [**alex@patentwatch.ai**](mailto:alex@patentwatch.ai) if you want to chat :)

_Thanks for reading!_

**TL;DR:** Appraisals have always been the bottleneck in mortgage underwriting, Automax will appraise any home in just **20 minutes**, fully compliant & with more transparency and data driven insights.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-M8BFckrxyk

Hey I’m Humza, Founder of Automax 👋

For the last 40 years, my family has been in the appraisal business. Automax first started as internal tooling to automate their manual Excel and report processes. That side project grew to power **3,000+ reports** a month for some of the largest appraisal firms nationwide.

While building that out, we realized the root problem wasn’t tools - it was the appraisal workflow itself: subjective, opaque, and built for a workforce with a median age of 62.

With new top down regulation called UAD 3.6 coming in January and reshaping the entire reporting format & data guidelines, appraisals are about to experience its biggest reset in decades with **20% of the workforce retiring** and turn times set to expand from the current **5-7 day** average to **several week long**.

Here’s how an Automax appraisal works:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95483&key=user_uploads/1939136/5b40d57c-0f8b-45e3-a2a6-12cf719dc5a9)

Automax sends a certified inspector to scan the property with our mobile app- LiDAR and CV extract 150+ attributes: dimensions, condition, finishes, layout, and more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95483&key=user_uploads/1939136/daeb1912-773d-4586-8901-1d114c13b2be)

That data feeds into AI Agents trained to follow the appraisal process, which generate a full valuation in under 10 minutes by reconciling market data, selecting and scoring comps, cleaning faulty inputs, and adjusting for subtle market signals (like how an upward-sloping backyard might impact site value uniquely in your neighborhood). A licensed staff appraiser then reviews, edits, and signs the report using **Appraisal Copilot**- our suite of AI tools for order management and review- interrogating data, tracing comps, and re-running analyses in context.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95483&key=user_uploads/1939136/954b1daf-7763-4d75-b86d-70ce54236749)

The result: a fully Fannie Mae & Freddie Mac compliant appraisal, **delivered on the same day**.

**Ask:**

* Today we’re taking appraisal orders across all of California & Colorado (with new states added each week)- if you or someone you know regularly orders appraisals (real-estate transactions, mortgage, tax, insurance, investment, etc), [**book a call with us here**](https://calendly.com/automax-ai/meet-with-automax-ai) and we’ll do your first appraisal for free.

launches.title: Real-SWE: A coding benchmark built from private company codebases
launches.tagline: Can coding agents can do real engineering work on codebases they've never seen?
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114666&key=user_uploads/426892/94ad1344-e8cb-4757-8023-59f3ed3e6081)

**TL;DR**\
Specific Labs (YC F25) is launching Real-SWE, a benchmark that evaluates coding agents on real software engineering tasks that engineers performed, using private, out-of-distribution codebases. Public benchmarks are built on open source repos models have already seen. Real-SWE tests whether an agent can do the work inside a company it has never encountered. Leaderboard and task examples at <https://realswe.withspecific.com>\
\
**Hi, we're Janak and Sid**\
Over the past year we've acquired and licensed operational data and codebases from real companies, and one question kept coming up with labs: how do coding agents actually perform on private code? Nobody had a clean way to measure it. So we built one.

**The problem**\
Every major coding benchmark is built on public repos. Models have trained on that code or on code that looks a lot like it. Scores keep climbing, but the number companies care about is different - can this agent land a fix in our billing system, our permissions layer, our customer data pipeline, without having seen any of it before?

**What Real-SWE is**\
Real-SWE is a set of tasks pulled from real work engineers did on private company codebases. Examples include an app with 200K+ users, a fintech platform processing 100K+ bank statements, and enterprise sales tools.

Each task gives the agent the codebase and the context an engineer would have had, then checks whether the fix actually works. One example: fix invoice billing so each business charges the right tax and exempt customers aren't taxed. The agent has to work out how the business handles tax, connect the tax provider, and keep invoices consistent.\
\
**What we found**

Agents that look strong on public benchmarks struggle a lot more when the codebase is one they've never seen.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114666&key=user_uploads/426892/5c10421b-da9c-4447-bb76-5cf298a890c9)

\
\
**The ask**

* If you're at a lab and want your model evaluated, or want the full task set for training, email [janak@withspecific.com](mailto:janak@withspecific.com)
* If you run a company and would be open to contributing a codebase (we handle anonymization and tasks stay private), reach out

launches.title: Amika - the operating system for AI agents to write and verify code
launches.tagline: Run fleets of human-in-the-loop or background coding agents inside cloud computers. Let them automate coding and verify it's correct.
launches.body:
Software isn't a craft anymore, it's a manufacturing problem.

At Amika, we're building **the open source operating system for coding agents to automate their work**, like how the factory automated manufacturing.

**Amika gives each agent a cloud computer, and lets you build automated or human-in-the-loop workflows for agents to write code and prove that the code is correct.**

A couple of examples:

\- Have Amika monitor production and auto-fix errors, testing the fix against your real app

\- Add Amika to shared customer Slack channels. Auto-implement customer requests and share a live preview the updated app with them

Check out some more examples in our video 👇

<https://youtu.be/GxqFsiBNbww>

# The problem

AI coding agents made code generation cheap. Producing correct code at scale, with real quality controls, is still unsolved. You're left with a tradeoff: pore over every change and go slow, or vibe-code and ship slop.

Coding agents are useful, but the surrounding system is missing.

\- They lack the right **dev environment to verify their work**

\- They lack the right **context to understand the full problem**

\- They lack **deterministic guardrails controlling what they can change**

\- They produce 10x more code, but teams lack **a system for 10x more review**

# How Amika solves this

Amika composes 5 primitives into its agent operating system:

1\. **Sandboxed environments**: isolated cloud computers with the repos, tech stack, MCP servers, skills, and context an agent needs.

2\. **Workflows**: programs as code or markdown files that define when an agent runs and what job it does.

3\. **Deterministic guardrails**: rules enforced on every code change, like "do not cross this module boundary" or "every database query must include a customer ID filter."

4\. **Automated verification**: test, review, fix, and merge loops that check the work against your real tech stack before it ships.

5\. **Audit trails**: the agent chat session, code changes, which checks passed, and what the run cost.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103929&key=user_uploads/101903/a1246cf3-1ed1-435d-94fb-2cb7437b4995)

Amika works with your existing coding agent subscriptions (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) so **you're not locked into one vendor**. Start agents from the web, Slack, GitHub, the CLI, or the API. At any point, a human can take over the sandbox and inspect the running apps, or drive from their own code editor.

Because each sandbox runs your full stack, you review the agent's work in a live preview of your real app, plus the verification artifacts it produced, like screen captures or API test requests, instead of poring over the diff line by line.

With Amika's workflows and environments, you can spend time building higher level loops for your agent to write and verify code, speeding up your product development.

We pivoted our YC company to bet on this, and we already use Amika for the majority of our PRs. We're building it in the open: each primitive ships as open source, and our cloud platform packages the whole operating system into a software factory for teams.

**TL;DR:** Companies spend trillions each year on salaries but still guess what to pay. Openroll ends that. Our AI agents reveal exactly how competitors pay – company by company, role by role – and guide leaders through salary decisions in real time.

Early customers are already closing candidates they used to lose, retaining their best people, and seeing 3X ROI in week one and six-figure P&L impact.

Know any tech People/HR leaders, CFOs, or CEOs? Let’s connect: [mattias@openroll.com](mailto:mattias@openroll.com)

https://youtu.be/WfrVYtrUWmM

**Problem**

Imagine playing chess without seeing the board.

That’s how companies set pay today. Salaries decide who joins, who stays, and who leaves – yet leaders still move blindly.

In fast-moving markets, the stakes are extreme. Miss the mark and:

• The candidate you need takes a competing offer.

• A top performer walks when they discover they’re underpaid.

• Replacements cost months of time and resources.

Despite salaries being the largest spend in business, companies still rely on industry averages, gut feeling, and overpriced consultants. By the time they get an answer, it’s already too late.

The consequences of guessing on pay are brutal: lost candidates, frustrated teams, and six-figure mistakes. And even the biggest, most sophisticated companies still make them.

**What We’ve Built**

Openroll is an agentic AI platform that brings real transparency into compensation for the first time:

* **See competitor pay, company by company:** Know exactly what your peers pay their employees. No averages. No black boxes. Just transparent data.
* **AI-guided pay decisions:** From setting starting salaries to balancing cash vs. equity, agents guide leaders through the toughest calls.
* **Speed is survival:** Weeks of manual work and spreadsheets collapse into seconds – giving you the edge to win and keep the people who matter most.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94293&key=user_uploads/1762740/cabffc7c-4a3c-4956-be6d-db93d501d7b4)

**Why This Matters**

Here’s what our users say:

“Candidates we used to lose now close in days.”

“We finally know where we stand in the market.”

“Comp decisions that dragged on for weeks now take minutes.”

“For once I know what my competitors actually pay”

**Employees** love Openroll because they know pay is fair and transparent. **Managers** love it because they can act instantly and with confidence instead of wrestling with spreadsheets and guesswork. **Executives** love it because it keeps their teams together and turns compensation into a driver of growth, not risk.

The pull from tech companies has been great but any organization competing for talent is starting to see Openroll as essential infrastructure.

**Who We Are**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94293&key=user_uploads/1762740/3c74d2d1-d720-4719-953e-8d0b235a3d29)

We are **Mattias Lindell** and **Porsev Aslan**. Over the past year, we’ve lived inside the world of compensation – shadowing HR teams, interviewing leaders, and building alongside early adopters.

We’ve sat in the rooms where offers were lost and talent walked away, and we’ve refined Openroll hand-in-hand with the companies fighting to keep their people.

**Our Ask**

Know any CHROs, Heads of People, CFOs, or CEOs who care about retaining top talent? Please connect us.

Have you ever been frustrated by surveys, consultants, or guessing games around pay? We’d love to hear your stories.

Reach out at: [mattias@openroll.com](mailto:mattias@openroll.com)

**In a nutshell:**

If you’re building the future and still running on a 10-year-old CRM, let us show you what it feels like to run autonomously → [item.app](http://item.app)

**Meet Item**

_item_ connects to all your customer tools, gathers and enriches context automatically, and becomes your company’s **source of truth** — one place where your team and your AI agents share the full picture to act autonomously.

At the center is the _Assistant_ — your sidekick for daily work. It can send follow-ups, research leads, or add deals with a simple prompt. No complex UI, drop-downs or fields, simply ask.

**The Status Quo**

AI has changed nearly every part of work. Yet the system at the center, the CRM, hasn’t evolved. It’s manual, data incomplete, and still takes trained experts to setup and automate.

We believe a CRM should know everything about your company and be able to do human-level work on your behalf, just like your best employee would.

After a meeting, item helps you send a follow-up based on the notes in that meeting and your history with that customer:

name: Coasts
long_description: A Coast (containerized host) is a local development runtime. Coasts let you run multiple isolated environments for the same project on one machine. As AI coding agents increasingly work in parallel across git worktrees, developers hit painful conflicts — clashing ports, duplicated databases, and fragile per-branch setup. Coasts solve this by giving each worktree its own fully isolated runtime, so multiple agents can build and test side by side without stepping on each other.
one_liner: Localhost service isolation and orchestration for git worktrees

launches.title: JSX Tool: In-Browser React IDE
launches.tagline: The AI first IDE for React development
launches.body:
**tl;dr**

JSX Tool is an in-browser IDE that creates a common language between developers and AI for building React UIs. Click any element in the browser to jump straight to the relevant line of code and edit it yourself, or provide precise context to an LLM to make updates.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JIIXvN7vhrs

---

---

---

**The Problem**

LLMs have transformed how we write code, yet they consistently struggle with precise UI updates. The common belief is that AI simply doesn’t do well with visual tasks, but the real problem is that we're asking LLMs to understand UI without giving them proper context. They’re great at vibe styling but not great at producing precise UIs.

When you prompt an LLM about styling or component changes today, you're describing visual elements through text alone. It's like giving directions without a map. Meanwhile, developers juggle between browser DevTools, their code editor, screenshot tools, and component explorers just to gather enough context to make AI useful for these kinds of tasks.

**Our Solution**

JSX Tool addresses this by letting you click on any element and prompt your LLM with precise DOM context, the exact source component, its styles, and its position in the React hierarchy. Everything happens in one place: inspect, prompt, edit, and see changes instantly. 

And when AI suggestions aren't quite right, our full IDE is right there in the browser with that same context, so you can jump to the exact line of code you want to edit with a single click. You get the benefits of AI, while keeping the creative control and the nuanced decision-making that UI development demands.

Now developers and AI models share a common language for UI; both can reference the exact same visual elements with clarity, turning LLMs from guessing machines into powerful UI collaborators.

**@Tagging:** In your prompts, you can either type @ and click on a section of your webpage to reference another element relative to the one you’re focused on OR you can type @/ to mention files and directories you want the LLM to have as context in your prompt.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95312&key=user_uploads/3082625/2b76e7e0-6efc-4bb5-8b16-86f1cffd6f08)

**CSS Editor:** JSX Tool has a CSS editor that is nearly as feature-complete as the native CSS style editors found in browser element inspectors. Instead of applying your changes to a single element, you can see how your change to a line of JSX code would be applied globally.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95312&key=user_uploads/3082625/f911aeb0-3a85-4e30-9042-d49fd4a06d61)

**LSP Integrations:** JSX Tool ships with a lightweight IDE for manually editing code, but still an IDE that does some heavy lifting. The JSX Tool IDE integrates in language servers for common React development tasks, so you can have things like type-checking, auto-complete, and linting upon save. We currently ship with LSPs for Typescript, Tailwind, ESLint, and Prettier.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95312&key=user_uploads/3082625/57a590b7-b2c0-41e1-90c3-336c839b7219)

To learn more or start using the extension, go to [jsxtool.com](https://jsxtool.com)!

_Note: IDE features are currently in app review and will be available in our next release._

**Team**

Jamie and Dan grew up in New York City and have been working on projects together for nearly 20 years. Before JSX Tool, we most recently built a mobile app for bypassing news site paywalls.

Jamie is a second-time YC founder. Prior to starting JSX Tool, he worked as a Software Engineer at YCombinator on their investor software. He previously co-founded Cheqout, a restaurant technology company that was a part of the YC W21 batch. Prior to his first startup, Jamie worked on Airbnb's China Risk Team.

Jamie has had a deep interest in higher-order and visual programming for a while. He previously built a version control system to diff and merge structured, non-textual assets. Many of the technical problems encountered in that project were very similar to those encountered in JSX Tool.

Dan worked most recently as a Senior Software Engineer at Everblue, where he led engineering teams building workflow applications to power US government systems. Prior to that, he worked as a Senior Cloud Engineer at Sela US. He got his start in tech in the world of React and has since returned to his roots. In a former life, he was a Chef at a James Beard award-winning restaurant.

# **TL;DR**

Corvera is the AI agent workforce for CPG back-office. We help retail brands increase profits by up to 40% by deploying digital workers that run their operations. 

**Ask:** Looking for intros to CPG brands that sell into retail, ideally with > $50M in ARR. Direct them to our website to schedule a demo!

**Website:** <https://www.corvera.ai/>

**Book a demo:** <https://www.corvera.ai/schedule-demo>

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o5ZLvv9Cgro>

### **The Problem**

Retail CPG brands are drowning in operational debt.

* **Ops is a massive opportunity cost** – US CPG brands waste 40% of their time and spend $78bn managing supply chains when they should be getting their products out there and selling to more customers.
* **Poor ops is a huge growth bottleneck** – CPG founders typically stem from product, marketing, or sales backgrounds. Therefore, ops handled by non-ops founders = distraction, pain, and time wasted on non-value-add tasks.
* **Ops pain scales with the brand –** Ops debt and headcount grow as a brand serves more customers, launches more products, and operates in more geographies, further hampering the brand’s growth.

### **The Solution**

**Corvera is the fully autonomous command centre managing ops for fast-growing retail brands.** 

We help brands cut wastage, improve margins, and maximise revenue, with an AI workforce that knows exactly how CPG brands work. We automate the 3 core ops workflows which consume the most time and hamper growth:

**1) Sales Order Processing**

_Process orders end-to-end without lifting a finger._\
\
Corvera plugs into your existing tools and automatically processes sales orders end-to-end, from fulfillment to invoice. It parses email PDFs and text, matches them against known entities in our catalogue, and executes downstream actions with human-in-the-loop approvals.

**2) Inventory Management**

_Track inventory across every location in real time._

Corvera knows exactly where your stock is and how much you’ve got at all times. We seamlessly sync inventory data across all of your warehouses, track shipments and transfers, and suggest actions to rebalance stock across your estate to maximize short-term revenue.

**3) Demand Forecasting & Supply Planning**

_Forecast demand in real time and automatically process purchase orders to prevent stockouts._

Corvera learns from your sales history and, coupled with insights from your team, forecasts demand in real time. With full visibility of your inventory across all locations, Corvera suggests corrective actions to prevent stockouts, so you can maximize your revenue, keep your customers happy, and accelerate your growth. \
\
**In short:** We take away ops pain from CPG brands, allowing them to do what they do best - market and sell their products to their customers.

Hey YC, we're [Rishab Jain](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rishab-jain-k/) and [Aditya Jain, MD](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adityajain2000/). 

Today, we’re announcing Prescience 🔮: health insurance for the age of abundant intelligence. Prescience is taking on United, Blue Cross, and every other incumbent to build the first health insurance company that doesn’t suck.

**TL;DR -** Prescience is a health insurance solution built for a world with AGI. We help cut premiums by 20%, offer $0 deductibles, include GLP-1s and other modern medicines, and have no hidden fees: we’re only paid when we save you money. We’re already helping some of America’s most ambitious companies save money, provide better benefits, and keep employees healthy so they can focus on their business. [www.getprescience.com](http://www.getprescience.com)

[youtube.com/watch?v=PBqyj9zP4BY&feature=youtu.be](http://youtube.com/watch?v=PBqyj9zP4BY&feature=youtu.be)

**The Problem**

Healthcare is a $6 trillion industry in America. For most companies it's the second-highest line item on their P&L, with costs rising about 15% every single year.

Employers keep paying more and getting less. Deductibles climb and the best benefits get cut. Even employees with "good" insurance still end up with denied claims, surprise bills, and debt.

Nothing changes because the entire industry is built to take a cut of your premium. When care gets more expensive, all of the middlemen make more money. They couldn’t care less if your people get more healthy.

**Our Solution**

Prescience is an AI-native health insurance that flips the incentive. Get a quote without speaking to middlemen, and get better health benefits at lower cost. That adds up to roughly **20% lower premiums**, and **better-than-platinum health benefits** like $0 deductibles, no middlemen, no fees. For YC companies, we have a Deal running with Free Wearables and GLP-1s covered.

Here's how we deliver. **Time Machine** is our reinforcement learning system trained on medical histories. The same way AlphaGo found "Move 37," a move no human would have played that turned out to be brilliant, Time Machine searches millions of possible health trajectories for each member and finds the non-obvious path that keeps them healthiest. Then it steers care toward that path: the right screening at the right moment, the right behavior, before a small issue ever becomes a hospital bill. We’re running a separate waitlist for YC companies who want to try Time Machine for personal use: <http://getprescience.com/time-machine-waitlist>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=106632&key=user_uploads/3202469/9ec81a8e-0484-4a24-873c-9aafa87d8124)

Time Machine is paired with **Crystal**: our care navigation assistant in your pocket. As an MD, I’ve seen how patients struggle to manage the labyrinth of healthcare. Hours of phone calls and wait times. Pouring through confusion insurance documents. No more - Crystal can book visits for you, answer questions about your health, and pay your bills.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=106632&key=user_uploads/3202469/6d96fb46-38d8-4b14-934d-c070c77b13b4)

Instead of today’s health insurance experience that forces employers to talk to brokers for weeks just to get covered, employers on Prescience get a quote in days and a plan that automatically tracks savings and does filings. We don’t just sit around and collect money from premiums, but actually try to make your employees healthy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=106632&key=user_uploads/3202469/869b2f99-6114-43c4-b8a3-4630545de430)

We are a real, full-stack solution. We’ve built out and partnered to deliver quotes, banking, HSA, MSO-PC, legal, compliance, network, risk, and any other solutions, We have a national team of top doctors who we negotiate with directly - no middlemen - and who we are able to offer fast payment, clear patient histories, and no admin paperwork. They in turn offer us heavy discounts we pass on to employers.

**The Team**

Rishab and Aditya are brothers and serial entrepreneurs. Rishab (CEO) studied CS & Neuro at Harvard, is an RSI alumni, won the International Science and Engineering Fair, and previously founded and exited an edtech company. Aditya (President/COO) earned his MD from Harvard Medical School, has been doing ML research since 2014, and is an Op-Med Fellow at Doximity.

Prescience aims to rebuild the entire $6T American healthcare industry into one that is proactive and prescient, not reactive. Our vision is to be both payer and provider, as our proprietary AI and data becomes ready to take on all of medicine.

Reach us anytime at [founders@getprescience.com](mailto:founders@getprescience.com).

**Our Ask**

1. **If you’re a founder, get your quote:** at [getprescience.com](http://getprescience.com) and **use our YC deal on Bookface**! Free GLP-1 weight loss program, genetic testing, and white-glove support.
2. **Intro us to enterprise:** Founders, Chief People Officers, Benefits Managers, Chief Medical Officers, CFOs, HRIS Platforms, or Brokers, especially at companies reviewing 2027 benefits!

launches.body:
Hi Everyone 👋:

We're [**David**](http://www.linkedin.com/in/davidstephenroberts), [**Andrew**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrew-hawthorn-reiter/), and [**Vishnu**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishnutejus/), co-founders of [**10x Science**](https://10xscience.com/). We’re a team of researchers from Stanford on a mission to make drug development 10x faster.

**TL;DR:** We are building _the_ AI-native solution to unlock fast, accurate, and scalable therapeutics characterization to accelerate drug development.

[10x Science Launch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WaQSdNSc1KM)

❌ **The** **Problem**

Protein-based drugs now make up a majority of new therapies and advances in AI are flooding the drug discovery pipeline with more candidates than ever. But **the bottleneck isn't candidate design, it’s candidate characterization to identify the best drug for clinical trials**. 

Every antibody, every cell therapy, every engineered protein requires characterization at a level of molecular detail that existing tools simply weren't designed to handle. Today, that process is: 

* **Slow**: Weeks to months per candidate spent on time-consuming data analysis and report generation that limit how fast new therapies can reach patients 
* **Expensive**: On average, it costs $1M+ for each day of delay in a clinical trial. Every day a biologic is delayed from entering the market is a missed opportunity to generate revenue and to save lives
* **Not scalable**: Labs are throwing thousands of therapeutics through the discovery pipeline, but processing the data requires individuals to perform expert analysis leading to reproducibility challenges and a specialized, manual bottleneck

The result: candidates pile up, timelines slip, and the promise of AI-powered discovery gets stuck. 

💡**Our Solution**

**10x Science** is the unlock **🔑**

What if you could go from raw data to output-ready characterization reports in minutes? That’s what we’re building: **AI-native infrastructure for protein characterization**:

* **Reduce analysis time from weeks to minutes**: our platform automates the data crunching that currently bottlenecks development → yielding $150,000+ time savings per team / month
* **Get reproducible, enterprise-ready results** without requiring extensive expertise and slow manual curation. This frees scientists to focus on the important stuff: discovery, not number crunching
* **Scale your pipeline**: process more candidates exponentially without linearly scaling your team

Now, therapeutics development can keep pace with AI-powered drug discovery.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97760&key=user_uploads/3203252/9b62279d-80f7-4f58-a80c-86665a72b6d7)

**📜 Backstory**

We've lived this problem.

As Stanford researchers building frontier tools at the intersection of chemistry, biology, and machine learning, we constantly hit the protein characterization throughput wall. We and every other scientist we’ve spoken with all feel the same pain: protein characterization is slow, manual, and just hard to do at scale. Today’s scientists are drowning in data. A single sample can generate gigabytes of data, yet extracting insights from it is painstakingly slow without the right tools.

If we don’t modernize protein analysis, then drug development grinds to a halt. **This is why we started 10x Science**.

🔬 **Our Team**

We are the only team in the world with deep expertise in proteomics, mass spectrometry, chemical biology, and artificial intelligence to tackle this problem. We’re researchers from Stanford with 18+ years of hands-on experience characterizing biologics and building new technologies and methodologies at the cutting edge. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97760&key=user_uploads/3203252/a384189a-2f27-4969-8d8f-156305c9ce8d)

David (CEO, middle): Damon Runyon Cancer Research Foundation Fellow; Stanford Postdoc from Carolyn Bertozzi’s Lab (2022 Nobel Prize in Chemistry); early career leader in field of mass spectrometry-based proteomics with 37+ peer-reviewed publications

Andrew (COO, right): Trained in Steven Carr’s Proteomics Platform Lab at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard, where he developed new methods in mass spectrometry. Later became a Ph.D. student and NSF-GRFP fellow at Stanford University, where he was co-advised by Dr. Carolyn Bertozzi and Dr. Or Gozani.

Vishnu (CTO, left): 2x YC founder. Built AI for go-to-market teams as the 2nd hire and founding engineer at Nooks. Forward deployed himself in research labs at the University of Washington, UCSF, and Stanford, where he was mentored by world-renowned scientists in analytical chemistry and cancer research. In < 1 year, he published 2 papers and won 4 national awards. 

**We are uniquely positioned** with the technical expertise and insights required to solve this major challenge.

 🌐 **The Big Picture**

We are automating the whole data analysis pipeline to enable scientists to focus on discovery: this is the "why" rather than the "how" of data processing. Every major therapeutic breakthrough of the last decade has depended on understanding proteins at the molecular level. And yet, the tools we use to analyze them haven't fundamentally changed in over twenty years. 10x Science is taking a totally new approach to usher in an AI-forward paradigm in protein characterization and drug development. 

 🙏 **Our Ask**

We're onboarding customers. If you answer "yes" to any of these, we'd love to chat:

**Know a pharma/biotech team** working on biologics characterization?

**Know an academic lab or core facility** doing protein analysis?

**Know a contract research organization (CRO)** looking to scale analytical capabilities?

**Resonate with our mission?** → Share this post!

 —_David_, _Andrew_, _Vishnu_ ([**10x Science**](https://10xscience.com/))

launches.body:
### **TL;DR:**

**Salus is an API that wraps around your agent and checks its actions at runtime, blocking incorrect ones and providing immediate feedback to guide retries.**

We’re Kevin and Vedant, former roommates at Stanford who studied CS, now building Salus full-time.

### 😔**The problem:** 

Your agent processed a refund without looking up the order, costing you thousands. It emailed your top lead using hallucinated data, ruining the deal. You only found out three hours later from a support ticket or an angry email.

Evals, output scoring, and observability are all necessary—but all reactive. They can reduce the likelihood of these problems occurring, but there's no solution that inspects an action as it’s about to execute. Salus does that.

**Ask:** If you are deploying agents and want to improve their correctness we’d love to help. Book a demo [here](https://calendly.com/d/cycy-fbc-fyj/salus-demo), and we can onboard you immediately with just a pip install and a few lines of code.

### 💻 **Our Solution:** 

<https://youtu.be/uyl5NJTY5Cg>

**How Salus validates an action:**

1. Actions must be **grounded in evidence**: Salus maintains an evidence cache for each run that every proposed action is validated against. Evidence includes all outputs from prior tool calls and the entire conversation history.
2. It must **adhere to policy**: Write constraints in YAML, markdown, or plain English. Salus compiles them into runtime checks that are version-controlled, diffable, and shadow-testable
3. And **more**: PII detection, budget/loop protection, idempotency, human-in-the-loop escalation, content moderation

**Self-repairing:** When Salus blocks an action, the agent receives structured feedback to guide a retry. In our benchmarks, **58%** of blocked actions recover and complete the task correctly.

### 📊 **Benchmarks:** 

We tested Salus on τ²-bench and ODCV-Bench. On τ²-bench, agents with Salus follow policies more reliably, at up to **60% lower cost**. On ODCV-Bench, Salus **reduced misalignment by 52%** on average across 12 frontier models (see below).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97574&key=user_uploads/1940292/e48b27f6-2e13-4d40-a9a4-13135ff981bc)

### ➕ **Other Features:** 

While we believe the missing piece is runtime validation, we know **evals and observability** are crucial. That’s why we incorporate all three in **one centralized product**. Using templates and LLMs, we generate thousands of both adversarial and realistic evals that have full context of your agent’s domain.

Contact us: [founders@usesalus.ai](https://founders@usesalus.ai)

# See us in action (demo vid):

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0nlcwZ6bw_c>

# The Problem:

62% of all companies still rely on legacy software and systems. Many of these systems are manual, outdated, and inefficient. In the age of AI, the legacy giants that create this software aim to “duct tape” AI onto their tools – but what they end up with is a **mangled mess that can’t actually do anything useful (Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, the generic useless “AI” sidebar in every application).** Enterprises and consumers need a way to automate work directly inside of the tools they are familiar with – \*\*their solution is o11.\*\*\
\
Starting with **the entire Google & Microsoft Suite,** we’ve enabled hundreds of companies to automate presentation / spreadsheet / document generation directly within their workflow. Teams that use us no longer need to move from app to app or deal with agents that merely “provide insights.” Now they can actually do things in these tools, and do them **fast.**

# Start today:

Try o11 for Free in Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 at <https://o11.ai>. Book a demo at <https://o11.ai/book-demo>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98341&key=user_uploads/1788479/2a4f8871-f9de-4f49-9758-39a582173ea4)

# 

# How did we come up with this?

Before we dropped out of UNC we were surrounded by finance students who all faced similar problems at their internships over the summer: Legacy software, no AI, and tons of grunt work. Most existing finance solutions thought the best way to provide workflow value was to build an external dashboard. But after speaking to hundreds of finance professionals we realized that teams don’t want an external solution, they require something that is directly within their workflow. So, we started by building a Microsoft PowerPoint plugin. Soon, financial teams started asking us for more, and we then introduced o11 For Excel and o11 For Word. But, why confine ourselves to Microsoft only? Teams that we worked with and spoke to all wanted integrations with the full G Workspace suite, and soon we built it for them in Google Slides, Docs, and Sheets. **We’re not stopping there though – while these productivity suites are a large part of our user’s workflows, their workflows aren’t just confined to these tools.**

# Where does this go?

Our users use thousands of enterprise legacy apps that need automation, not duct-taped AI. That’s why, the product we’re soon going to release will enable you to use o11 in any app — **it’s going to enable you** **to automate directly inside any workflow.**

launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’re [Mitch](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mitchellradhuber/) and [Shipra](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shipra-jha-9b021859/) - before Corelayer, we built data infrastructure at Goldman Sachs where we spent many late nights and weekends debugging systems that processed 100s of billions of rows a day.

**TL;DR**

When you’re on call in data-heavy, regulated industries like fintech, healthcare, or insurance, you need to inspect underlying data to debug production issues. We built a platform that monitors both infrastructure and data for anomalies and uses AI agents to debug and suggest fixes in minutes.

[Corelayer Launch Video](https://youtu.be/yFZKJ9QRrr4)

**On-call support is painful and expensive**

All engineers hate being on call. Production issues kill velocity, erode user trust, and become more and more costly as companies scale.

Fortune 100s spend **$100M+/year** on first-line-of-defense production support.

Smaller companies can’t afford to burn **scarce engineering resources** on time-consuming support and maintenance.

**The (sensitive) data problem**

If you’re a backend engineer at a fintech, you probably own a service that queries data, applies some business logic, and stores the result somewhere (i.e., a data pipeline).

When this service is running in production, you’ll see two failure modes:

1. Exceptions in logs and/or failing jobs
2. Bad data produced by your service

“Bad data” can mean anything from incorrect values to entirely missing or duplicated rows.

**This is really common** in certain products and industries, but you’re totally blind to these errors without monitoring data for anomalies and querying data while debugging.

In regulated environments where this problem is prevalent, **production data is sensitive**, which is another constraint we have to solve for.

**Corelayer solves this**

We continuously monitor logs, metrics, **and data** for anomalies and use AI agents to debug, root-cause, and suggest fixes for issues.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96772&key=user_uploads/2897480/fce0b569-7a89-41f5-8225-625e86092a04)

We also filter out false positives and group related issues to reduce alert noise.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96772&key=user_uploads/2897480/6b91dd40-c7c7-4ca9-97a4-f80eaaff537d)

Every team is different. We take feedback from human engineers so our agents learn your systems and improve over time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96772&key=user_uploads/2897480/f5384b34-039b-40f5-ba00-4c1ede356893)

Data is especially sensitive in regulated industries. We’re SOC 2 compliant, offer **BYOC and** **on-prem deployments**, flexible LLM inference options, and expose an audit trail of each step performed by the agent with citations.

**Our Asks**

Does your team deal with data or integrations and spend more time on production support than you’d like? [Let’s chat](https://cal.com/mitchrad/30min). 

Can you connect us with an engineering leader at a finserv, fintech, healthcare, or insurance company? Reach out at [founders@corelayer.com](mailto:founders@corelayer.com).

Thank you!

launches.title: Dream - Pocket-sized AI cameras that catch asset damage
launches.tagline: Dream makes pocket-sized, battery-powered AI cameras that catch damage teams miss.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋, we are Ryland and Alexander, co-founders of Dream.

**TL;DR: Dream automatically photographs every vehicle or machine that passes through your gate, builds a 3D condition record, and uses AI to catch new damage the moment an asset passes through.**

**Launch Video: [https://youtu.be/uMP12lCb12E](https://youtu.be/uMP12lCb12E)**

**The problem**

Damage is an expensive leak for anyone who moves large, expensive assets in and out all day. It shows up two different ways:

**Car dealership service departments**

* As a car pulls into the service entrance, damage that could be identified and fixed goes unnoticed, which is lost revenue.
* Without a record of the car's condition on arrival, disputes come down to the customer's word against the dealership's, and the dealership gets blamed for pre-existing damage.

**High-value asset rentals (heavy equipment, trucks, boats, planes, trailers)**

* Teams are inconsistent about photographing assets as they go out and come back, so new damage gets missed before the customer is billed.
* When damage is missed, there's no evidence to charge the customer, so the company eats the repair cost out of pocket.

**What Dream does**

Dream cameras sit at your gate, lane, or service drive and turn every pass into evidence, automatically:

* **Continuous capture:** every vehicle or machine that moves through is photographed from every angle. No one has to remember to do it.
* **Asset identification:** Dream knows exactly what you need to look at.
* **3D reconstruction:** every pass becomes a complete 3D condition record for that asset.
* **AI damage detection:** on return or intake, Dream compares against the last record and flags new dents, scrapes, and visible changes right away.

The result is one clear source of truth for every asset's condition over time: rental companies catch damage before they bill so they stop eating repair costs, and dealership service departments find more fixable damage and resolve customer disputes with evidence.

Works across cars, vans, trucks, heavy equipment, and more.

**Why us**

We have spent years training models for aerial imaging and edge computer vision devices. Ryland has worked on the exact problem of detecting damage to assets from aerial imaging, such as degraded paint. Alexander has trained models that run on edge cameras deployed in the wild in Africa and India to detect poachers.

**Our ask**

We're onboarding partners now. **We'd love intros to:**

* **Car dealerships**
* **High-value asset rental companies** (heavy equipment, trucks, boats, planes, trailers)

If you run one of these, or know someone who does, please message us on LinkedIn!

launches.title: Ask Poth—ask anything about your customers
launches.tagline: The internal voice of the customer
launches.body:
# \*\*\*\*

**TL;DR: Your customer data is fragmented across Pylon, Granola, Posthog, Hubspot, Slack, and Notion. Poth connects that information into a living model of your customers, mapping analytics from Posthog and transcripts from Granola to the same customer, so you can finally answer the questions that live across multiple tools: churn, adoption or what to build next, with cited evidence. pothlabs.com**

<https://youtu.be/k9gsdaxXdtM>

**The problem:**

Companies have customer information scattered across support tickets, sales calls, CRM notes, surveys, interviews, product analytics and more. 

But answering a new question about customers still usually means manually searching across those systems or beginning another research project.

**The (soft) pivot:**

We originally built Poth to generate hypotheses and launch adaptive interviews and surveys to test them. To determine what questions to ask and which customers to ask, Poth first had to understand all of the customer information a company already had.

Under the hood, we built a customer knowledge graph: Poth identifies the important objects in a company’s data: customers, accounts, users, products, features, conversations, behaviors, and feedback, and connects them through their relationships.

As we integrated with more teams, we noticed that several were using this underlying model as much as, or more than, the survey functionality itself. They wanted to ask questions across everything their customers had already said and done so we made that a core part of the product!

**Customer knowledge graph example:**

For a company like Slack, Poth might model five objects:

* **Account**  (a company paying for Slack)
* **User**
* **Workspace**
* **Feature** (Slack Connect, Huddles, Canvas, or workflows)
* **Customer signal** (A support ticket, call transcript, survey response, or product event)

It then connects them through relationships such as:

User —BELONGS_TO→ Account Account —OWNS→ Workspace User —USED→ Feature Customer Signal —CREATED_BY→ User Customer Signal —REFERENCES→ Feature

Slack could then ask:

“Why are enterprise accounts trying Slack Connect but not adopting it broadly?”

And Poth could connect low Slack Connect usage in PostHog, permission-related support tickets in Pylon, security concerns mentioned in Granola transcripts, and renewal context from HubSpot, all through the same accounts, users, workspaces, and features.

Instead of returning a generic summary, Poth can show the supporting and contradicting evidence, cite the underlying sources, and explain what information is still missing.

In practice, the model contains many more objects and relationships based on each company’s business and data.

**Ask Poth:**

Connect your customer data sources and internal documentation. Poth automatically builds the living model, and your team can ask questions naturally across everything customers have said and done.

When the existing evidence is not enough, you can also use Poth to launch adaptive interviews and surveys to collect what is missing.

Some use cases we’ve seen:

* **Discovery:** “Across our discovery calls, what do users want most that we haven’t built?”
* **Adoption and growth:** What is preventing activated customers from adopting more of the product and expanding?”
* **Churn and risk:** “Identify the top three reasons customers have churned, then flag the five active accounts showing similar warning signs.”
* **Win-loss analysis:** “What are the most common reasons we lose enterprise deals, and which product gaps are actually affecting revenue?”
* **Account intelligence:** “Give me everything relevant to this account before my next customer call.”

**Our ask:**

We’re already working with several teams in the YC batch, and we’re looking for more companies whose customer context is spread across several systems.

I’d especially appreciate introductions to:

* Founders and product leaders at growing startups with significant customer data across three or more tools
* Heads of Customer Insights, Voice of the Customer, Customer Experience, User Research, or Customer Success at larger companies

And if your team has important customer questions it still cannot answer confidently, email me at [matthew@pothlabs.com](mailto:matthew@pothlabs.com)! We’ll work closely with early teams to connect their core systems and get them live.

pothlabs.com

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Poth helps you understand _why_ your users behave the way they do. It uses your company's data and context to generate hypotheses, then validates them through adaptive user interviews until it uncovers the root cause.

**What we do:** Poth is an AI-native customer research platform

Analytics tools show behavior. Traditional research tools ask users static, predetermined questions. Poth connects the two—starting from your own data.

It takes a company's existing data and context to generate hypotheses, validates them through adaptive interviews, and continuously updates its questioning based on each user's responses—helping teams uncover the reasons behind churn, failed activation, checkout abandonment, or any user behavior.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YHgz41ItGhI>

The problem: 
AI has quietly become one of the largest and fastest-growing line items for companies. Spend is scattered across a dozen provider consoles that each show one number at the end of the month and nothing about why it moved. There's no unified view, and no way to trace a dollar back to the customer, feature, team, or even the pull request that caused it.

Which customers are unprofitable once you subtract their AI costs? Which feature is quietly burning your Anthropic budget? Is this week's spike a runaway loop or real growth? How much did that AI-written PR actually cost to ship?
Today teams reverse-engineer answers by exporting CSVs from each provider and stitching them together in a spreadsheet, and by the time they do, the money is already spent.

What SuperPenguin does: SuperPenguin tracks AI spend across 14 providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, AWS Bedrock, Azure, Modal, Cursor, OpenRouter, and more).

* Zero-code setup: connect an API key and costs sync automatically with model-level breakdowns, trends, and forecasts
* Per-request attribution: add two lines with our Python or TypeScript SDK to tag every AI call by customer, feature, team, or environment (or any other metadata).
* AI coding cost per PR: connect Cursor to see engineering spend attributed to each pull request, repo, and developer, so you know what it actually costs to ship.
* Alerts on budget thresholds and spend anomalies, delivered to Slack, email, or Discord.

Most teams are set up in under five minutes. We help companies see where their AI money goes and whether it's worth it.

**TL;DR:** Carrot Labs helps you build models for your agents that are faster and better, forever. Use our platform to build proprietary models using open source that progressively improve.

[**Our Launch Video**](https://youtu.be/Qiw-HG14AVE)

## **The Problems:**

Frontier models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google are constantly pushing the boundary of intelligence further, but great quality comes with high latency and cost. Smaller models are fast, but can't get the job done right.

So you start modifying system prompts. It takes you far enough, but at some point you hit a ceiling. And every time a new model comes out, your prompts don't work the same way anymore! (just February 2026 alone, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 from Anthropic, Gemini 3.1 Pro from Google, GPT-5.3-Codex from Open AI, Qwen 3.5 from Alibaba came out to name a few.)

## **Solution:**

We build you a proprietary model tuned to your tasks so you always have access to the most performant model for your agent.

Our platform records your agent’s activity and tunes an optimized model from an open source base model. Once it's ready, swap out the frontier model for yours. That's it. As new production data flows in, we continuously evaluate and retrain your model to boost performance. What you get is a model specialized to your tasks that outperforms frontier.

## **Why this matters to your startup:**

In the short run, you need your agent to be faster and more accurate, and prompt tuning will only get you so far. We are the fastest way to get there.

In the long run, every company building agents is using the same frontier models. Your competitor has the same intelligence you do. The thing that differentiates you is the knowledge you distill into your own model. Your model is your moat.

## **Team:**

Chris led AI at Skylo Technologies, the world's largest commercial direct-to-device satellite network that provides satellite communications services to Google, Samsung, and Garmin devices.

Yuta was a senior data scientist at Snowflake where he developed financial forecasts through ML that supported the company's hypergrowth from pre-IPO to billions in revenue.

## **How you can help:**

If you are building agents or know anyone building agents who would appreciate a model that outperforms frontier on their tasks, let us know at [contact@carrotlabs.ai](mailto:contact@carrotlabs.ai).

Our self-serve agent eval SDKs are available. Feel free to use it! You can sign up from here: <https://platform.carrotlabs.ai/login>.

**TLDR:** We help insurance brokerages get quotes faster and cheaper. We started as brokers, realized insurance is broken end to end, and are now building the plumbing to fix it.

We’re hiring across sales, ops, and engineering here in SF. [**Apply here**](https://www.workatastartup.com/companies/hedge)**.** 

### **The problem:**

I started a YC-backed AI-native insurance brokerage because buying insurance sucked.

We thought the answer was building a better brokerage. But then we became brokers and realized we weren’t actually fixing the system.

Brokers do important work. They help businesses navigate a messy market. But they don’t control the parts of the stack that determine speed, price, and coverage.

Every quote still depends on multiple layers of brokers, underwriters, carriers, reinsurers, MGAs, and wholesalers.

Each layer is still manual. Someone re-enters the same information by hand, then emails it to another person in the chain who does the same.

Even when brokers move fast, quotes still sometimes take days or weeks. Brokers hate this. Their customers hate it even more.

We realized the only way to fix this was to go full stack and rebuild the workflows ourselves.

### **What we’re building:**

[**Hedge**](https://www.hedgespecialty.com) helps insurance brokerages get better, faster, and cheaper coverage for complex businesses.

To do this, we’re starting with the wholesale layer. The first major bottleneck for brokers.

Our competitors are billion-dollar businesses that are still almost entirely human-driven. Ryan Specialty, one of the largest wholesalers, spends almost 60% of revenue on salaries. Their version of innovation is giving manual work to offshore contractors.

We think the better version is rebuilding the workflow around AI from day one. Hedge uses AI agents paired with underwriting to help brokers get quotes faster.

Soon, we’re moving up the stack: combining wholesale distribution and underwriting into one AI-native insurance company built to help brokers win more business.

**TL;DR:** Manufacturers are buried in coordination work that is well-defined but still manual. Korso lets them describe those workflows in plain English and deploy autonomous agents that run across their existing systems.

## <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yOKcdERZe9w>

## The Problem

Ops, procurement, and customer-service teams at manufacturers spend the majority of their week on coordination that is clearly defined but never automated:

* Chasing suppliers for ETAs
* Processing incoming RFQs
* Routing PO approvals
* Monitoring order exceptions
* Following up on stale opportunities

Every person on one of these teams could write down the exact steps for the task, and yet nobody has built the thing that runs those steps reliably at scale.

The tooling around this problem is stuck in a half-finished state:

* ERP-native AI answers questions about ERP data; it doesn’t execute the multi-step workflows that sit between the data and the work getting done.
* Middleware and iPaaS connect systems but don’t make decisions.
* Systems integrators custom-code workflows that take quarters to ship and break when a process changes.
* BPO adds variable cost and leaves the underlying coordination fragmented.

When a manufacturer adds a product line, a new region, or a new supplier tier, the coordination load scales linearly, and so does the headcount requirement.

## What We Built

Atlas generates autonomous coordination agents on top of the ERP systems manufacturers already run: SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, Dynamics 365, Odoo, and more.

A workflow that today takes a quarter to custom-code or an ongoing BPO contract to staff is, on Atlas, described in plain English and stood up as a running agent in hours.

## Workflows We’ve Deployed

### Procurement & Supplier Coordination

Chases supplier responses, confirms ETAs, routes PO approvals, and escalates exceptions before they become missed deliveries.

### RFQ to Quote

Parses incoming RFQs from email or portal, prices against history and current cost, drafts and routes quotes for approval, and tracks through to response.

### Order & Exception Handling

Monitors order status across ERP and transport systems, surfaces exceptions before they escalate, and maintains a complete audit trail.

### Natural Language to Workflow

Turn any manual process into automation simply by prompting an agent.\
\
**Our Ask:**

If you know any manufacturer with a coordination-heavy ops or procurement team, we’d love to talk! Feel free to book a demo at [korsoai.com](https://korsoai.com) or reach out to [support@korsoai.com](https://mailto:support@korsoai.com)

Each agent deepens our understanding of the business, so the next agent launches faster. We stay embedded until the business is rebuilt.**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O829Y4wlKvk>

We’re Will Drevno, Richard Berwick, and David Pastewka, the founders of Marker. We’ve built together for 15 years. Our last company, Drapr (YC S20), was acquired by Gap Inc., and Richard went on to found Gap’s Office of AI.

Inside Gap, we saw firsthand how much leaders wanted to transform their businesses with AI and how hard it was to turn that ambition into production systems that actually changed how their organizations worked.

**95% of AI initiatives still fail. Ours don’t.**

The hard part is understanding how work happens across people, systems, and teams; choosing the opportunities that matter most; and getting solutions into production.

We embed with each company and lead the transformation end to end:

* **Understand the organization.** We listen closely to leaders and frontline teams, learn their systems and ways of working, and map the processes that usually live in people’s heads.
* **Find the biggest opportunities.** We identify and prioritize the problems where AI can have the greatest impact on cost, capacity, speed, or growth.
* **Build and ship.** We create custom agents and automations around the company’s real workflows and systems. The agents we deploy run on the Marker Command Center and go live in production within weeks.
* **Compound.** Every agent we deploy deepens our understanding of the company. That helps us launch the next one faster and makes Marker increasingly integral to how the organization operates.

We’re rebuilding companies from mid-size through Fortune 500.
